strings.text: 「「堕ちろぉぉぉぉ！　デモンベイン！」」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: ""FAAALLL! DEMONBANE!""

strings.text: 「てめえも道連れだぁぁぁぁぁ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "YOU'RE GOING DOWN WITH UUUSSS!"

strings.text: これもまた、ひとつの世界と物語。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: This is yet another world and another story.

strings.text: 神が玩ぶ無限螺旋は撃ち砕かれ――世界は再び、未来に向かって動き出す。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The Infinite Spiral schemed by God is shattered-- And the world begins to head for the future anew.

strings.text: ご想像願おう。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Let us imagine.

strings.text: 蟲が啼き、風が哭く夜。幽明と揺らめく洋灯の光。めくる古書から漂う黴の臭い。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The night is filled with insect cries and howling winds. Lamps emit a shimmering, otherworldly light. The scent of moisture drifts from moldy old books as their pages turn.

strings.text: そんな妖夢の気配に酔い痴れながら、怪奇幻想に魅入られた好事家たちはその都市の名前を口にするのだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Enthralled by the intoxicating aura of this mysterious dream, connoisseurs are seduced by bizarre fantasies as they begin to speak the names of cities.

strings.text: 例えば幻都倫敦。わだかまる霧。揺らめく影。たゆたう夢。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Such as the Phantasmal Capital of London. Lingering fog. Wavering shadow. Flickering dream.

strings.text: 例えば魔都上海。入り乱れる文化。入り乱れる闇。乱れ狂う異形。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Such as the Demonic Capital of Shanghai. Clash of cultures. Clash of darkness. Rampaging abominations.

strings.text: 例えば帝都東京。舞い散る夜桜。降り注ぐ月明かり。踊る怪奇。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Such as the Imperial Capital of Tokyo. Cherry blossoms scatter in the night air. Moonlight pours down. Strange monsters dance.

strings.text: そしてもう一つ。魔術理論の最先端。大黄金時代にして大暗黒時代にして大混乱時代の混沌都市。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: And yet another. The bleeding edge of magic theory. This Chaotic City lives in a Great Golden Age, and a Great Age of Chaos and Darkness.

strings.text: ――妖都櫃夢。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --The Otherworldly City of Arkham.

strings.text: あの人智を超えた――否、『神智』をも超えた戦いは時間の記憶から失われ……だがそれでも、この都市の属性は何ら変容ることはない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The battle that transcended the knowledge of humanity--no, even 'divine knowledge'--had become a memory lost to time...... Yet, the city's nature is constant.

strings.text: ミスカトニック大学、秘密図書館。その歴史を紐解けば、禁断の知識を狙う閲覧者たちとそれを封じる管理者たちとの闘争で綴られる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Miskatonic University's Secret Library. If one unravels its history, it tells a story of the struggle between readers who seek forbidden knowledge and the wardens who seal it away.

strings.text: その内の何割かは、あるいは世界の命運を賭けた戦いだったのかも知れない。彼が知る事件もまた、きっとそのひとつだったのだろう。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Some portion of those struggles may have been battles with the fate of the world at stake. The incident he knew of was surely one of them.

strings.text: ミスカトニック大学図書館長ヘンリー・アーミティッジは回顧する。誰も居ない図書室の、誰も居ない闇を見据えながら。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Miskatonic University's chief librarian, Henry Armitage, reminisces, staring into the empty darkness of the unoccupied library.

strings.text: 「……あの夜を思い出すな。忘れもしない。８月３日のことだ」
strings.speaker: アーミティッジ
strings.translated: "......I remember that night. I will never forget it, the incident on August 3rd."

strings.text: 誰も居ないはずの図書室の、誰も居ないはずの闇がわなないた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: In the library where no one should be, the darkness where no one should be trembles.

strings.text: 「夜明けが近かった。夜鷹のけたたましい啼き声は、忌まわしいほどにリズミカルだった」
strings.speaker: アーミティッジ
strings.translated: "Dawn was approaching. The piercing cries of Whippoorwills echoed with a repulsive rhythm."

strings.text: 空気が一変した。何処からともなく生温かい風が吹く。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The atmosphere shifts abruptly. Out of nowhere, a warm breeze sweeps through.

strings.text: 風は腐臭にも似た臭気を孕んでいる。瘴気だ。瘴気の風だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The wind carries a putrid odor reminiscent of decay. It is miasma. It is a wind of miasma.

strings.text: 「番犬の雄叫び。魂を引き裂くような断末魔。図書館を充たす悪臭。ダンウィッチの怪異がもたらした、それは悪夢の記憶だ」
strings.speaker: アーミティッジ
strings.translated: "The watchdog's howl, those soul-rending death throes, and a stench which filled the library. They're the nightmarish memories brought by that Dunwich Horror."

strings.text: 風が吹き荒れる。瘴気を孕む異界の風に、書棚の魔導書が飛ばされる。頁が解けて、無数の紙片が宙に舞う。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The wind bellows. Caught in an otherworldly, miasmic wind, Grimoires are hurled from their shelves. Pages unbind, and countless sheets of paper drift in the air.

strings.text: 叩きつけるような暴風を正面から受け止め、だが老齢のアーミティッジは怯むことなく其処に立つ。アーミティッジの視線の先、魔導書の断片が渦を巻いている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The elderly Armitage faces the intense storm head-on, undaunted. In his gaze, the fragments of Grimoires swirl.

strings.text: さらに解ける。魔導書の頁、一枚一枚から『文字』が溢れ出し、急速な勢いで竜巻の中心に収束していく。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: They disintegrate further. [Symbols] are overflowing from every single page, rapidly converging into a central vortex.

strings.text: 数万数億の文字が複雑に編まれてゆく。結晶する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Tens of thousands--perhaps even hundreds of millions--of symbols intricately weave together. Then they materialize.

strings.text: それは血のように紅い人影だった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It is a silhouette, dyed a deep blood-red.

strings.text: 「……ヘンリー・アーミティッジ」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "......Henry Armitage."

strings.text: 「ほう？　私のことをご存知か。だが、それなら規則も知っていただきたい。今は閲覧時間ではないのだよ」
strings.speaker: アーミティッジ
strings.translated: "Hoh? Are we acquainted? However, you should know the rules. Now is not the time to be browsing."

strings.text: 「賊め……このミスカトニック大学秘密図書館に何の用だ？」
strings.speaker: アーミティッジ
strings.translated: "Damn thief...... What are you plotting in this Miskatonic University's Secret Library?"

strings.text: 「いやよ、お爺ちゃん。そんな怖い顔しないで」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "Oh no, old-timer. Don't give me such a grim look."

strings.text: くすくすと、紅い影が嗤う。その手の中に、一冊の魔導書があった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: With a giggle, the crimson shadow sneers. It clasps a Grimoire in its hand.

strings.text: 「わたしはただ、仲間を迎えに来ただけ」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "I have come merely to retrieve my companion."

strings.text: 手に持った魔導書を掲げる。アーミティッジは見た。その慄然たる題名を。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The figure raises the Grimoire in its hand. Armitage sees its dreadful title.

strings.text: 「『死霊秘法』！？」
strings.speaker: アーミティッジ
strings.translated: "The [Book of the Dead]!?"

strings.text: 頁と頁の隙間から、無数の魔術文字が蟲のように這い出てくる。文字は絡み合い、繋がれ、長い文字列となり、紅い影の、紅い唇の奥、紅い口腔の内部へと吸い込まれてゆく。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: From the gaps between pages, countless magical symbols crawl out like bugs. The symbols interweave, forming a long string before being absorbed by the scarlet shadow, going through its lips and into its mouth.

strings.text: 「ダンウィッチの怪異の同属か！」
strings.speaker: アーミティッジ
strings.translated: "Are you the same type of being as the Dunwich Horror!?"

strings.text: 「お望みとあらば！」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "If you wish it so!"

strings.text: 卵がひび割れるような音を、アーミティッジは聴いた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Armitage hears a sound like an egg cracking.

strings.text: 紅い影の胸が、縦に裂ける。噴き出る鮮血は闇に映えて、綺羅綺羅と輝いていた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The crimson shadow's chest tears open vertically. Fresh blood from the shade gushes forth, sparkling brilliantly in the dark.

strings.text: 飛び散る鮮血は、宙に真紅の魔法陣＝正方形×正方形＝回転式八芒星を描く。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It splatters, weaving a crimson magic circle mid-air = Square x Square = Drawing a spinning octagram.

strings.text: 「なんと！？」
strings.speaker: アーミティッジ
strings.translated: "What the!?"

strings.text: 空間が裂け、時空が流血した。今までとは比べ物にならない瘴気と臭気が、時空の向こうから流れ込んでくる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Space is torn asunder, and space-time bleeds out. Exceeding the continuum, a miasma and stench unlike anything before flow in.

strings.text: この気配と悪臭をアーミティッジは知っている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Armitage knows this stench and this presence.

strings.text: 時空の向こう、異形の眼がこちらの世界を覗き込んでいる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Beyond space-time, otherworldly eyes peek into this world.

strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: They keep increasing/ 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 10000000

strings.text: 現実を侵す悪性腫瘍／兆京垓杼穣溝澗正載極恒河沙阿僧祇那由他不可思議無量大数
strings.speaker: NARRATION

strings.text: 異／♂／界と／現／♀／実との／＊／壁がつい／＋／
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The barrier/♂/between/another world/♀/ and/*/reality/+/

strings.text: に決壊す／る
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: finally/ crumbles.

strings.text: 「ウェイトリイ！？」
strings.speaker: アーミティッジ
strings.translated: "Whateley!?"

strings.text: 異次元より伸びる無数の触手。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Countless tentacles extend from another dimension.

strings.text: 反射的に印を結ぶアーミティッジの周囲に、粉のようなものが舞う。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Around Armitage, a powdery substance flutters as he traces a seal reflexively.

strings.text: 粉は闇に輝き、空間に魔法陣を浮かび上がらせる。術式展開。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: With the powder glittering in the dark, a magic circle emerges from empty space. A spell is cast.

strings.text: ふたつの魔力が激突し、光と音と臭いと衝撃と思念とが荒れ狂い、火花を散らし、そして。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Two magical forces collide--light, sound, stench, shockwaves, and thoughts raging wildly, scattering sparks, and then--

strings.text: 駆けつけたウォーラン・ライス教授とフランシス・モーガン博士が見たものは、爆発の傷痕が生々しい秘密図書館の姿だった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: When Professor Warren Rice and Doctor Francis Morgan rush to the scene, what they notice first is the Secret Library ravaged by fresh scars from the explosion.

strings.text: 残留する瘴気は未だに濃く、館内は酷い悪臭に満ちている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The remaining miasma is as dense as ever, filling the library with a terrible odor.

strings.text: 二人は知っている。この臭いの正体――思い出したくもない悪夢の正体を。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Both of them know. This scent's true nature--this nightmare's identity that they wish to forget.

strings.text: 「ウィルバー・ウェイトリイのときと同じだ……」
strings.speaker: ライス
strings.translated: "Just like Wilbur Whateley back then......"

strings.text: 「アーミティッジ博士！」
strings.speaker: モーガン
strings.translated: "Doctor Armitage!"

strings.text: 図書館の中央、膝を突き蹲る、傷だらけのアーミティッジを見つけたモーガンが叫ぶ。倒れた本棚を鬱陶しそうに避けて、駆け寄る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Morgan shouts as he spots a battered Armitage on his knees in the center of the library. Pushing past the fallen bookshelves in frustration, he rushes to his side.

strings.text: 「何があったんです！？」
strings.speaker: モーガン
strings.translated: "What on earth happened!?"

strings.text: 「……賊に『ネクロノミコン』を奪われた」
strings.speaker: アーミティッジ
strings.translated: "......A thief stole the [Necronomicon]."

strings.text: 「何だって！？」
strings.speaker: モーガン
strings.translated: "What did you say!?"

strings.text: 「それにこの臭い……まさか、またダンウィッチの化物が……！」
strings.speaker: ライス
strings.translated: "Not to mention this smell...... Don't tell me, it's that Dunwich monster again......!"

strings.text: 「……解からん」
strings.speaker: アーミティッジ
strings.translated: "I don't know......"

strings.text: 「だが……大変なことが起こっているぞ……」
strings.speaker: アーミティッジ
strings.translated: "However...... something terrible is definitely happening......"

strings.text: 「来るぞ……九郎」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Here they come...... Kurou."

strings.text: 「分かってる、アル」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Got it, Al."

strings.text: 「術衣形態！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Magius Style!"

strings.text: 「九郎！　また来るぞ！」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Kurou! They're coming again!"

strings.text: 「クッ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Kuh!"

strings.text: 「くっ……はっ！　チィィィッ！」
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: "Kuh...... Hah! Shiiiit!"

strings.text: 「クトゥグア！　イタクァ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Cthugha! Ithaqua!"

strings.text: 「くたばれ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Drop dead!"

strings.text: 「怪我は無いか、九郎？」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Are you hurt, Kurou?"

strings.text: 「ああ、大丈夫だ。しかし……」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Yeah, I'm alright. It's just......"

strings.text: 「またコレか……」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "This again......"

strings.text: 大十字九郎。職業、魔導探偵。まあ、要するにオカルト絡みの事件を扱う何でも屋だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Daijuuji Kurou. Occupation: Occult Detective. Well, to put it simply, I'm a jack-of-all-trades who handles occult-related cases.

strings.text: そんな俺がここ数週間、多忙を極めている。その諸悪の根源が……たった今、ぶっ倒したコレだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Because of that, I've had my hands full for the past few weeks. The very source of all this evil is...... well, those creatures we just beat the living hell out of a moment ago.

strings.text: ここ数週間、多発している怪異。それらはコイツらによって引き起こされていた。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: Strange things have been occurring frequently over the past few weeks. They were caused by these things.

strings.text: 普段は不定形。だが時折こうして実体化し、街中で暴れ出す。その正体はこの通り――自らの意思を持って動く、血溜まりだ。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: Normally, they're formless. Every now and then, though, they materialize like this and go on a rampage in the middle of town. As you can see, their true form is a puddle of blood moving with a will of its own.

strings.text: 今夜と同じように、もう何度もコイツらを倒している。だが怪事件は減るどころか増えていく一方だ。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: Just like tonight, we've already taken them down countless times. Yet far from decreasing, the bizarre incidents only keep multiplying.

strings.text: 「……何なんだ、コイツら」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "What the hell are these things......?"

strings.text: 「さあな」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Who knows."

strings.text: 「妾にも解からん」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Not even I have an idea."

strings.text: アルの知識を以ってしても正体不明な、今回の怪異。ここまで奇妙なのは、かれこれ前の世界以来だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Even with all of Al's knowledge, the true nature of this phenomenon remains a mystery. We haven't seen anything this bizarre since the previous world.

strings.text: アルが言わんとしているところは分かっている。それがまた、さらにこの事件の奇怪さを増しているのだが。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I know what Al is going to say. That also fuels just how bizarre this incident is.

strings.text: 「お前に『近い』感じがある……か」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "You felt that they were 'similar' to you...... right?"

strings.text: 「てけり・り」
strings.speaker: ダンセイニ
strings.translated: "Tekeli-li."

strings.text: 「おう、ただいま」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Oh, we're home."

strings.text: 「留守番ご苦労。ダンセイニ」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Good work house-sitting, Dunsany."

strings.text: 「はあ……むやみやたらに疲れた……」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Haah...... I'm totally beat......"

strings.text: 帰るなり、ソファーに向かって倒れ込む。心底、疲れた。いくらなんでも忙し過ぎる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: As soon as I got inside, I sank onto the sofa. I'm exhausted as hell. Whatever the circumstances might be, I'm way too overloaded right now.

strings.text: 暇よりはマシかも知れないが、これでは身体の方が持たない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: While it might be better than being unoccupied, my body is at its limit.

strings.text: 「覇道の小娘に報告しなくて良いのか？」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Shouldn't we report this case to the Hadou girl?"

strings.text: 「今日はパス……明日で良いや……」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "I'll pass today...... Let's do it tomorrow......"

strings.text: 「だらしがないのう」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "So unsightly."

strings.text: 「てけり・り」
strings.speaker: ダンセイニ
strings.translated: "Tekeli-li."

strings.text: うるせえぞ、人外風情ども。だいたい報告するにしたって、いつもと同じ内容じゃねえか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Shut the hell up, you inhuman Peanut Gallery. I mean, even if we do file a report, won't it be the same shit as usual?

strings.text: 何の腐れ縁か――俺はこの世界でも、覇道財閥のお抱え探偵をやっている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I don't know what kind of toxic relationship I've built with them--nonetheless, I'm still working as a private eye for the Hadou Enterprise in this world.

strings.text: 『ブラックロッジ』が存在しなくても、この街と俺を取り巻く環境は大して変わっていない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Even though [Black Lodge] no longer exists, this city and its atmosphere haven't changed much.

strings.text: 変わっていることがあるとすれば――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The one thing that has changed--

strings.text: デモンベインが無いことくらいか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Is the fact that Demonbane no longer exists.

strings.text: そう。邪神の陰謀を砕いた今、魔を断つ剣は必要ない。アイツの永い戦いはようやく終わったのだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: That's right. Now that we've thwarted the scheme of the Evil Gods, the Sword that Smites Evil is no longer needed. His long battle has finally come to an end.

strings.text: もう居ないデモンベイン。デモンベインを忘れた世界。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Demonbane is no more. A world where Demonbane is forgotten.

strings.text: ふと寂しく思うこともある。だけどこれで良いんだ。世界は未来へ向かっているのだから。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Sometimes a wave of loneliness hits me out of nowhere. But it's better this way. After all, the world is moving toward the future.

strings.text: ……なんてな。感傷的になっている場合じゃない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: ......Yeah, as if. Now's not the time for me to get all sentimental.

strings.text: 今の問題は、例の件だ。あのファッキン血溜まりども、本気で厄介になってきた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The problem right now is this whole case. Those fucking puddles of blood are getting seriously troublesome.

strings.text: 今のところ後れを取ることはないが、それでも決して楽な相手ではない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: So far I haven't been pushed onto the back foot, but even so, they're far from an easy opponent.

strings.text: 「このままじゃキリがねえ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "At this rate there's no end to them."

strings.text: 「……元凶を突き止めんことにはな」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "......Not unless we pin down the source behind this."

strings.text: 「むむむ～」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "*Sigh*~."

strings.text: 「てけり・り～」
strings.speaker: ダンセイニ
strings.translated: "Tekeli-li~."

strings.text: 元凶を突き止めようとしても、手がかりすら無いけどな。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Though even if we want to pin down the source, we don't have a single lead.

strings.text: なにせヤツら、斃れて血溜まりになったと思ったら、すぐに蒸発して消えちまう。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: After all, the moment they go down and collapse into puddles of blood, the bastards evaporate right before our eyes, vanishing without a trace.

strings.text: 「やってらんねえ～……」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "I'm done with this bullshit~......"

strings.text: 「ええい、だからしっかりせんか」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Jeez, can you get a grip already?"

strings.text: 「本当にアイツら、何ものなんだ……」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Honestly, just what on Earth are they......?"

strings.text: 「それを調べるのが仕事だ……ったく」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "That's why investigating them is part of our job...... Good grief."

strings.text: 言いながら、アルは俺の横を通り過ぎる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Saying so, Al passes by me.

strings.text: 「……ん？　どこ行く？」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Hmm......? Where're you goin'?"

strings.text: 「疲れたのは妾も同じだ。湯に浸かって身体を休める」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "I am exhausted as well. I shall soak in the bath and rest my body."

strings.text: 告げて、アルは浴室へ入っていった。部屋には俺とダンセイニが残される。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Saying that, Al enters the bathroom. Only Dunsany and I are left in the room.

strings.text: 「てけり・り？」
strings.speaker: ダンセイニ
strings.translated: "Tekeli-li?"

strings.text: 「何故……汝も入ってくるかぁぁぁ――――ッ！？」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Why...... are you coming in tooooo----!?"

strings.text: 「ドンマイドンマイ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Don't mind me."

strings.text: 「何がだっ！？　あっ、んん……っ！こ、こら、変なところ触るなっ！」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Don't mind WHAT?! Ah, mm... H-Hey, do not touch me in strange places!"

strings.text: 「仕方ないだろ？　狭いんだから」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "What can ya do? The tub's too small."

strings.text: 「か、顔がにやけておるぞ！あ……あああっ……くぅぅんっ！……ま、またぁぁぁぁっ！」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Y-You're grinning?! Ah...... Aaaagh...... Kuun! N-Not agaaaiiin......!"

strings.text: 「やわらかいなぁ……」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "So soft......"

strings.text: 「しみじみ言うな！うくぅっ……そ、そこは……駄目ぇぇぇ……っ！」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "D-Don't say it with so much feeling! Ugh, kuuh...... N-Not there...... Don't......!"

strings.text: 「ヤベ。勃ってきた」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Crap. I got a boner."

strings.text: 「い……いぃ……いぃぃ～～～ッ」
strings.speaker: アル

strings.text: 「……いい加減にせんかッ色情狂がぁぁぁぁっ！」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "......ENOUGH OF THIS CRAP, YOU DAMN SEX MANIAAAAAC!"

strings.text: 「ぐぎゃあああああああああっ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "GUHGYAAAAAAAAAARGH!"

strings.text: 「はぁ……はぁ……余計に……疲れるではないか……うつけが……っ」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "*Pant*... *Pant*... Now I am... even more exhausted... You utter fool..."

strings.text: 「痛てて…………ったく、今さら恥ずかしがる仲でもねえだろ……ブツブツ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Shit that hurts............ Man, what are you embarrassed for when we're already this close......? Grumble grumble."

strings.text: 「わ、妾は汝のように無節操ではないのだっ！」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "I-I am not so shameless as you!"

strings.text: 「へいへい。そりゃあ悪ぅござんした。ふぅ～～～～……」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Alright alright. My bad, then. Phew~~~~......"

strings.text: 「……どうしたのだ？」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "......What's wrong?"

strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "What do you mean......?"

strings.text: 「最近、無理にお道化てないか？」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Have you not been forcing yourself to play the fool lately?"

strings.text: 「……ははっ、なに言ってんだか。俺は別に――」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "......Haha, what the hell are you talking about? I'm not really--"

strings.text: 「誤魔化すな」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Don't play dumb with me."

strings.text: 「汝のことなど手に取るように分かる」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "I know everything about you, inside and out."

strings.text: 「……お見通しってか？　敵わないな」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "......You've seen through me, huh? I can't win against you, after all."

strings.text: 特に意味もなく、アルの髪を撫でる。アルはそれを黙って受け入れている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: For no particular reason, I stroke Al's hair. She accepts it in silence.

strings.text: アルを軽く胸の中に抱いて、告げる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I gently pull Al into my chest and speak.

strings.text: 「大したことじゃないのさ。ただ、ちょっとだけな。前のことを思い出したりして」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "It's no big deal. Just a little something. I was just thinking back on how things used to be."

strings.text: 「『前世』か」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Is it the 'previous life'?"

strings.text: 『前世』ってのはつまり、『ブラックロッジ』が存在した世界……つまりデモンベインで戦っていた時間のことだ。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: By 'previous life', in short, it was the world where [Black Lodge] once existed...... In other words, it was the time when I was fighting with Demonbane.

strings.text: 俺たちの知る暗黒時代は、歪んだ歴史が生み出したものだった。デモンベインの戦いにより間違った時間は修正され……この時間、この世界にはあの強大な悪は存在しない。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: The dark age we knew was born of a distorted history. Through Demonbane's battle, that wrong timeline was corrected...... In this time, in this world, that mighty evil does not exist.

strings.text: そしてあの戦いもまた、もう俺たちの記憶の中にしか存在しないのだ。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: And that battle, too, only exists in our memories right now.

strings.text: 「これで良いんだって、分かってるんだけどな」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "I know this is the best for us, but......"

strings.text: やれやれ。結局、おセンチになっちまった。こういうのは俺の性格には似合わないんだが。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: Good grief. I ended up getting sentimental after all. This kind of thing really isn't in my nature.

strings.text: 「不安にならずとも良い」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "You need not feel uneasy."

strings.text: 湯船の中、アルはそっと俺の手を握る。小さくて華奢な指が、俺の指と絡まり合う。優しく、静かな……だけど確かな口調で告げる。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: In the bathtub, Al softly grasps my hand. Her small, delicate fingers entwine with mine. She speaks in a gentle, quiet...... yet unwavering voice.

strings.text: 「妾はちゃんと、此処に居る」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "I am right here."

strings.text: 「……そうだな」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "That's true......"

strings.text: 俺たちは一度別れ、だが再び廻り逢った。この小さな掌を、もう二度と離すまい。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: We were parted once before, yet found our way back to each other. I will never let go of this small hand again.

strings.text: そう。俺たちはずっと、ふたりで歩んでゆく。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: That's right. We'll keep walking forward together, forever.

strings.text: 「大十字九郎……アル・アジフ」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "Daijuuji Kurou...... Al Azif."

strings.text: 存在は無限に拡散し、世界へと融けてゆく。対して意識は無限に明瞭になり、世界の総てを感じ取る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: My existence diffuses into infinity, dissolving into the world. In contrast, my consciousness becomes infinitely clear, sensing all things in the world.

strings.text: 世界間を移動するときは、いつもこのような感覚に囚われる。今の我は、実在と非実在のゆらぎの中に居る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Whenever I travel between worlds, I am always seized by this sensation. Right now, I exist within the wavering boundary between reality and non-reality.

strings.text: それは魔術の深淵に近づく行為でもあり、自己を見失う危険な行為でもある。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: This is an act that reaches close to the abyss of magic, and also a dangerous act that causes one to lose their very self.

strings.text: 深淵を覗き込むとき、深淵もまた此方を覗き込む――強大な『情報』の渦に呑み込まれれば、ヒトの精神など跡形もなく消し飛んでしまう。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: When you gaze into the abyss, the abyss also gazes into you--if swallowed by the mighty vortex of 'Information,' a human mind would be obliterated without a trace.

strings.text: 自我に幾重にも防壁を編み込み、心は宇宙の中心へと向かう激流、世界の中心から溢れ出す濁流、その狭間、荒れ狂う字祷子の乱流を奔る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Weaving numerous layers of protection around my ego, my mind races through the turbulent currents of Azathoth raging between the torrent rushing toward the center of the cosmos and the muddy stream overflowing from the center of the world.

strings.text: 大いなる流れの只中にあって、我ら時空の魔術師は全知全能となる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: In the middle of the great flow, we, as Space-Time Magi, become omnipotent and omniscient.

strings.text: だが無限の能力は一瞬たりとも魂の器に留まることはなく、ただ空虚に通り過ぎてゆくだけ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: However, that infinite power does not remain in the vessel of the soul for even a moment; it merely passes through in vain.

strings.text: そう。全にして無、だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Indeed. All, and yet nothing.

strings.text: 引き伸ばされた時間が急速に圧縮されてゆく。実世界での顕現が近い。其処はまた、新たな遊戯場だろう。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The Rubber Time is compressing rapidly. I am close to materializing in the real world. Once again, there will be a new playground.

strings.text: 良いだろう、玩弄者。踊らされてやる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Very well, Teaser. I shall let you make me dance.

strings.text: 今回の件は我の迂闊さが招いたこと。彼奴との決着は、この手で付けさせてもらう。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Because of my own carelessness, this incident came to be. I will settle things with her by my own hands.

strings.text: さあ、玩弄者。今度の遊戯は何だ？
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Now, Teaser. What will the Game be this time?

strings.text: 顕現の瞬間。雑念が紛れ込んだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Intrusive thoughts creep in at the moment of my materialization.

strings.text: 自我の防壁をいとも容易く擦り抜け、怒涛の如く流れ込んでくる大質量の思念。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: An immense sentiment flows into me like a surging wave, effortlessly slipping through the defenses of my ego.

strings.text: その正体を我は知らない。だがそれはとても馴染みのあるものだ。世界間を移動するとき、我は必ずこの想いに触れる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I do not know its true identity. Yet it is deeply familiar to me. Whenever I travel between worlds, I always brush against this feeling.

strings.text: 何だ。何なのだ、この想いは。灼けるように熱くて。壊れそうなくらいに激しくて。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: What is this? What is this feeling? It's fiery hot. So intense I feel like I'm about to break.

strings.text: 苛烈で壮絶な魂の衝動／燃焼／激動／疾走／爆発／嵐
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A fierce and tremendous impulse / combustion / upheaval / sprint / explosion / tempest of the soul.

strings.text: でも、それは、そんななのに、それは、強くて、優しくて、陽気で、愛しくて、
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: And yet, even so, it is strong, gentle, bright, and dear--

strings.text: 誰。誰なんだ。いや……
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Who? Who are you? No......

strings.text: 貴方は――『何』なんだ？
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: 'What'--are you?

strings.text: 総ては、ウツロに、通り過ぎるだけ。全にして――無。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: All things merely pass by into emptiness. All, and yet--nothing.

strings.text: ――顕現が始まる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --Materialization begins.

strings.text: まず最初に詞在り。魔術文字が式を組み、識を生む。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: In the beginning is the Word. Magical script weaves a formula, giving birth to consciousness.

strings.text: 空間に投影される術式。擬似的に構築された人体、その隅々に血を送り込む。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A magic formula is cast into space. It pumps blood into every corner of the pseudo-constructed human body.

strings.text: 血こそ我が存在。我が魔力の証明。我が魔術の源泉。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Blood is my existence. It is proof of my magic power. It is the source of my magic.

strings.text: ヒト型の術式、未だ存在しない躰を血が満たしてゆく。紅く、宝石のように輝く術式。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Blood fills the humanoid magic formula, the body that is yet to exist. The magic formula shines crimson like a ruby.

strings.text: 血と術が融け合い、本物の躰を編み上げてゆく。「我」という存在を実証し、世界に承認させているのだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Blood and sorcery fuse together, weaving a real body. It substantiates the existence known as 'myself' and compels the world to acknowledge it.

strings.text: そして我は此処に、新たな世界に立つ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: And here I am, standing in the new world.

strings.text: 最初に感じたのは風。身に纏う外套が強風に煽れ、はためく。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The first thing I feel is the wind. The cloak I wear is whipped by the gale and flutters.

strings.text: 次に音。遠くから聴こえる街の喧騒が、この世界の活気を物語っていた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Next is sound. The bustle of the city heard from afar speaks of this world's vitality.

strings.text: 匂い。大気の匂い。違和感に気付く。何か――懐かしい。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Smell. The scent of the air. I notice something amiss. Something--nostalgic.

strings.text: 光。我は眼を開けた。その眼下に広がるものに、唖然とする。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Light. I open my eyes. I am astonished by what is unfolding below me.

strings.text: 「アーカムシティ？」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Arkham City?"

strings.text: 「失礼します。お茶をお持ちしました」
strings.speaker: 稲田
strings.translated: "Excuse me. I've brought everyone some tea."

strings.text: 「ありがとう、稲田」
strings.speaker: 瑠璃
strings.translated: "Thank you, Inada."

strings.text: 「うむ、御苦労」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Indeed. Good work."

strings.text: お茶を持ってきてくれたメイドさんを横目に、俺たちは昨日の事件について話していた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Glancing sidelong at the maid who brought us tea, we were talking about yesterday's incident.

strings.text: 「……そうですか。また出ましたか」
strings.speaker: 瑠璃
strings.translated: "I see. It's them again, huh......?"

strings.text: 「しかも頻度が増えている。何とかしないとヤバイんだが……うぅむ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "What's more, they are appearing more and more often. We have to do something about 'em, or else we'll be in deep shit...... *Sigh*."

strings.text: 「手がかりはまだ？」
strings.speaker: 瑠璃
strings.translated: "Did you find any leads?"

strings.text: 「さっぱり」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Not a single one."

strings.text: 「困りましたわね……」
strings.speaker: 瑠璃
strings.translated: "That is problematic, isn't it......"

strings.text: 「使用人、茶菓子を所望する」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Servant, fetch me some teacakes."

strings.text: 「そこ。会話に参加すれ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "You there. Join the conversation."

strings.text: 「アルたん……今日も可愛い……ハァハァ……」
strings.speaker: マコト
strings.translated: "My pretty Al...... You're as cute today as ever...... *Pant* *pant*......"

strings.text: 「そこ。仕事しなさい」
strings.speaker: 瑠璃
strings.translated: "You there. Get back to work."

strings.text: 「い、いつの間に……ッ」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "W-When did she......?"

strings.text: 「あー……お嬢様、すんません。ご迷惑おかけしましたぁ……」
strings.speaker: チアキ
strings.translated: "Ah...... We are terribly sorry, mistress. Please pardon the inconvenience."

strings.text: 「さあ、戻るで。マコトっ」
strings.speaker: チアキ
strings.translated: "Alright, time to hustle back. Makoto."

strings.text: 「ああああ……せ、せめてアルたんの匂いを……っ」
strings.speaker: マコト
strings.translated: "Aaaah...... A-At least, let me take a sniff of my little Al......"

strings.text: 「アンタ、今日はトイレ掃除やろ。さっさと働くっ！」
strings.speaker: チアキ
strings.translated: "It's your duty to scrub the toilet today. So move your ass and get back to work!"

strings.text: 「ぴっかぴかに磨き上げろぉ！マリア様でもウンコしたくなるようになぁっ！」
strings.speaker: ソーニャ
strings.translated: "Better clean 'em up all shiny and brand new! So that even Lady Maria would want to take a shit on 'em, got it!?"

strings.text: 「――ソーニャさん。エプロンが、曲がっていてよ？」
strings.speaker: チアキ
strings.translated: "--Sonia-san. Your apron is crooked, you know?"

strings.text: 「黙れ、蛆虫」
strings.speaker: ソーニャ
strings.translated: "Silence, you fucking maggot."

strings.text: 「な、何なのだ……あの女は……ッ」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "W-What the hell...... is wrong with that woman......?"

strings.text: 「……こほんっ。とにかく何か手を打たなければなりません」
strings.speaker: 瑠璃
strings.translated: "......Ahem. At any rate, we must take some sort of countermeasures."

strings.text: 「アーミティッジの爺さんなら、何か知ってるか……？」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Maybe that old-timer Armitage might know something......?"

strings.text: 「ミスカトニック大学ですか」
strings.speaker: ウィンフィールド
strings.translated: "You mean Miskatonic University?"

strings.text: 「あんまり気は進まねえけどな」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Not that I'm interested in going back, though."

strings.text: 「何だ、まだ心的外傷を引きずっているのか？……まったく、『前世』の記憶だと言うのに情けない」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "What, are you still dragging around that trauma? ......Good grief, how pathetic when they are merely memories from a 'previous life.'"

strings.text: 「いや……前世って言うな」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Hey now...... Don't say previous life out loud."

strings.text: そいつは俺たちにしか解からない言葉だろうに。……ほら、姫さんが首傾げてるじゃないか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It's a term that no one but the two of us can understand. ......You see? The Princess is tilting her head at us.

strings.text: 「トラウマってワケじゃねえけど。濃い人間が多いんだよ、あの大学は。はっきり言って疲れる」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Look, it's not like I'm traumatized or anything. It's just that the university is full of eccentric people. To be frank, they wear me out."

strings.text: そもそも俺の在籍していた陰秘学科自体が濃すぎる。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: To begin with, the Esoteric Studies Department I was enrolled in was way too eccentric in itself.

strings.text: その最たるのがダンウィッチ事件に関わっていたアーミティッジの爺さんだが、それにタメ張ってドギツイ先生が他にもいる。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: The prime example of that is old man Armitage, who was involved in the Dunwich incident, but there's another professor who's every bit as intense as he is.

strings.text: 「そういえば最近、アーカムシティに戻ってきたって聞いたけど。あの先生も何か知ってるかもな」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Speaking of which, I heard he recently came back to Arkham City. Maybe that professor knows something too."

strings.text: 「あの先生？」
strings.speaker: 瑠璃
strings.translated: "That professor?"

strings.text: 「ひときわスゴイのが居るんだよ。……とてもジジイには思えないのがな」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Yeah, there's one who's on a whole other level...... You'd never believe he's an old man."

strings.text: 眠る街の静寂を、衝撃波が引き裂いた。高層ビルの窓ガラスが一斉に砕け、眼下の街へと雪のように舞い散る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A powerful shockwave rips through the silence of the sleeping city. The glass windows of skyscrapers all shatter at once, scattering onto the streets below like snow.

strings.text: だが、たとえ空を見上げる者がいようとも、既にそこには何も無い。あるのはただ、取り残された風ばかり。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Yet, even if one were to look to the sky, there is already nothing left. Nothing but the wind.

strings.text: 超音速の世界。大気が兇悪な質量を持って、襲いかかる領域。音すら阻む風の壁を通して、彼の声は彼女に届く。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The world of supersonic speed. A domain where the atmosphere itself assaults you with ferocious mass. Through the barrier of wind that blocks even sound, his voice still reaches her.

strings.text: 「レディ、このままでは逃げられるぞ」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Lady, at this rate, it'll get away from us."

strings.text: 衝撃波を引き連れ、疾る飛行体。それは異形の生命と異界の科学が生んだ落とし子だった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: An aircraft soars at rapid speed, shockwaves trailing in its wake. That object is the offspring born from an amalgamation of otherworldly science and a grotesque lifeform.

strings.text: そしてその背に乗り、超音速の暴力に生身を晒す男がいる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: And riding on top of its back is one man who dares to expose his own flesh and blood among the chaos at supersonic speed.

strings.text: 既に老齢に達しているだろう男だった。しかしそれを全く感じさせないほどの気力に満ちている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: He was a man who must have already reached old age. Yet he was brimming with such vitality that one would never sense it at all.

strings.text: 精悍な顔つき。しかし目元は黒眼鏡に隠され、表情が判別し難い。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: His features are sharp and rugged. However, his eyes are hidden behind a pair of black glasses, making it difficult to read his expression.

strings.text: 果たして如何なる理論が、彼をこの爆速の中で生かすのか。速度はなおも増し、迸る衝撃波はビルを砕く。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Just what kind of logic has enabled him to survive in the midst of such explosive speed? Their speed continues to escalate, smashing the surrounding structures into pieces with surging shockwaves.

strings.text: だが、その超音速を超えて、彼らの先を飛翔る物体がある。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Even so, ahead of them is another flying object exceeding that of supersonic speed.

strings.text: 摩天楼の空に刻む、紅い光線。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A crimson beam carved into the heavens above the skyscrapers.

strings.text: あるときは直線、あるときは曲線、物理法則を無視した機動で追跡者を翻弄する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The beam taunts its pursuers with a maneuver that disregards the very laws of physics; appearing in a straight line at one point, then as a curve at another.

strings.text: その正体は、ここ数週間に渡り、アーカムシティを騒がせている怪異だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Its true identity is the Other that has been running amok in Arkham City over the last few weeks.

strings.text: そしてそれを追う者は、狩猟者だ。字祷子を読み解き、光を超えて霊子の海を往く、闇黒の賢者にして狩人。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: And the one in pursuit of it is a Hunter. He's a Hunter and a Sage of Darkness. Someone who can decipher Azathoth and traverse the sky of Ether beyond the light.

strings.text: 「分かっている」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "Got it."

strings.text: 何処からともなく、彼女の声が返る。その声はやはり、音速の壁に遮られることはない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Her voice answers him from nowhere in particular. Once again, it is not blocked by the sound barrier.

strings.text: 「本気を出すよ。振り落とされないでね」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "I'm about to get serious. Try not to get thrown off, okay?"

strings.text: 「蜂蜜酒は飲んでいる。思いっきりやりたまえ」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "I drank the Mead. You're free to go all-out."

strings.text: 「Ｙｅｓ，Ｄａｄｄｙ」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "Yes, Daddy."

strings.text: 飛行体の後部、魔力エンジンであるフーン機関が唸りを上げる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: At the rear of the aircraft, the magic-powered Hune engine howls.

strings.text: それは圧縮された情報、一音節ごとに超高密度の魔術的『意味』を詰め込まれた言語は悲鳴となり、常人の識閾を超え、蛮名化する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It is compressed Information, a language packed with extremely dense magical 'meaning' in each and every syllable. It becomes a shriek, a barbaric howl that surpasses the limit of mortal consciousness.

strings.text: 霊子の吸引→魔術的定義の圧縮→魔力燃焼→排気／爆発＝物理的／概念的に。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Absorption of Ether -> Compression of magical definition -> Combustion of magic power -> Exhaust/Explosion = Physically/Conceptually.

strings.text: 次の瞬間、賢者を乗せた飛行体は光となった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The aircraft the Sage rides on becomes pure light in that instant.

strings.text: 時間を切り取ったかのように、紅い光線の行く先に飛行体が現出した。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: As if a slice of time itself had been cut away, the aircraft materialized directly in the path of the crimson beam.

strings.text: 軌道を変えようとする紅い光線。だが遅い。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The crimson beam attempts to switch its trajectory, but it's too late.

strings.text: 「捉えたぞ！」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Got you!"

strings.text: 驚くべきことに賢者は、超々々音速で奔る飛行体から飛び降りた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Astonishingly, the Sage leaps right off the aircraft as it hurtles forward at hypersonic speed.

strings.text: 五芒星形の印が、兇暴な物理法則と魔術法則から彼を守護る。さらに続けて印を結ぶ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The pentagram-shaped mark helps protect him from both the violent laws of physics and magic. He continues to weave the mark even further.

strings.text: 「吹き荒め、険悪にして窮極の風よ！
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Rage forth, O sinister and ultimate wind!

strings.text: ハスターの爪、受けるが良い！」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: Taste the Claw of Hastur!"

strings.text: 賢者の詠唱に応え、遥かヒヤデス星団の彼方から、光の距離を超えて風が吹いた。それは空間をも断ち切る風の刃。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: In response to the Sage's incantation, a wind blows from far beyond the Hyades cluster, crossing light-years of distance. It is a blade of wind that cleaves even space itself.

strings.text: 邪神の爪から逃れられる存在はいない。摩天楼の空が七度『切断』された。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: No being can ever escape from the claws of this Evil God. The heavens above the skyscrapers are 'severed' seven times.

strings.text: 紅の光線も断たれ、爆ぜる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The crimson streak of light is also cut to pieces and bursts open.

strings.text: 血の雨が眼下の街に降り注いだ。紅い光線の正体は、超音速で疾走する血風だったのだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A downpour of blood rains upon the city below. The crimson beam's true form is a bloody wind, racing through the skies at supersonic speed.

strings.text: 断たれた空間が急速に復元する。空間の断層に大気が流れ込んだ。暴風が吹き荒れる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The torn space swiftly returns to its original state. The air is streaming into the gap in space. An intense gale sweeps over.

strings.text: 「ふんっ！」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Hmph!"

strings.text: 賢者は風を編んで、自らの周囲に風の結界を創る。超音速の只中に居た賢者は、減速して減速してさらに減速。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The Sage weaves another flurry of wind, surrounding himself in a barrier. He begins to slacken his ultra-rapid pace, slowing down further and further.

strings.text: ほぼ無重力の状態になったところで、翔け寄ってきた飛行体が自らの背に彼を乗せた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: As he floats in a state of near-zero gravity, the aircraft rushes over, placing him on its back.

strings.text: 「やったか……？」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Did we get it......?"

strings.text: 「まだ！」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "Not yet!"

strings.text: 激しく降る血の雨は、だが街を濡らしていない。止まったのだ。時間を止めたように、全ての雨粒は中空に静止している。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The heavy deluge of blood does not soak the city. Rather, it halted. As though time has stopped, all the raindrops stand still in mid-air.

strings.text: 「此奴！」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "This thing!?"

strings.text: 逆転する。今度は、天に向かって降り注ぐ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Everything reverses. This time, the rain pours upward toward the heavens.

strings.text: 雨はアーカムシティの上空に集まり、巨大な血の湖を作った。澄んだ紅い水面が、鏡となって街を逆様に映している。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The rain collects in the sky above Arkham City, forming a huge lake of blood. The clear crimson surface reflects the city upside-down like a mirror.

strings.text: 水面にひとつの波紋が生じた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A single ripple dances across the water's surface.

strings.text: 波紋はさらなる波紋を呼び、水面を乱し、波立たせていく。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: That ripple calls forth more ripples, disturbing the surface and churning it into waves.

strings.text: 歪む鏡写しの街。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The mirrored reflection of the city warps.

strings.text: その向こう側、異界の彼方より、巨大な何かが顕れる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Beyond the reflection, from the far side of another world, something gigantic emerges.

strings.text: 「ダディ！」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "Daddy!"

strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Impossible......!"

strings.text: 掌だ。鋼鉄に鎧われた、巨人の腕だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It's a palm. An arm of a giant clad in steel.

strings.text: 「鬼械神！？」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "A Deus Machina!?"

strings.text: その掌の上――正しくは下――に、小柄な人影が在った。その人影は、邪悪な光が宿る眼で、眼下の街を見上げている。口の端を吊り上げ、犬歯をむき出しにして嗤う。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: On top of it--or, to be more precise, underneath its palm--is a tiny human figure. The figure looks up at the city below, his eyes gleaming with an evil spark of light. Curling his lips, he sneers at them, baring his canines.

strings.text: 「Ｉａ！　ｉＡ！
strings.speaker: クラウディウス
strings.translated: "Ia! iA!

strings.text: ＨａＳＴｕＵＲＲｒｒｒｒｒｒ！」
strings.speaker: クラウディウス
strings.translated: HaSTuURRrrrrrr!"

strings.text: 異形の呪文と共に、瘴気の風が吹き荒れる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A wind of miasma bellows forth, accompanied by an otherworldly spell.

strings.text: 闇黒色の竜巻が、街を、賢者を、彼が乗る飛行体を襲う。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A pitch-black vortex assaults the city, the Sage, and the aircraft he's riding.

strings.text: 大気と魔力の流れが生む、巨大なミキサーに全てが投げ込まれた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Everything is tossed into something akin to a giant mixer, created by streams of air and magic power.

strings.text: 「きゃああああああ！」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "KYAAAAAAH!"

strings.text: 「ぐっ……ああああ！」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Guh...... Ooooh!"

strings.text: 「これは……ハスターの力ッ！？」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "This is...... the power of Hastur!?"

strings.text: 大気同士の摩擦が、空間同士の摩擦が、現実と異界との摩擦が、臨界点を突破する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The friction between atmospheres, between spaces, and between reality and another world breaches the critical point.

strings.text: 竜巻の内部に生じる雷。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Within the vortex, bolts of electricity take form.

strings.text: それは光度と威力を増し、ついには暴発する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Their brightness and power intensify until, at last, they violently detonate.

strings.text: 雷光が街を包み込んだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Lightning swallows the entire city.

strings.text: 怪異が過ぎ去った後は、またしても破壊の傷痕。瓦礫が降り積もり、あちこちで炎が上がっている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: After the otherworldly phenomenon passes, the scars of destruction are vivid once again. Debris piles up and flames erupt everywhere.

strings.text: 爆心地。焼け焦げた飛行体の残骸が転がっている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: They are at ground zero. What remains of the aircraft has burnt to a crisp, tumbling lifelessly to the ground.

strings.text: 見るも無残な状態、だがあれだけの力に晒されながら、原形はしっかりと止めている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Although it's in such a miserable state, it retains its original form in spite of the excessive force it endured.

strings.text: 突然、飛行体の装甲がひび割れた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Suddenly, its armor cracks.

strings.text: 崩れる機体の内部から、大きな虫の翅が現れる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Insect wings emerge from the interior of the collapsing machine.

strings.text: さらに続いて、その翅を持つ少女の躰が。それは蛹から孵る蝶の姿にも似ていた。翅が折りたたまれ、少女の背中に収納される。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Right behind them follows the body of the girl who bears those wings, looking much like a butterfly emerging from its chrysalis. The wings then fold up and stow away into her back.

strings.text: 「大丈夫、ダディ？」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "Are you okay, Daddy?"

strings.text: 「くっ……ああ、無事だ」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Kuh...... Yeah, I'm alright."

strings.text: 崩れ落ちる装甲の下から、蹲った賢者が現れる。意識が朦朧としているのか、両目を右手で覆い軽く頭を振っている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The Sage crawls out from underneath the crumbling armor. Shaking his head lightly, he covers his eyes with his right hand, perhaps still feeling groggy.

strings.text: 賢者の様子に気付いた少女は周囲に視線をめぐらせ、足元に落ちているサングラスを見つける。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The girl, realizing the state he's in, searches around her and discovers his sunglasses next to her feet.

strings.text: 「ダディ、サングラス」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "Daddy, here's your sunglasses."

strings.text: 「ああ……すまない」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Ah...... Thank you."

strings.text: 少女が拾い上げたサングラスを受け取り、掛け直す。立ち上がり、周囲の状況を見渡した。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Receiving them from her, he fixes them back onto his face. He starts observing the situation around him as he rises to his feet.

strings.text: 「アーミティッジ博士の言うとおりだな。この怪異は大事になりそうだ」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Just as Dr. Armitage said, this horror is going to turn into a major incident."

strings.text: 「あの血溜まり――」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "That puddle of blood--"

strings.text: 「レディ？　何か分かるのか？」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Lady? You know something?"

strings.text: 「ううん。でも……私に近い気がするよ」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "No. But...... I have a feeling that it is similar to me."

strings.text: 「近い……か。それにあの小僧――」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Similar...... huh? Besides, that young lad--"

strings.text: 先ほどの戦いを思い出す。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: He recalls the battle that just took place.

strings.text: 飛翔る血風。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The soaring bloody wind.

strings.text: 逆流する血の雨と、空に生じた血の湖。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The reverse-flowing rain of blood, and the lake of blood formed in the sky.

strings.text: その向こうから顕れた、血まみれの少年と鬼械神の腕――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: And materializing from beyond it, the blood-soaked boy and the arm of a Deus Machina--

strings.text: 「何故だろうな。妙に引っかかる。失った記憶を無理やり引きずり出されるような、嫌な感覚だ」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "I wonder why. It bothers me strangely. It's an unpleasant sensation, as if lost memories are being forcibly dragged out of me."

strings.text: 「……どう思う、アル？」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Your thoughts, Al......?"

strings.text: 「例の奴だろうな」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "It is likely the one we have been pursuing."

strings.text: 「ドクター・ウェストの仕業って線は？」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Any chance it's Doctor West's doing?"

strings.text: 「無いな。こんな不愉快な血の臭いを残すのは、あの怪異以外居るまい」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Not a chance. Nothing else could leave behind such a foul stench of blood save for that horror."

strings.text: 「……だよなあ。だとしたら、今までとは段違いの力だ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "......Yeah, I figured. If that's the case, its power is on a whole different level than it's been up to now."

strings.text: 昨夜、この区画で大規模な爆発があった。状況は……見ての通り。なかなか派手にやってくださる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Last night, there was a large-scale explosion that occurred in this block. The result is...... well, you can see it here. They created this whole fiasco; it's quite a scene.

strings.text: 「これ程の魔力を持っているとなると……相当、厄介だぞ」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "If it possesses this much magical power...... it will prove quite troublesome indeed."

strings.text: 「……本気でヤバくなってきたようだな」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "We're in deep shit right now......"

strings.text: こっちが思ってた以上に、事態は深刻のようだ。ボヤボヤとはしてられない。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: It appears the situation is way worse than we expected. We can't afford to let ourselves remain idle.

strings.text: 微風が吹いた。それだけのことだが、妙な胸騒ぎを感じる。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: A gentle breeze blows past me. Even though that's all it is, it makes my heart feel strangely uneasy.

strings.text: 「……風が瘴気を孕んでいる」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "......This wind is filled with miasma."

strings.text: 「これも奴の仕業か？」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Is this their doing too?"

strings.text: 「さあな」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Who knows."

strings.text: 「……分からないことだらけだな」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "There are a bunch of things that I still don't understand......"

strings.text: だがこれと同じ、灼けつくような魔性の風を俺は知ってる。あれは――
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: Though I recall a devilish, scorching breeze similar to this one. It was--

strings.text: 「……まさか、な」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "There's no way, right......?"

strings.text: 「そこぉ！ここは立ち入り禁止であります！」
strings.speaker: ストーン
strings.translated: "You there! This place is a restricted area!"

strings.text: 「……暑苦しいのが来よったわ」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "......And here comes that loud, overbearing one."

strings.text: 見知った顔が、こっちに駆け寄ってくる。その後ろには治安警察の装甲車と、複数の警官の姿があった。現場検証をしていたのだろう。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A face we know all too well comes rushing at us. Behind him are the armored vehicles of the security police department, along with several officers. I guess they're supposed to investigate on-site.

strings.text: 「現場を荒らされては困るのであります！さあ、帰った帰った！」
strings.speaker: ストーン
strings.translated: "It would be troublesome for us if you guys made a mess outta the crime scene! Now, get out of here!"

strings.text: 「荒らすも何も、既にこれ以上無いほど荒れておるではないか」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Mess or not, could this place possibly be any more ruined than it already is?"

strings.text: 「そういう問題では……！」
strings.speaker: ストーン
strings.translated: "That's not the issue here......!"

strings.text: 「あ。覇道財閥の許可はもらってるんで」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Ah. We already got the authorization from the Hadou Enterprise."

strings.text: 「くぅぅぅぅぅ～～～～ッ！」
strings.speaker: ストーン
strings.translated: "Grrrrrr~~~~!"

strings.text: 「よう。探偵」
strings.speaker: ネス
strings.translated: "Hi there. Mr. Detective."

strings.text: 「やあ。やる気の無い方のお巡りさん」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "What's up? Mr. Apathetic Officer."

strings.text: 「覇道お抱えのあんたらが動いてるってことは、やっぱりこいつも例のヤツ絡みか？」
strings.speaker: ネス
strings.translated: "Since ya Hadou employees are makin' a move, that must mean all these commotions are because of 'em, yeah?"

strings.text: 「多分な」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Probably."

strings.text: 「あーゆー非常識な事件は、あんたらが面倒見てくれると、俺は楽なんだがねぇ～」
strings.speaker: ネス
strings.translated: "Well, it makes my life a whole lot easier if you guys take care of absurd cases like those for me~"

strings.text: 「ネス警部！またそんな無責任なことをっ！」
strings.speaker: ストーン
strings.translated: "Inspector Ness! Again, with that negligence of yours!"

strings.text: 「気楽に言ってくれるなよ……」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Don't just say it so casually, man......"

strings.text: 血の化け物。昨夜の爆発。瘴気の風。もう何が何やらさっぱりだ。こいつは本気でミスカトニックに頼ってみるかぁ？
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: Blood monsters. The explosion from yesterday. And the gust of miasma. I have no idea what the hell is going on anymore. Do I seriously have to turn to Miskatonic for this?

strings.text: 「まっ、期待してるぜ。正義の味方」
strings.speaker: ネス
strings.translated: "Well, I'm countin' on ya, Champion of Justice."

strings.text: 「……よしてくれ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Gimme a break......"

strings.text: 今回の件に限らず、この街では相変わらず怪事件は多発し、ついでにドクター・ウェストの破壊ロボは暴れまくる。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: Weird incidents are routinely happening in this city as often as ever, not even limited to the current case alone, all while the Destroyer Robots of Doctor West are on a relentless rampage.

strings.text: そういうのを相手にしているうちに、いつの間にかこの人からは「正義の味方」呼ばわりされる羽目になった。だけど。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: While dealing with all that, before I knew it, this guy started calling me a "Champion of Justice." Even so...

strings.text: 「本物の『正義の味方』は、もっと立派だよ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "A genuine 'Champion of Justice' is much more praiseworthy."

strings.text: 『ブラックロッジ』の存在しないこの世界に、もう『正義の味方』はいない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: In this world where the [Black Lodge] doesn't exist, the 'Champion of Justice' is no more.

strings.text: いや……必要ではないのだ。重い宿命背負ったヒーローなんて、もう居なくても良い。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: No...... It's more like one is no longer needed. There's no need for a hero burdened with a heavy fate to exist anymore.

strings.text: 吹きゆく風は、やはりわずかな瘴気を孕んでいる。その不快な気配に、思わず顔をしかめる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Indeed, the wind that blows past us is carrying a small amount of miasma. I couldn't help but grimace at such an uncomfortable presence.

strings.text: 正義の味方は必要ない。だから――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: We don't need a Champion of Justice. Therefore--

strings.text: 「こんな胸糞悪ィ風なんか吹いてちゃ駄目なんだよ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Ain't no way we'll let such a nasty and sickening wind keep blowin' as it pleases."

strings.text: ――私は囚われの姫だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --I am a princess in captivity.

strings.text: 覇道瑠璃は己が境遇を悲嘆する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Hadou Ruri laments her own circumstances.

strings.text: そう……私は恐るべき魔王に囚われている。この美貌が、魔王の心を奪ってしまったからだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: That's right...... I am held in captivity by a terrible Demon King. All because my beauty stole the Demon King's heart.

strings.text: 覇道の邸は魔王の城であり、総帥の椅子は牢獄である。デスクに積まれた書類の山は拘束の鎖。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The Hadou Mansion itself is the castle of the Demon King; the president's seat serves as her prison. The mountains of documents piled high act as her shackles.

strings.text: そして、書類に刻まれている文字は言うまでもなく呪いだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: And needless to say, the writings engraved on those documents serve as her curses.

strings.text: 「……ド畜生ですわ」
strings.speaker: 瑠璃
strings.translated: "......What a brute."

strings.text: 長きに渡る監禁は、彼女の精神を着実に磨耗させた。哀れ、気高く美しい姫の魂は、ついぞ魔王に屈してしまった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Her long confinement had steadily worn away at her spirit. Alas, the soul of the noble, beautiful princess had finally succumbed to the Demon King.

strings.text: あとはただ堕落と退廃に溺れ、穢れゆくだけ――。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The only thing left for her is to become tainted, and indulge in degeneration and depravity--.

strings.text: ぐったり。ばったり。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Limp. Slumped.

strings.text: 机の上に、だらしなくうつ伏す上半身。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Her upper body lies sprawled face-down across the desk in a disheveled heap.

strings.text: 倒れ込んだ衝撃で書類の山がギリギリの均衡を失い、容赦なく瑠璃の上に雪崩れる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The impact of her collapse causes the precarious piles, which had been reaching their limit, to unforgivingly descend onto the woeful Ruri.

strings.text: 書類に埋もれながら、悲劇の姫君は呪詛を吐く。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Buried beneath the documents, the tragic princess spits out a curse.

strings.text: 「逃げやがりましたわね……お父様」
strings.speaker: 瑠璃
strings.translated: "You ran away from all this, didn't you...... Father?"

strings.text: 祖父が隠居したとき、覇道瑠璃は財閥総帥の座を継いだ。本来、総帥を継ぐべきは父である。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: When her grandfather went into retirement, Hadou Ruri succeeded him as president of the Hadou Enterprise. Originally, it was her father who should have taken over as head of the group.

strings.text: だが自分にその器は無いと判断した父は、才能ある瑠璃にその座を譲ったのだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: However, he himself concluded that he was unsuitable for the position, and gifted it to Ruri.

strings.text: さもありなん。アーカムシティを本拠とする覇道財閥の総帥は多忙を極める。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: And small wonder. As the president of the Hadou Enterprise, which is based in Arkham City, she is swamped with work.

strings.text: 何せＦＢＩの某課も吃驚の怪事件が、ファーストフード並みの気軽さで、市民の皆様に提供されるような素敵都市だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: After all, it's a wonderful city where bizarre incidents that would shock even a certain department of the FBI are served up to the citizenry as casually as fast food.

strings.text: ソレ絡みの処理は、他の仕事を圧迫するほどの量になる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: That's not even mentioning the processes involved in dealing with cases related to them have been stacking up to the point that they're interfering with her normal duties.

strings.text: 「殺されるほど忙しい」と書いて「忙殺」。誰が好きこのんで、そんな地獄のような仕事をやりたがるものか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: They literally spell "swamped with work" using the characters for "busy" and "killed." Who in their right mind would ever willingly take on a hellish job like that?

strings.text: 父は「覇道財閥総帥の責務」と言う名の魔王に、我が娘を生贄として差し出したのだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Her father presented his own daughter as a sacrifice to the Demon King, called "The Duty of the President of the Hadou Enterprise".

strings.text: 「……腐れ外道」
strings.speaker: 瑠璃
strings.translated: "......What a worthless brute."

strings.text: ……父は今ごろ何をしてるのか。世界経済の視察と称して、母と二十年遅れの世界旅行を楽しんでいるのか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: ...What is her father even doing right now? Is he enjoying a twenty-year-belated trip around the world with her mother under the pretext of inspecting the global economy?

strings.text: 帰ってきたらアリゾナの砂漠に埋めてやる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I'll definitely bury him in the Arizona desert once he comes back.

strings.text: 心に固く誓い、窓の外に広がる景色を見る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: She looks at the vast scenery outside the window as she resolves this pledge firmly in her heart.

strings.text: 時間はもう夕方になっていた。夕陽が世界を紅く、染めている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It was already evening. The setting sun dyed the world crimson.

strings.text: まるで血に濡れているようだ。瑠璃は思った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It looks as though it's drenched in blood, Ruri thought.

strings.text: 「血……ですか」
strings.speaker: 瑠璃
strings.translated: "Blood...... huh?"

strings.text: 書類の一枚を拾い上げる。昨夜あった爆発事故の件についてだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: She picks up a single document. It's a report regarding the explosion accident that occurred last night.

strings.text: この件もやはり、例の怪事件――血の怪異絡みらしいという調査結果が出ている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Their investigation results revealed that this case is also connected with the strange incidents in question--the blood horrors.

strings.text: 再び、窓の外に目を向ける。血の彩の空。逢魔ヶ刻には、こんな彩こそ相応しい。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: She shifts her focus to the window again. The sky is painted like blood. Such a color is fitting for the demonic twilight.

strings.text: 「……嫌な夕焼け」
strings.speaker: 瑠璃
strings.translated: "Such a nasty sunset......"

strings.text: 何故だろう。なぜ夕焼けを、こんなにも忌まわしいものと感じるのだろう。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Why though? Why does she feel that this sunset is so detestable?

strings.text: 何かが疼いていた。記憶の奥の奥。さらに奥。前世より遠い場所にある、深い深い傷痕。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Something is aching. Deep inside her memories, and even deeper. A deep and profound scar that lies somewhere beyond her previous life.

strings.text: 根拠の無い不安と憂鬱に、瑠璃は囚われていた。陽が完全に沈むまで、ずっと。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Ruri was gripped by groundless anxiety and melancholy. All the way until the sun had completely set.

strings.text: 覇道邸廊下。夕陽に染まる廊下を、覇道家執事ウィンフィールドは歩いていた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: In the corridor of the Hadou mansion. Winfield, the Hadou butler, walks through the corridor, dyed by the setting sun.

strings.text: 足を止める。行く先。紅い夕陽の光に溶けるように佇む、紅い人影。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: He pauses. Ahead of him stands a crimson shadowy figure, still as can be, yet melting into the reddish light of dusk.

strings.text: 「誰ですか？」
strings.speaker: ウィンフィールド
strings.translated: "Who's there?"

strings.text: 紅い影がゆらりと歩き出す。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The scarlet shadow sways and begins to walk.

strings.text: 影の濃度が増す。紅から黒へ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The density of the shadow is getting thicker, shifting from red to black.

strings.text: 全身に纏わりつく紅い羊膜を破り捨てるように、それは姿を顕した。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: As though casting away the red membrane that has been coiling around its whole body, it reveals its form.

strings.text: 時代劇の銀幕から抜け出し、現実に迷い込んだ、ひとりのサムライ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It's a samurai who has freed himself from the silver screen of a period drama and wanders into reality.

strings.speaker: ウィンフィールド
strings.translated: "--An intruder!?"

strings.text: 「疾ッ！」
strings.speaker: ティトゥス
strings.translated: "Haaah!"

strings.text: サムライが疾り、銀閃が迅る。弧を描き迫る刃は、ウィンフィールドの首を狙う。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The samurai dashes forward, swiftly unleashing a flash of silver. His approaching blade draws an arc, aimed at Winfield's neck.

strings.text: 思考よりも速く、闘争本能がウィンフィールドを動かした。放たれるクロスカウンター。刃と拳は交差し、そして――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Winfield's combat instinct kicks in faster than his own thoughts. A cross counter is released. The fist and the blade clash, and then--

strings.text: 擦り抜けた。サムライの黒い影も、煌めく刀の銀閃も、夕陽の紅に融け落ち、存在の濃度を失う。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: They pass through. Losing their existence, the samurai's shadow and his glittering blade dissolve into the crimson of twilight.

strings.text: ただ一陣の風が、ウィンフィールドの横を吹き抜けていった。鼻腔を突く鉄錆の臭い。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Yet, only a gust of wind blows past Winfield. The scent of rusty iron pierces his nostrils.

strings.text: ――血臭。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --It's the smell of blood.

strings.text: 拳を突き出した体勢のまま、呆然と立ち尽くす。日は沈み、窓の外は藍色の空が広がり始めていた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Dumbfounded, he continues standing there while still holding his fist out. The sun has set, and the indigo sky begins to expand outside the windows.

strings.speaker: ウィンフィールド
strings.translated: "What in the world, just now......?"

strings.text: 「めしー」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Foooood."

strings.text: 「めしー」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Foooood."

strings.text: 「それ以外の言語を知らんのか、君ら」
strings.speaker: ライカ
strings.translated: "Do you guys know any other words?"

strings.text: 「最近忙しそうねえ、九郎ちゃん」
strings.speaker: ライカ
strings.translated: "You seem busy lately, Kurou-chan."

strings.text: 「もぐもぐ……いほがひぃ……もぐ……ものふほく、いほがふぃい」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "*Munch munch*...... (We've been busy)...... *Munching*...... (Drowning in stuff to do, for real)."

strings.text: 「はい。口の中に食べ物を入れたまま喋らない」
strings.speaker: ライカ
strings.translated: "Okay. Don't talk with your mouth full like that."

strings.text: 「もぐ……もぐ……ごくんっ。ああ、すっげー厄介なの抱え込んでるよ……ふぅ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "*Munch*...... *Munch*...... *Gulp*. Yeah, we did run into some serious issues...... Phew."

strings.text: 「例の事件に関わっているんだったっけ？えーと、ほら」
strings.speaker: ライカ
strings.translated: "So they had something to do with those incidents? Umm, you know."

strings.text: 「もぐもぐ……
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "*Munch munch*......

strings.text: ひのばへものほほほは」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: Yhou mhean the bhlood hohhors?"

strings.text: 「はい、そこも。ちゃんと飲み込んでから喋るっ」
strings.speaker: ライカ
strings.translated: "Right, you too. Make sure to swallow properly before speaking."

strings.text: 「んぐ……んく……ごくんっ。
strings.speaker: アル

strings.text: うむ、血の怪異のことか。まったく忌々しい。彼奴のせいで、休む暇も無い」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: Indeed, you speak of the blood horrors? Truly infuriating. Because of that fiend, we have not had a moment's rest."

strings.text: 「バケモノは年中無休の２４時間営業だからな」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Because monsters are open for their business 24 hours a day and 365 days a year."

strings.text: 「でも良いことじゃない、ちゃんとお仕事があるということは。お姉さんは感激ですよ～」
strings.speaker: ライカ
strings.translated: "But it means that you've finally gotten yourself a stable job, so isn't that a good thing? Your big sis is extremely moved~."

strings.text: 「そうよ……九郎ちゃんが真面目に社会人してるなんて、ぶっちゃけありえねぇーまさに奇蹟かつファンタスティックな出来事ですもの」
strings.speaker: ライカ
strings.translated: "Oh yeah...... To think Kurou has become an honest working adult is totally unbelievable. It's nothing short of a fantastically marvelous event!"

strings.text: 「私はてっきりこのまま九郎ちゃんが人道を踏み外して――」
strings.speaker: ライカ
strings.translated: "And here I thought, at this rate, Kurou would certainly stray from the human path--"

strings.text: 「（妄想中）」
strings.speaker: ライカ
strings.translated: "(Lost in her delusions)"

strings.text: 「九郎ちゃんっ！？あの冷蔵庫の中身にもモザイクが必要だと思うのっ！」
strings.speaker: ライカ
strings.translated: "Hey Kurou!? I think we need to apply mosaic censorship to the contents of that fridge as well!"

strings.text: 「落ち着けシスター。そして地獄に堕ちろ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Hold your horses, Sister. And please go to hell."

strings.text: 「相変わらず殺伐とした団欒風景だ」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Still a savage family gathering as usual."

strings.text: 「でも……お化け暴れてるの、こわいよね……」
strings.speaker: アリスン
strings.translated: "But...... It frightens me to know that monsters are running wild out there......"

strings.text: 「大丈夫よ、アリスン。九郎ちゃんが解決してくれるから。……そうよね？」
strings.speaker: ライカ
strings.translated: "Things are gonna be okay, Alison. Because Kurou will take care of them in no time. Am I wrong......?"

strings.text: 「んー？　ま、頑張ってはみるさ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Hmm? Well, I'll give it my best shot."

strings.text: 「そうだー、もっとキリキリはたらけーっ♪」
strings.speaker: ジョージ
strings.translated: "Yeah, get to work on the double!"

strings.text: 「バシャウマのごとくはたらけーっ♪」
strings.speaker: コリン
strings.translated: "Work like a packhorse!"

strings.text: 「ええいっ！　このガキんちょどもが！人の苦労も知らずにっ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Gah! You little brats! You have no idea what kind of hardships I go through!"

strings.text: 「……何だよ？　いきなり笑い出して。気持ち悪いなぁ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "......What's the matter? You started smiling out of nowhere. It creeps me out."

strings.text: 「いえいえ♪……九郎ちゃんは誰かのために頑張る子だなあ、ってね」
strings.speaker: ライカ
strings.translated: "Oh, nothing... I was just thinking how you always work so hard for someone else's sake, Kurou-chan."

strings.text: 「……別に大層なことをしてるつもりはないよ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "It's not that big a deal, though."

strings.text: 「そう？　ふふ……だけど、九郎ちゃんって、そうね……」
strings.speaker: ライカ
strings.translated: "You think so? Heh heh...... But you see, Kurou......"

strings.text: 「まるで――『正義の味方』みたい」
strings.speaker: ライカ
strings.translated: "It's like--you're a 'Champion of Justice'."

strings.text: 「よしてくれよ……」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Cut me some slack already......"

strings.text: 教会からの帰り道を、アルとふたり並んで歩く。静かな夜だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: On our way back from the church, Al and I walk side-by-side. It's a peaceful night.

strings.text: 街の喧騒は遠く、ジリジリ……と切れかかった街灯の、明滅する音が聴こえる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The bustle of the city is far off, and I can hear the faint buzzing of a dying streetlamp flickering on and off.

strings.text: 夜道には人の気配は無く、さっきから誰ともすれ違わない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: There are no signs of people on the streets at this time, and we haven't even encountered anyone for quite a while.

strings.text: 「九郎」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Kurou."

strings.text: 「ああ、分かっている」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Yeah, I know."

strings.text: 俺たちは足を止めた。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: We halt in our tracks.

strings.text: 前方の薄闇を凝っと睨みつける。粘つくような夜気が気持ち悪い。周囲の建物が圧し掛かってくるような威圧感を感じる。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: I glare intently into the dim darkness ahead. The sticky night air is sickening. I feel an oppressive pressure, as though the surrounding buildings are bearing down on me.

strings.text: そして何よりも雄弁なのは、さっきから鼻を突く鉄の臭い――血臭。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: And the most potent sensation of all is the scent of iron that has been assailing our nostrils for some time now--the smell of blood.

strings.text: 「はんっ。まさか向こうからお出ましとはな。どういう風の吹き回しだ？」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Heh. Didn't expect 'em to take the initiative. So what brought this on today then?"

strings.text: 脳の奥で、世界がひび割れる音を聴く。現実の壁を破り、怪異がこちらの世界に流れ込むのだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Deep within my mind, I hear the sound of the world cracking. Tearing the barrier of reality apart, the Other flows into this world.

strings.text: 血生臭い風が吹く。ロウソクの火が風に吹き消されるように、街灯が一斉に消えた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A blood-stained wind howls. The streetlamps all go out simultaneously, as if they were candle flames extinguished by the wind.

strings.text: 辺りは闇に包まれる。そしてその闇の中、例によって紅い影が立っていた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Our surroundings become shrouded in darkness. And, as usual, in the darkness stands a crimson shadow.

strings.text: 「よう、血溜まり野郎」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Yo, puddle-of-blood bastard."

strings.text: 血の化け物は人のカタチを真似ていた。こんな風に何かの真似をすることは、今までにもあった。元が不定形だから変幻自在なのだろう。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: The blood monster mimics the shape of a human. It has done this before, taking on the likeness of something else. Being formless by nature, it can probably take whatever shape it pleases.

strings.text: 紅い影の、のっぺらぼうな顔が、にたりと嗤った。周囲を包む威圧感が指向性を得る。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: The faceless crimson silhouette curls into a grin. The pressure surrounding us focuses in a single direction.

strings.text: 「アル！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Al!"

strings.text: 「承知！」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Indeed!"

strings.text: 地面が爆ぜるのと、宙に舞い上がるのは同時。アルの姿が無数の紙束となって解け、紙吹雪となって俺の周囲を取り囲む。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The ground bursts open as we soar into the air at once. Al's form disintegrates into countless sheets of paper, encircling me in confetti of pages.

strings.text: 俺とアルの意識が繋がる。周囲を舞うアルの断片が俺の全身を包み込み、術衣を編む。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: My consciousness is linked with Al's. Her fragments dance around me, engulfing my body as they weave a magical suit.

strings.text: 俺はマギウス・スタイルに変身した。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I've transformed into Magius Style.

strings.text: 上空。月を背景に紅い影が舞う。俺が跳躍するのと同時に、こっちに向かって飛びかかってきたのだ。させはしない！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: High above, the crimson shadow dances against the backdrop of the moon. At the exact moment I leaped, it lunged straight at me. Like hell I'll let you!

strings.text: 「バルザイの偃月刀！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Scimitar of Barzai!"

strings.text: 右手を横に払う動きに合わせ、炎が一閃する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I move, sweeping my right hand sideways, and flames spring forth in unison.

strings.text: 空中で燃え広がる炎の直線より、一本の刀が生じた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: From the thinly spread line of embers, a blade emerges.

strings.text: そいつを掴み取り、落ちてくる影を斬り棄てる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Grasping it tightly, I swing upon the descending shadow.

strings.text: 手応えは水を斬る感触。刃に残る炎が、紅い影に燃え移った。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: It feels like slicing through water. The flames lingering on my blade spread to the crimson shadow.

strings.text: 紅い影は瞬く間に炎に包まれる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The shadow is engulfed in the blink of an eye.

strings.text: 「九郎！」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Kurou!"

strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Wha!?"

strings.text: 炎の中から一本の手が突き出ている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: From those flames comes a hand.

strings.text: こちらに向かって広げられた掌が、不気味に脈動していた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Pulsating eerily, it extends towards us.

strings.text: 「――ガルバ」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "--Galba."

strings.text: 掌が急速に、醜悪に膨張する。人の頭ほどの大きさに腫れ上がった掌に裂け目が生じた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The palm swiftly and horrifically expands. A rift forms in the hand, which has swelled to the size of a human head.

strings.text: ――口だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --It's a mouth.

strings.text: 口腔の奥から、唾液を滴らせた長い舌が伸びる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A long tongue stretches out from inside, dripping with saliva.

strings.text: 「ぐぅぅぅっ！？」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Guuuuh!?"

strings.text: 不覚にも舌に絡まりつかれ、身動きが取れなくなる。笑い声が爆炎の向こうから聞こえる。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: Caught off guard, I'm ensnared by the tongue and can't move a muscle. Laughter echoes from beyond the roaring flames.

strings.text: 「ははは……相変わらず乱暴だなあ。野蛮だなあ。マスター・オブ・ネクロノミコン？」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "Hahaha...... Still as vicious as ever. What a barbaric man. Am I right, Master of Necronomicon?"

strings.text: 「汝は……真逆！」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "You are...... It cannot be!"

strings.text: 舌が俺の躰を振り回す。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The tongue spins my body around.

strings.text: 充分に遠心力がついたところで離され、地面に叩きつけられる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: After it has reached sufficient centrifugal force, it releases me, slamming me against the ground.

strings.text: 「ぐはぁッ！　……ぐっ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "GUHAAH! ......Guh!"

strings.text: 痛む躰に鞭打って身を起こす。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I force my aching body to get back up.

strings.text: 爆炎が晴れた。声の主がゆっくりと地面に降り立つ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The explosion clears. The owner of that voice slowly lands on the ground.

strings.text: 俺は……俺たちはこいつを知っている。俺たちだけが知っている。だけど――！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I...... We know this guy. Only the two of us know him. And yet--!

strings.text: 「――何故だ！何故、汝が此処に居る！？」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "--Why!? Why are you here!?"

strings.text: 「何故？　何故かだと？　さて、何故だ？何故なんだろうなぁ。あまり深く考えたことはなかった。なかったよ。だがまあ良い。良いな？」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "Why? Why, you said? Well, why then? I wonder why, though. To be honest, I didn't think deeply about it. I really didn't. But I'm fine with it. It's fine, right?"

strings.text: あり得ない。何故なら俺たちの記憶にあるこいつは……失われた時間の存在だからだ！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Impossible. Because this bastard in our memories...... is an existence from the lost time!

strings.text: 「やあ、大十字九郎君にアル・アジフ。久しい……本当に久しいなぁ。前世以来か？」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "Greetings, Daijuuji Kurou, and Al Azif. It has been a while...... Truly, a long while. Not since our previous lives, perhaps?"

strings.text: 「「――ウェスパシアヌス！」」
strings.speaker: 九郎＆ちびアル
strings.translated: ""--Vespasianus!""

strings.text: 「その通り！　いやあ、嬉しいな。憶えていてくれて実に嬉しい」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "Exactly! Dear Lord, how delighted I am. I'm sincerely delighted that you remember."

strings.text: 「私はこの世界では無かったことになっているからね。実を言うととてもとても寂しい想いをしていたんだ。いやはや歳は取りたくないものだな……おおっと」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "After all, in this world, it's as though I never existed at all. To tell the truth, I was feeling terribly, terribly lonely. Good gracious, getting old really is no fun...... Oh my."

strings.text: 「はははは、ほらほらほら。見てくれたまえ。ガルバも喜んでおる」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
