strings.translated: "--Call your Deus Machina."

strings.text: 「はは……ふはははは……フハハハハハハハハハッ！」
strings.speaker: アウグストゥス
strings.translated: "Haha...... Bwahahahaha...... Bwahahahahahahahahaha!"

strings.text: 常人なら心臓が破裂するほどの鬼迫を正面から受け止め、だがアウグストゥスは哄笑っていた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Even under the pressure that will cause an average person's heart to explode, Augustus is laughing hysterically.

strings.text: 何も無い虚空に金色の光が生じて、鬼火のようにアウグストゥスの周囲を浮遊する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Golden light manifests from empty space, hovering around Augustus like will-o'-the-wisps.

strings.text: 実体を結ぶ光。それは全１３冊からなる書物。魔導書『金枝篇』だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The light takes form. It is a tome composed of 13 volumes. The Grimoire: [The Golden Bough].

strings.text: １３冊の魔導書が同時に開く。開かれた頁の向こうから溢れ出す、光の枝。黄金の枝。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: All 13 Grimoires open together. Glowing branches--or golden boughs--begin to emanate from their unfolded pages.

strings.text: 黄金の枝は無数に分岐／複雑な経路を辿りながら伸張／枝と枝は複雑に絡み合い――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Those golden boughs branch off into countless lines/ expanding as they follow a circuitous course/ branches are intertwined intricately--

strings.text: 伸びて／伸びて／伸びて／伸びて／伸びて／伸びて／伸びて／昇り／昇り／昇り／昇り／昇り／昇り／昇り／昇り／昇り／昇り／昇り／拡がり／拡がり／拡がり／拡がり／拡がり／拡がって、編み込まれてゆく金細工。精巧に組み立てられてゆく藝術。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: They lengthen/lengthen/lengthen/lengthen/lengthen/ lengthen/lengthen/ascend/ascend/ascend/ascend/ ascend/ascend/ascend/ascend/ascend/ascend/ ascend/widen/widen/widen/widen/widen/widen before weaving into a goldwork. An artwork is delicately crafted.

strings.text: 金細工はＤトゥーソードよりも巨大に成長し、その内に内包する魔力は物理的な重圧を得る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: As the goldwork surpasses D. Two-Sword in size, its magic power generates physical pressure.

strings.text: 途方もない質量の気配。ひび割れた舞台の強度は、限界に達し――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It is a sign of an incoming colossal mass. The cracked stage's integrity is at its limit--

strings.text: 「――では、我が鬼械神レガシー・オブ・ゴールドがお相手しよう！」
strings.speaker: アウグストゥス
strings.translated: "--Then, my Deus Machina, Legacy of Gold, shall be your opponent!"

strings.text: 決壊する。Ｄトゥーソードが大きく沈む。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It gives way. D. Two-Sword sinks heavily.

strings.text: 砕け散る舞台。崩れ落ちる足場。その下は底無しの闇。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The stage shatters. The footing crumbles. Beneath is infinite darkness.

strings.text: 墜ちる。総ては深淵の向こうへと。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: And they fall. Everything goes beyond the abyss.

strings.text: 「悪夢よ！　現世に感染せよ！」
strings.speaker: アウグストゥス
strings.translated: "O nightmare! Blight this transient world!"

strings.text: 黄金の衝撃。金の閃光が、闇を押し退ける。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: What follows is a golden blast. A flash of gold clears away the dark.

strings.text: 『金枝篇』が編む巨大な金細工に、命が宿ったのだ。藝術が機械として完成したのだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Inside the huge, gold-braided creation of [The Golden Bough], a life is found. An art is perfected as a machine.

strings.text: ――鬼械神レガシー・オブ・ゴールド！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --Deus Machina Legacy of Gold!

strings.text: 「うおおおおおおおおおおお！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "UOOOOOOOOOOOH!"

strings.text: 墜ちるＤトゥーソードの掌中に二挺の魔銃が顕現する。構えた銃身、閃光と氷霧を纏う。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: In the hands of the falling D. Two-Sword, a pair of magic pistols materialize. Their raised barrels are wreathed in flashes of light and icy mist.

strings.text: 「ハハハハハハハハハハハ！」
strings.speaker: アウグストゥス
strings.translated: "HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!"

strings.text: 墜ちるレガシー・オブ・ゴールドが無数の砲身を出現させる。狙う砲口、その奥に湛える破壊の光。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Countless cannons emerge from the falling Legacy of Gold. They aim their muzzles, emitting destructive light from within.

strings.text: 銃声／砲声／爆音。闇を引き裂く。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Gunshots/cannonades/explosions. Darkness is torn apart.

strings.text: 闇を墜ちて／墜ちて／堕ちた、その終着は――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: As they continue to plummet/plunge/drop into the dark, their endpoint is--

strings.text: 「馬鹿な……馬鹿なァァァ！」
strings.speaker: アウグストゥス
strings.translated: "Impossible...... Impossibleeee!"

strings.text: 雌雄は決した。致命的な一撃を受けると同時に、崩壊が始まる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The outcome is settled. As soon as the mortal blow is dealt, the disintegration process begins.

strings.text: 『黄金』の機体が急速に『錆びてゆく』。腐蝕する黄金。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The 'golden' machine is rapidly 'rusting'. Gold corrodes.

strings.text: 機体の至るところに生じた無数の黒点が、レガシー・オブ・ゴールドを虫食いの如く蝕んでゆく。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Countless black spots break out across the frame, eating away at Legacy of Gold like moth holes.

strings.text: 「――消えろ。取るに足らない、くだらぬ悪夢よ」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "--Vanish. You trifling, worthless nightmare."

strings.text: 「ぐおおあアアあアアあ――ッ！」
strings.speaker: アウグストゥス
strings.translated: "GUWOOAAAAAAARGH--!"

strings.text: 黒い灰燼となって、レガシー・オブ・ゴールドは跡形もなく崩れ、大気に散った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Legacy of Gold crumbles without leaving any trace, scattering into the air as black ashes.

strings.text: 大広間には勝者――デモンベイン・トゥーソードだけが残る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Only the victor--Demonbane Two-Sword--remains in the main hall.

strings.text: 「此処は――」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "This is--"

strings.text: 九朔は警戒を解かず、周囲の状況を再確認する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Kuzaku stays alert and double checks his surroundings.

strings.text: 広大な血の海。おぞましく脈動する肉の壁。そして鬼械神の全長を優に超える、巨大な心臓――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A vast sea of blood. Walls of flesh pulsating repulsively. And a titanic heart far exceeding the full height of a Deus Machina--

strings.text: 此処はかつて『Ｃ計画』の依城だった『夢幻心母』の中枢部。デモンベインがアンチクロスと最後の死闘を演じた舞台だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: This place is the central unit of the [Illusory Heart Mother], which previously served as the vessel of the [C Project]. Furthermore, it is the stage where Demonbane and the Anticross engaged in their final battle.

strings.text: 「如何にもアナザーブラッド好みの下劣な舞台だ」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "This detestable setting really suits Another Blood."

strings.text: この大空間に、Ｄトゥーソード以外の気配は無い。脈打つ心臓の鼓動が、爆音のように大気を震わせる。だが、九朔は気付いていた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Only D. Two-Sword's presence exists in this vast space. Like an explosion, the pulsing of the heart sets the air trembling. Yet Kuzaku has already noticed it.

strings.text: 耳を劈くような鼓動の只中、しかし血の海面は細波一つ立つことがない。凍りついているかの如く、静まり返っている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Even amidst the ear-splitting heartbeats, not a single ripple stirs upon the sea of blood. It lies dead still, as if frozen solid.

strings.text: 身構えるＤトゥーソード。機神の双眸が物質／霊質すべての動きを油断なく読み取る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: D. Two-Sword braces itself. The Machine God's eyes read every movement while on its guard, be it material/spiritual.

strings.text: 不動のまま、時間だけが流れてゆく。ただ心臓の鼓動だけが、空間を震わせ――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: As it stands still, only time continues to pass by. What causes space to quiver is nothing but the pounding of the heart--

strings.text: 強大な重圧感が、Ｄトゥーソードに圧し掛かる。高濃度の瘴気に中てられ、錯乱する魔術回路。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A tremendous pressure weighs on D. Two-Sword. Caught in the dense miasma, its magic circuits are thrown into disarray.

strings.text: 九朔の対応は早い。モニターを埋め尽くす警告は無視。悲鳴を上げる回路に、次々と術式を送り込み、無理矢理に制御を取り戻す。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Kuzaku reacts instantly. Ignoring the warnings filling the monitor, he feeds spell formula after spell formula into the screaming circuits, forcibly wresting back control.

strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "--Is it coming?!"

strings.text: 前方を睨みつける九朔。しかし其処にはやはり、何ものも存在しない――否。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Kuzaku glares ahead. Yet in the end, there is nothing there--no.

strings.text: 細波一つ立たない、鏡面のような水面。この広大な心臓の間を逆様に映す紅の鏡は、実体の無い怪異を暴き、映し出す。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The water surface is as smooth as a mirror, without a single ripple. The crimson mirror reflects the enormous heart chamber upside down, projecting and revealing an incorporeal, otherworldly entity.

strings.text: 鏡の向こう。逆様の世界。逆様のＤトゥーソード。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Beyond the reflection. An upside-down world. A reversed D. Two-Sword.

strings.text: そして――対峙する紅の巨影。――逆様の鬼械神。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Next--a crimson giant shade faces off against it. --An inverted Deus Machina.

strings.text: 瞬間、世界が反転する。虚は実に。実は虚に。移り変わり、映り変わる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: In an instant, the world turns over. Fiction becomes reality. Reality becomes fiction. It shifts and changes.

strings.text: 実体を結ぶ幻影。鏡の国より顕れ出でた幻想。機械仕掛けの悪夢――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Illusion takes physical form. Through the looking-glass, fantasy emerges. A Clockwork Nightmare--

strings.text: 「……リベル・レギス！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "......Liber Legis!"

strings.text: Ｄトゥーソードの前に、紅の鬼械神が立ちはだかる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The crimson Deus Machina stands before D. Two-Sword.

strings.text: 「我が城へようこそ。勇猛果敢たる騎士殿」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "I welcome you to my castle. O brave and bold Sir Knight."

strings.text: 少年の声は幾重にも木霊して響き渡った。大気を伝導するのではなく、霊気を伝導する音。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The boy's voice rings out across the chamber, echoing in layers. A sound transmitted not through the air, but through spiritual energy.

strings.text: 精神に直接語りかけてくるような聲だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It is a voice that speaks directly to the mind.

strings.text: 紅の鬼械神を駆る金色の獣。騎士の少年は、世界の天敵の名を、魂で識っている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A voice that belongs to the Golden Beast, who pilots the crimson Deus Machina. The young Knight knows the identity of the world's archenemy in his soul.

strings.text: 「……大導師マスターテリオン」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "......Grand Master, Master Therion."

strings.text: 「未だ存在し得ぬ英雄にまで、我が名が知れ渡っているとは……光栄なことだ」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "My, what an honor...... to think that my name is well-known even to a hero who is yet to exist."

strings.text: 「……無限螺旋の戦いは、我が血にも記されている。だがな、獣よ。存在し得ぬのは貴様だ」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "......The battle of the Infinite Spiral is also recorded in my blood. But the one who shouldn't exist is you, Beast."

strings.text: 両掌に顕れる双剣。その切っ先をリベル・レギスに向けて、突きつける。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Twin swords manifest in both hands. Their tips are pointed towards Liber Legis.

strings.text: 九朔の鬼迫は圧迫感をもって、大広間の空気を震撼させる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Kuzaku's aura asserts enough pressure to make the air in the main hall tremble.

strings.text: 「疾く去ね。単なる悪夢に用は無い」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Begone at once. I have no business with a mere nightmare."

strings.text: 「はは……手厳しいな。しかしそれは此方の台詞でもある……」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Haha...... such a no-nonsense attitude. But that's my line too......"

strings.text: マスターテリオンの気配が変わった。冷たく、鋭く突き刺さる威圧感。心臓を鷲掴みにされるような怖気を感じる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Master Therion's presence changes. It becomes a cold, sharp, piercing pressure. There is a sense of dread, as if a hand is clutching one's heart.

strings.text: 「疾く去ね。貴公には露ほどの興味も無い。余と渡り合えるのは唯一、大十字九郎とアル・アジフ――あのふたりが駆るデモンベインのみぞ」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Begone at once. I have not the slightest interest in you. The only one worthy of crossing blades with me is Daijuuji Kurou and Al Azif--the Demonbane piloted by those two alone."

strings.text: 二つの鬼迫は不可視の圧力となって奔り、両機の中央で衝突した。爆ぜる紅の海面／天井を衝く血柱／降り注ぐ血の豪雨／充満する紅の霧。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Both fighting spirits clash, creating an invisible pressure between the two machines. The sea of crimson erupts/bloody pillars stab the ceiling/a torrent of blood rains down/the air is thick with a crimson mist.

strings.text: 「……先程の雑兵といい、『ブラックロッジ』の連中はよほど囀るのが好きと見える。啼かなければ、撃たれずに済んだものを！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "......Just like that small fry earlier, I see you lot from [Black Lodge] really enjoy running your mouths. Perhaps if the last one hadn't been squawking, he wouldn't have been gunned down!"

strings.text: 今にも飛びかからんばかりのＤトゥーソード。一触即発の空気。だがリベル・レギスは身構える素振りすら見せない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: D. Two-Sword looks poised to strike at any moment. The atmosphere is thick with tension. However, Liber Legis displays not a hint of readiness.

strings.text: むしろ聴こえてくるマスターテリオンの声は、怯える小動物を宥めすかすように、酷く優しい。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: On the contrary, Master Therion's voice is terribly gentle, as if he is soothing a frightened small animal.

strings.text: 「虚勢を張る必要はない。貴公の脆さ――ひび割れて、剥き出しな生身の魂。この獣にはちゃんとお見通しよ」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "There is no need for bravado. Your fragility--your cracked, exposed, naked soul--this Beast sees right through it all."

strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "What nonsense are you......!"

strings.text: 「哀しいな。微笑ましいな――騎士道を謳ったところで、魂は甲冑で鎧えない」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "How sorrowful. How heartwarming--you extol your chivalry, yet your soul isn't clad in steel."

strings.text: 「……もう良い。貴様はくだらぬ夢のまま散り逝け」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "......Enough. Scatter and perish as the worthless dream you are."

strings.text: 刹那、リベル・レギスの目の前で空間が捩れ、歪んだ。断鎖術式の発動を意味する超常現象。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: In an instant, space twists and distorts in front of Liber Legis. A paranormal phenomenon, signaling the activation of the Chain-Severing System.

strings.text: Ｄトゥーソードの姿が掻き消えた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: D. Two-Sword's figure vanishes into thin air.

strings.text: 次の刹那。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The next instant.

strings.text: Ｄトゥーソードはリベル・レギスの眼前に現れ、双剣の刃は紅の機体に触れていた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: D. Two-Sword reappears before Liber Legis, its twin blades making contact with the crimson machine.

strings.text: 致命的な一撃。九朔は勝利を確信する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A fatal blow. Kuzaku is certain of his victory.

strings.text: リベル・レギスの機影を見失う。はたして双剣は虚しく空を切った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: He loses sight of Liber Legis. Sure enough, the twin swords slice through empty air in vain.

strings.text: 「馬鹿な」／「何処だ」という驚愕／焦燥が光の速度で脳裏を駆ける。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: "Impossible!"/"Where is he?" The shock/unease flashes through his mind at the speed of light.

strings.text: 感情／思考を瞬時に切り離し、索敵を――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: He severs emotion/thought in a split second to search for the enemy--

strings.text: 「闘争本能を制御出来ていないな……それでは猪と何ら変わらん」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "You can't even control your fighting instinct...... You are no different than a wild boar."

strings.text: 背筋を灼く、冷たい戦慄。断鎖術式がもたらす超機動よりも迅く、リベル・レギスはＤトゥーソードの背後を取っていた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A freezing shiver burns down his spine. Liber Legis has gotten behind D. Two-Sword, faster than the hypermobility granted by the Chain-Severing System.

strings.text: 「いつの間に……！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "When did you......!?"

strings.text: 「ＡＢＲＡＨＡＤＡＢＲＡ」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "ABRAHADABRA!"

strings.text: 雷光が九朔の視界を白く灼き、Ｄトゥーソードの魔術回路を灼く。発狂する機体。増殖する損傷。コクピットのあちこちが爆発する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A flash of lightning scorches Kuzaku's vision white and sears D. Two-Sword's magic circuits. The machine goes mad. Damage multiplies. Explosions erupt throughout the cockpit.

strings.text: 「ぐああああああああああ！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "GUAAAAAAAAAARGH!"

strings.text: くずおれるＤトゥーソード。だが強引な機体制御によって、何とか持ち堪える。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: D. Two-Sword collapses. However, it somehow manages to endure, thanks to forceful control of the machine.

strings.text: 「ぐぅっ……お、おのれ……ッ！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Guuh...... D-Damn you......!"

strings.text: 体勢を立て直す間も惜しみ、斬撃を繰り出す。リベル・レギスは飛び退いて、それを躱す。重力を無視したかのような跳躍。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: He unleashes a slash without taking a moment to regain his footing. Liber Legis leaps back to evade it. A leap that seemingly defies gravity.

strings.text: 「うおおおおおおおおおお！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "UOOOOOOOOOOH!"

strings.text: 再び脚部シールドのエネルギーを爆裂させ、リベル・レギスに迫るＤトゥーソード。神速の突撃から繋ぐ、神速の剣撃。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Once again, D. Two-Sword blasts the energy of its leg shields, closing in on Liber Legis. A lightning-fast charge followed up with lightning-fast swordplay.

strings.text: 「弱過ぎる！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Too weak!"

strings.text: 二つの剣閃を縫って迅る拳閃。Ｄトゥーソードの装甲が穿たれ、捩れ、拉げた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A darting fist flashes and weaves through the twin sword strikes. D. Two-sword's armor is punctured, warped and sundered.

strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Gah...... Hah!"

strings.text: カウンターとして放たれたリベル・レギスの拳は、間合いの不利をものともせず、Ｄトゥーソードを吹き飛ばした。５０メートルの巨大な鋼鉄が、軽々と宙を舞う。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Liber Legis' fist unleashed a counter and sent D. Two-Sword flying, undeterred by the handicap in reach. The fifty-meter giant of steel is hurled effortlessly through the air.

strings.text: 「ぐあああああああ！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "GUAAAAAAAH!"

strings.text: 高層ビルに匹敵する高さの水柱が盛大に迸る。即座に体勢を立て直す九朔。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A skyscraper-high column of water violently surges forth. Kuzaku immediately regains his footing.

strings.text: しかし自分の操縦に、Ｄトゥーソードが付いて来れない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: But D. Two-Sword cannot keep up with his handling.

strings.text: 動くたびに新たな警告が増え、機体の損害を訴えてくる。ダメージは思いのほか深刻だった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Each move he took resulted in new errors appearing, warning of damage to the machine. The damage is far more severe than he imagined.

strings.text: 不様に足掻くＤトゥーソードを見下ろし、マスターテリオンは激昂する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Master Therion becomes furious at the sight of D. Two-Sword's pitiful struggle below.

strings.text: 「弱過ぎるぞ、英雄狂！　その機体、同じデモンベインとは到底思えぬ！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Far too weak, hero maniac! That machine doesn't seem like the same Demonbane at all!"

strings.text: 「～～～～ッッ！貴様ァァァァァァァ――！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "~~~~! YOU BASTAAAAAAAARD--!"

strings.text: ……比較したな。またしても我を――我を、大十字九郎と比較したな！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: ......I was compared. Again, I was compared--to Daijuuji Kurou!

strings.text: 冥く烈しい怒りが、九朔の認識を灼き尽くし、塗り潰す。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A dark, violent rage consumes and clouds Kuzaku's judgment.

strings.text: ――劣るはずがない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --There's no way I can be inferior.

strings.text: この我と、このデモンベインが――鬼械神を駆ることに特化した血を持つ我と、強化を繰り返し進化したデモンベインが、大十字九郎が操る旧型などに！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: How could I and this Demonbane--I, who carry blood specialized for piloting a Deus Machina, and a Demonbane evolved through repeated upgrades--possibly be inferior to an outdated model piloted by Daijuuji Kurou?!

strings.text: 「巫山戯るなぁぁぁ――ッ！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "DON'T SCREW WITH MEEEE--!"

strings.text: 双剣が魔術文字となって解けた。魔術文字は新たに組み合わさり、異なる文字列を形成する。編み上げられてゆく術式。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The twin swords break down into magic symbols. The magic symbols then recombine to form a different sequence. A spell is being woven.

strings.text: 剣に代わって、二挺魔銃がその両手に握られた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Instead of swords, two magic guns are grasped in both hands.

strings.text: ――証明してやる。我こそがデモンベインの騎手であることを。殺意を以って、証明してやろう！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --I will show you. I am the true pilot of Demonbane. I shall prove it with my murderous impulse!

strings.text: ――滅ぼしてやる！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --Prepare for your annihilation!

strings.text: 一瞬で両銃の弾倉が空になる。リベル・レギスを襲う銃弾の嵐。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The magazines in both guns are emptied in an instant. A storm of bullets assaults Liber Legis.

strings.text: リベル・レギスは防禦陣が展開、銃弾を防ぐ。Ｄトゥーソードは攻撃の手を休めない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Liber Legis casts a protective barrier around itself to repel the gunfire. D. Two-Sword continues its relentless onslaught.

strings.text: 新たなカードリッジ／スピードローダーを宙に招喚し、神懸かった速度でそれらを装填する。途絶えることのない銃撃。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It summons new cartridges/speed loaders into the air, loading them with godlike speed. An unending wave of gunfire.

strings.text: 「神獣形態！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Divine Beast Form!"

strings.text: 二つの銃口が兇暴な力を湛える。神獣弾――旧支配者の神力を降ろす、二挺魔銃の切り札。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The two gun barrels brim with ferocious might. Divine Beast shells--the trump card of the twin magic pistols, which house the divinity of the Great Old Ones.

strings.text: 引鉄を引くと同時に、強大な威力が解き放たれる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Immense force is unleashed the moment their triggers are pulled.

strings.text: 閃光の奔流。神力の乱流。滅びを纏って翔ける二柱の獣。旧支配者クトゥグア。旧支配者イタクァ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A torrent of blinding light. A turbulent surge of divine energy. Clad in destruction, two colossal beasts soar through the air. Great Old One Cthugha. Great Old One Ithaqua.

strings.text: その圧倒的な存在力の顕現。神獣が紅の鬼械神に襲いかかる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Manifestations of their overwhelming presence. The Divine Beasts pounce on the crimson Deus Machina.

strings.text: 爆ぜる神力の中心。総てを噛み砕く白い闇の中心であり、総てを嘗め尽くす黒い光の中心。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Divine energy explodes at the center. It is the central point of the all-consuming white darkness, and the all-encompassing black light.

strings.text: 旧支配者の力が生み出す、破滅の空間。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The might of the Great Old Ones gives birth to the space of ruination.

strings.text: その只中に、リベル・レギスは確かに存在する。腐蝕し、沸騰する紅の超鋼。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: In the heart of it all, Liber Legis undeniably stands. Crimson super steel corrodes and seethes red-hot.

strings.text: だが、そこまでだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: However, that is as far as it goes.

strings.text: クトゥグア／イタクァの神獣形態を以ってしても、この鬼械神を滅ぼすことは不可能――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Even the Divine Beast Forms of Cthugha/Ithaqua are nowhere near enough to destroy this Deus Machina--

strings.text: だが、この爆『神』地に自ら飛び込む機影がある。デモンベイン・トゥーソード。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Nevertheless, the silhouette of a machine is diving towards this 'divine' hypocenter. Demonbane Two-Sword.

strings.text: その右掌には更なる破滅――絶対否定空間を編み上げる無限熱量を宿して、駆ける／翔ける。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Residing within its right palm is even further annihilation--infinite heat, creating a space of absolute negation as it rushes/soars.

strings.text: 「巫山戯るな！」
strings.speaker: マスターテリオン
strings.translated: "Don't mock me!"

strings.text: 心臓の間に、再び静寂が訪れる。紅の海面に波紋を広げて立つのは、紅の機体。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Silence returns to the heart chamber. The crimson machine stands on the red sea, spreading ripples across its surface.

strings.text: リベル・レギスは覇王の威厳で、討ち取った敵を見下ろし、見下している。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Liber Legis looks down on its slain enemy with the majesty of a conquering king, regarding them with contempt.

strings.text: 「こんな……はずは……」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "This...... cannot be......"

strings.text: リベル・レギスの足元。Ｄトゥーソードが血の海に、ゆっくりと沈んでゆく。機体は絶対零度の手刀に断たれ、半身が瘴滅していた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: At Liber Legis' feet. D. Two-Sword is gradually sinking into the sea of blood. Half of it had been annihilated; the machine was severed by a hand-blade of absolute zero.

strings.text: 「ぐああああああああ！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "GUAAAAAAAAH!"

strings.text: リベル・レギスの左掌から放たれる雷撃が、Ｄトゥーソードを撃つ。機体が爆ぜ、水銀の血が飛び散る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A lightning bolt from Liber Legis' left palm strikes D. Two-Sword. The machine bursts apart, splattering mercury blood everywhere.

strings.text: Ｄトゥソードに雷撃を浴びせながら、マスターテリオンは叫ぶ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: As he showers D. Two-Sword with lightning, Master Therion roars.

strings.text: 「脆い脆い脆い脆い脆いッ！こんなものが……こんなくだらん代物が、デモンベインであってたまるものか！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Feeble, feeble, feeble, feeble, so utterly feeble! How can something...... How can something so wretched be Demonbane!?"

strings.text: 「貴様……ッ」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Bastard......"

strings.text: 「三位一体に到らぬデモンベインに……何の意味がある！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "A Demonbane that fails to reach the Trinity...... What's even the point!?"

strings.text: 「がああああああああああああ！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "GAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!"

strings.text: さらに強力な雷撃が、Ｄトゥーソードを襲う。爆ぜる爆ぜる爆ぜる。わずかに生き残っていた魔術回路が次々と死滅し、ついには沈黙した。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: An even fiercer bolt of lightning strikes D. Two-Sword. It explodes, shatters, and bursts open. One after another, its dwindling magic circuits cease to function before falling silent.

strings.text: 闇に包まれたコクピット。自身も雷撃を受け、九朔は血を吐きながら、苦痛に喘ぐ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Darkness shrouds the cockpit. Having been struck by lightning himself, Kuzaku retches up blood while gasping in pain.

strings.text: 「クソッ……タレ……！」
strings.speaker: 九朔

strings.text: 「……終わりだ」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "......It's over."

strings.text: 頭上に浮かぶ、十字架の剣。それは真っ直ぐにＤトゥーソードを貫き、剣に宿る魔力は解き放たれ、爆裂し――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A cross-shaped sword hangs above its head. It stabs right through D. Two-Sword, unleashing the magic power dwelling in the sword, leading to a detonation--

strings.text: 心臓の間には、紅の鬼械神だけが残された。Ｄトゥーソードの姿は無い。全ては紅く冥い海の底へ呑み込まれていった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Only the crimson Deus Machina is left in the heart chamber. D. Two-Sword is nowhere to be found. Everything was swallowed up into the murky depths of the crimson sea.

strings.text: 「……つまらん……実につまらん」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "......Boring...... Utterly boring."

strings.text: 「こんな紛い物では、我が飢餓は癒されぬ……」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Such a cheap imitation cannot ease my hunger......"

strings.text: 金色の瞳が遠い何処かを、凝っと見つめている。一切の光を映さない金色の闇――その奥に宿るのは憎しみか、焦がれか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: His golden eyes are fixated on somewhere far away. A golden darkness, completely devoid of light--does hatred or a deep longing lie within them?

strings.text: 恐らくはそのどちらでもあり、どちらでもない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It could be both, or it could be neither.

strings.text: 「来い……大十字九郎……アル・アジフ……デモンベイン！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Come forth...... Daijuuji Kurou...... Al Azif...... Demonbane!"

strings.text: 「貴様らだけが――三位一体の剣だけが、余を……」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Only you--only the Sword of Trinity can grant me......"

strings.text: 「……で、ここは何処だ？」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "......So, where the heck are we?"

strings.text: 『夢幻心母』に突入した次の瞬間、俺たちはこの異質な空間の中にいた。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: After we stormed into the [Illusory Heart Mother], we found ourselves in this strange space.

strings.text: 「だいたいの想像はつくが」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "I have a rough idea."

strings.text: 「ああ。血液言語版だな」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Yeah. It's the Blood Language Edition, right?"

strings.text: アナザーブラッドが創る悪夢の空間。さすがに慣れてきた。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: This place is a nightmarish dimension created by Another Blood. Still, we've gotten used to it.

strings.text: 「バルザイの偃月刀を使う」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Let's use the Scimitar of Barzai."

strings.text: 爆炎を伴って、バルザイの偃月刀が招喚される。刀身に浮かび上がる、魔術紋様。偃月刀は宙に静止した状態のまま、独りでに回転を始めた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The Scimitar of Barzai is summoned with a flare. A magical crest emerges on its blade. The Scimitar remains stationary in mid-air before starting to spin by itself.

strings.text: 「導いてもらおう」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Let us have it guide us."

strings.text: 横回転から縦回転に。やがて剣先を真下に向け、急降下する。剣閃の軌跡が、淡い光となって残留する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Its rotation changes from horizontal to vertical. Soon, it points its tip directly below and takes a nosedive. The blade leaves behind a flash of faint light.

strings.text: 「道案内か」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Dowsing, huh?"

strings.text: 偃月刀の導きに従い、歪な空間を降ってゆく。紅い霧が、重く重くデモンベインに纏わりつく。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: Following the Scimitar's guidance, we glide down through the warped space. The dense bloody mist clings heavily to Demonbane.

strings.text: 降れば降るほど、紅い霧は濃度を増す。霧は血に。血は塊に。気付けば俺たちは、紅い泥濘の中に潜っていた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The lower we descend, the thicker the bloody mist becomes. Mist turns into blood. Blood turns into clots. The next thing I knew, we had been submerged in a reddish mud.

strings.text: 「ええい！鬱陶しいな、クソ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Aiiee! So irritating, shit!"

strings.text: 「悪夢から抜けるぞ」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "We are breaking out of this nightmare!"

strings.text: 視界が開ける。泥濘の中から飛び出したデモンベインは、宙に躍り出た。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Our view clears. Demonbane leaps out of the muddy space and springs into the air.

strings.text: 地表が迫る。シャンタクを操り、ゆっくりと降り立つ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The ground is getting closer. Maneuvering Shantak, we slowly make our landing.

strings.text: 「これは……」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "This is......"

strings.text: 周囲を見渡す。そこは無機物と有機物が絡まり合って組み上げられた空間だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: We survey our surroundings. Ahead of us is a chamber, mixed and blended with inorganic and organic compounds.

strings.text: 壁も床も天井も、おぞましく脈打つ肉に埋もれている。臓物と配管が複雑に絡まり合い、不気味なオブジェを構築していた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The walls, the floor, and even the ceiling are buried in the pulsing, repulsive flesh. Organs and pipes entwine in a complex manner, forming a horrifying object.

strings.text: この光景には見覚えがある。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I feel like I've seen this sight before.

strings.text: 「『夢幻心母』の内部か」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "So this is the [Illusory Heart Mother]'s interior?"

strings.text: 「……また『受肉』しているのか？」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "......Could it be an [Incarnation] again?"

strings.text: 万魔殿『夢幻心母』は、そもそも邪神を降ろすための器だった。まさか今度も……？
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: Originally, this Pandemonium, the [Illusory Heart Mother], was a vessel to host the Evil God. Don't tell me this time too......?

strings.text: 「血液言語版に、そこまでの魔力はあるまい。書割の様なものだ――悪夢の舞台を演出するためのな」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "The Blood Language Edition doesn't possess that much magic power. This is to set up the nightmare stage--like a backdrop."

strings.text: 「趣味が悪ィぜ……ったく」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Talk about poor taste...... Sheesh."

strings.text: 「此処に居るのは我等だけのようだ」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Seems like we're the only ones here."

strings.text: 周囲にアイオーンもアンブロシウスも見当たらない。完全にはぐれてしまったようだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Neither Aeon nor Ambrosius is anywhere to be seen. Looks like we've been completely separated.

strings.text: 「さっきのは俺たちを分断するための罠か……チクショウ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "So earlier was a trap to divide us......? Damn it."

strings.text: 「その通りよ……これなら誰の邪魔も入らないでしょ？」
strings.speaker: ティベリウス
strings.translated: "Yup...... That way, nobody will stick their nose in our business, right?"

strings.text: 「来るぞ！」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "They're coming!"

strings.text: 何処からともなく蟲の羽音が聴こえてくる。生理的な嫌悪感を掻き立てられる、極めて不快な羽音だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: From out of nowhere, the buzzing of insects reaches our ears. It is an extremely unpleasant droning sound that stirs a visceral sense of revulsion.

strings.text: デモンベインの前方に黒い霧が生じる。霧の正体は幾万、幾億に及ぶ蝿の群れだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Black fog appears ahead of Demonbane. The true nature of this fog is a swarm of flies, reaching tens of thousands, if not hundreds of millions.

strings.text: 蝿の群れが闇黒の魔法陣を描く。生じる邪悪で強大な魔力の気配。この吐き気をもよおす存在感――間違いない！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The swarm of flies forms a dark magic circle. A sign of evil but mighty magic power emerges. This nauseating presence--it's definitely him!

strings.text: 「ティベリウス！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Tiberius!"

strings.text: 「ベルゼビュート！　暴食せよ！」
strings.speaker: ティベリウス
strings.translated: "Belzebuth! Consume them!"

strings.text: 噴き出す瘴気が、周囲の肉塊を一瞬で腐敗させる。爛れ落ちる腐肉の中心、蝿の群れを依代として一体の鬼械神が顕現した。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Miasma gushes out, causing the surrounding lump of meat to decompose in an instant. In the center of the crumbling, decaying flesh, a Deus Machina manifests with the swarm of flies as its vessel.

strings.text: 『妖蛆の秘密』が招喚する鬼械神、ベルゼビュート。そしてそれを駆るのはアンチクロスの一人、不死の魔術師ティベリウス。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Belzebuth, a Deus Machina summoned by [De Vermis Mysteriis]. And its pilot is the undead sorcerer, as well as one of the Anticross, Tiberius.

strings.text: 「はぁ～い、元気にしてたぁん？九郎ちゃん、アルちゃあぁん☆」
strings.speaker: ティベリウス
strings.translated: "Hey~, how are you doin' my love? Little Kurou, little Al ☆."

strings.text: 「……姫さんから聞いてるぜ。相変わらず性根が腐ってるらしいな、ゾンビ野郎！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "......I heard everything from the Princess. Your rotten nature never changes, does it? You zombie piece of shit!"

strings.text: デモンベインに潰されたはずだが、やはりその程度では死なないか。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: Demonbane should have turned him flat as a pancake already, but looks like it's still not enough to obliterate him.

strings.text: しぶとくてウザくて臭くて面倒なヤツだ。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: Not only is this guy stubborn, irritating, and smells like shit, but he's also a pain in the neck.

strings.text: 「瑠璃お嬢ちゃまとは、もっと思い出話に花を咲かせたかったんだけど……まあ、良いわ。アタシの本命はアンタたちだもの」
strings.speaker: ティベリウス
strings.translated: "I was goin' to have a nice, long chat with little Miss Ruri about our old times...... but meh, whatever. You two are my favorites."

strings.text: ティベリウスの声のトーンが変わる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: There is a change in the tone of Tiberius' voice.

strings.text: 憤怒、憎悪、怨嗟――様々な負の感情が瘴気となって噴き出し、ベルゼビュートを包んでいく。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Anger, loathing, resentment--all kinds of negative emotions erupt as miasma, enveloping Belzebuth.

strings.text: 「忘れないわ……忘れないわよ、アンタたちに滅ぼされたときの恐怖と絶望……甦ってからずっとずっと、アンタたちのことばかり考えてたの」
strings.speaker: ティベリウス
strings.translated: "I won't forget...... I'll never forget my fear and despair of that moment, when I was annihilated by your hands...... Since I returned, you're all I've ever thought about."

strings.text: 防禦陣を展開し、瘴気の爆風を防ぐ。デモンベインの装甲の一部がわずかに腐蝕した。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: We put on a defensive field to block the miasma blast. A part of Demonbane's armor erodes slightly.

strings.text: 「そうよ……アンタたちを滅ぼすことばかり考えてたわ……！思い知らせてあげる、デモンベイン。アタシの恐怖を知りなさいッ！」
strings.speaker: ティベリウス
strings.translated: "Oh, yes...... My only obsession is your demise......! I'll make you pay, Demonbane. Know my fear!"

strings.text: 「吠えるな、悪夢！汝はもはや死人ですらない。存在しないのだ！我等が滅ぼした！」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "Quit howling, nightmare! You're not even a dead man! You do not exist! We have destroyed you!"

strings.text: 「今ここに存在するアタシは、確かな憎悪よ！殺してなんかあげないわ……生きたまま腐らせて、蛆どもの餌にしてくれるッッ！」
strings.speaker: ティベリウス
strings.translated: "The 'me' that exists here and now is absolute hatred! I'm not gonna kill you or anything...... Instead, I'll leave you to rot alive and feed you to my maggots!"

strings.text: 「眼中にねえんだよボケが！もう一回滅びてこい、この精神的ブラクラ野郎！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Like we even give a shit about you, idiot! Go perish all over again, you walking mental hazard!"

strings.text: 「アタシは……不死身……この程度で滅びるはずが……」
strings.speaker: ティベリウス
strings.translated: "I am...... immortal...... I won't perish by something of this level......"

strings.text: 「く、崩れる……？何故……何故なの……ッ？アタシは……アタシはァァッ！」
strings.speaker: ティベリウス
strings.translated: "C-Crumbling......? How...... How could it be......? I...... I aaam!"

strings.text: 「告げたはずだ。汝は死人ですらない、単なる悪夢なのだと」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "I told you. You're not even a dead man, you're merely a nightmare."

strings.text: 「ああああアアアアアああああぁぁぁぁ……ァァァァ……」
strings.speaker: ティベリウス
strings.translated: "Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaargh...... Aaaah......"

strings.text: ベルゼビュートの機体が、紅い霧となって崩れてゆく。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Belzebuth's frame breaks down into a crimson mist.

strings.text: 何も残らない。夢はただ夢と散り逝くだけだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Nothing remains. Dreams fade away, as they are meant to.

strings.text: 「何とか倒したが……シュリュズベリイ先生やアズラッドたちは無事かな？」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Finally got rid of him...... Think Professor Shrewsbury, Azrad, and the others are alright?"

strings.text: 「信じるしかあるまい。今はただ先に進むだけだ」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "We have to put our faith in them. For now, let's just move forward."

strings.text: 「ああ……分かった」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Yeah...... I got it."

strings.text: アナザーブラッドの罠により、分断された三体の鬼械神。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Due to Another Blood's trap, the three Deus Machina are separated.

strings.text: しかし自身もまた夢の存在であるアズラッドに、アナザーブラッドの生み出した空間は通用しない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: However, this space created by Another Blood has no effect on Azrad, whose existence is also a dream.

strings.text: 迷うことなく、『夢幻心母』の最深部へと向かう。はぐれた二体の心配はまったくしていない様子だった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Without hesitation, he proceeds to the innermost part of the [Illusory Heart Mother]. The absence of the other two does not seem to bother him in the least.

strings.speaker: アズラッド
strings.translated: "--An enemy?"

strings.text: 「如何にも。拙者はティトゥス。『黒き聖域』の信徒にして『逆十字』の末席に名を連ねる者也」
strings.speaker: ティトゥス
strings.translated: "Indeed. I am Titus, a follower of [Black Lodge] and he who earned the lowest seat of the [Anticross]."

strings.text: ――鬼械神、皇餓。『屍食教典儀』によって招喚される、機神にして剣鬼。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --Deus Machina Ogre. Summoned by [Cultes des Ghoules], it is a Machine God and a Sword Demon.

strings.text: 「……とは言っても、正しくはその幻影に過ぎぬがな。お主と同じように」
strings.speaker: ティトゥス
strings.translated: "......Though I stated it, to be frank, I'm nothing but a phantom. Just like you."

strings.text: 「妄執に囚われ、今一度の死合に望んだものの、この身は二度敗れ去った。雌雄が決した今、この世に留まる理由も無いが――」
strings.speaker: ティトゥス
strings.translated: "My delusion consumed me and I craved for another bloody duel, and yet I was defeated twice. Now that the score is settled, I see no reason to stay in this world, but--"

strings.text: 「拙者を喚んだ者はそうは考えていないらしい」
strings.speaker: ティトゥス
strings.translated: "Apparently the individual who summoned me doesn't think so."

strings.text: 「『ネクロノミコン血液言語版』か」
strings.speaker: アズラッド
strings.translated: "You mean the [Necronomicon Blood Language Edition]?"

strings.text: 「此処から先へ進みたければ、拙者を斃してゆけ――と、つまりはそういうことだ」
strings.speaker: ティトゥス
strings.translated: "If you wish to go further beyond this point, you must destroy me-- that's all I wanted to say."

strings.text: 「退く気は無いようだな」
strings.speaker: アズラッド
strings.translated: "I presume you don't intend to withdraw."

strings.text: 「はは……宮仕えの悲しいところだ。それに――強者との戦いを拒む道理も無い」
strings.speaker: ティトゥス
strings.translated: "Haha...... That's the miserable part of serving others. Besides--there's no reason for me to refuse to fight such a strong opponent."

strings.text: 「そうか。ならば、撃ち滅ぼすのみ」
strings.speaker: アズラッド
strings.translated: "Is that so? Then I'll just have to eradicate you."

strings.text: 「参れ。此度の死合には、良い剣風が吹きそうだ」
strings.speaker: ティトゥス
strings.translated: "Come. Looks like the wind is in our favor for this death match."

strings.text: 致命的な一撃が皇餓を断つ／絶つ。機体全体から焔の如く噴き出る、紅い霧。皇餓が崩れてゆく。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A fatal blow ends/severs Ogre. Crimson mist spouts out of the entire machine's frame like flames. Ogre begins to collapse.

strings.text: 「……これで、良い」
strings.speaker: ティトゥス
strings.translated: "......This is fine."

strings.text: 安堵ともつかぬ、諦念ともつかぬ、弱々しい呟き。ティトゥスの声は、アズラッドに届いただろうか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A weak murmur that is neither relief nor resignation leaks out of his mouth. Has Titus' voice reached Azrad?

strings.text: 「さらばだ。悪夢とはいえ――なかなかに愉しかったぞ」
strings.speaker: ティトゥス
strings.translated: "Farewell. Even though it was a nightmare--I had quite a good time."

strings.text: それはアズラッドに向けた言葉なのか、それともウィンフィールドに向けた言葉なのか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Were his words addressed to Azrad, or did he mean them for Winfield?

strings.text: 不敵な笑みを浮かべた貌の半分は、血煙となって気化していた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: With a daring smile on half of his face, he melts into a spray of blood.

strings.text: やがて何もかもが崩れ去る。何処から吹くとも知れぬ風が、血の霧を運び去ってゆく。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Soon, everything crumbles away. A wind blows from no one knows where, taking the bloody mist along with it.

strings.text: そうだ。夢はただ夢と散り逝くだけだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: That's right. Dreams fade away, as they are meant to.

strings.text: 散り逝く皇餓を見届け、アズラッドは何を想うか。ティトゥスと同じく、夢幻の存在に過ぎないアズラッドは何を想うのか――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: What crossed Azrad's mind when he was watching the dying Ogre? Similar to Titus, what is Azrad, who is nothing but a fantasy being, thinking about--?

strings.text: 「罠を抜けたよ、ダディ」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "We escaped the trap, Daddy."

strings.text: 「ああ……ここが要塞内部か」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Ah...... So this is the interior of the fortress."

strings.text: 「はぐれちゃったけど、九郎たち大丈夫かな？」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "Since we got separated, are Kurou and the others alright?"

strings.text: 「この程度の小細工でどうにか出来るほど生易しい子ではないよ、アレは」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "They won't fall so easily for such a petty trick."

strings.text: 「まあ、そうだろうけど」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "Well, I guess so."

strings.text: 「ああ、そうだろうとも――特に、君たちは身に染みているのではないのかね？」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Yeah, certainly--but you were all already well aware of that, weren't you?"

strings.text: 「ははははははははは……」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "Hahahahahahahahaha......"

strings.text: 「うむ。気付いておいでか、気付かれておいでか。まったくもって人が悪い、意地が悪いですなあ、博士」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "Mm. Have you noticed? Have you finally noticed? How truly nasty and mean of you, Doctor."

strings.text: 「その声――あのとき大十字君を襲った魔術師だな？」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "That voice--were you the sorcerer who attacked Mr. Daijuuji back then?"

strings.text: 「……生きてたみたいね」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "......And here I thought you were a goner."

strings.text: 「ほう？　私のことを憶えてらっしゃったか。嬉しい、嬉しいですなあ」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "Hoh? You still remember me? Delightful, I feel so delighted."

strings.text: 「目が見えない分、耳と記憶力が良くてね。君もアンチクロスとやらなのだろう？」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "I may be blind, but my hearing and my memory are pretty good. I suppose you're also an Anticross or something?"

strings.text: 「如何にも。私はアンチクロスの一、ウェスパシアヌス。そして、これが私の鬼械神サイクラノーシュ！」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "Indeed. I am Vespasianus, one of the Anticross. And this is my Deus Machina, Cykranosh!"

strings.text: 「お会いできて非常に、非常に光栄です。光栄ですとも、ラバン・シュリュズベリイ博士。以後、お見知りおきを」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "I'm extremely, extremely thrilled to meet you, it's an honor. It's such an honor, Dr. Laban Shrewsbury. It is my immense pleasure to make your acquaintance."

strings.text: 「やれやれ。私も有名になったものだ」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "My goodness. Looks like I rose to fame too."

strings.text: 「好ましくないモノばっかり寄ってくるけどね」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "Except we attracted nothing but a bunch of annoyances, though."

strings.text: 「はははは。まあまあ、そう言わずにお嬢さん。この年寄りの暇潰しに少しばっかり付き合ってくれたまえ付き合っていただけますね、教授？」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "Hahahaha. Come now, don't say such things, young lady. Be a good sport and keep this old man company for a bit--you will indulge me, won't you, Professor?"

strings.text: 「セラエノの知識を駆る大賢者！エーテルの海を超える超人！ラバン・シュリュズベリイと一局打てるとは何と幸運！　何とも僥倖！」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "The great sage who bears the knowledge of Celaeno! The superman who transcends the Sea of Ether! How fortunate I am to have a duel with Laban Shrewsbury! What a stroke of luck!"

strings.text: 「さあ、論じましょう！　論じ合いましょう！討論を！　有意義かつ不毛な闘論を！」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "Now, let's discuss! Let us join in discussion! A debate! A worthwhile yet fruitless combat-debate!"

strings.text: 「ああ、良かろう、付き合ってやる。しかし、あまり時間を割いてやるワケにはいかんぞ？　こう見えても多忙の身でね」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Alright, fine, as you wish. But know that I can't spare too much time for you, okay? Believe it or not, I'm a very busy man."

strings.text: 「戦闘準備完了――勝負！」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "Ready for battle--Duel!"

strings.text: 「君の出番は終わりだ！大人しく無音の闇黒へ還りたまえ！」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Your time is up! Be obedient and return to the tranquil darkness!"

strings.text: サイクラノーシュの巨体に亀裂が入る。決定的／致命的で不可逆／不可避の破壊／崩壊／敗北が動き出す。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Cracks develop on Cykranosh's colossal frame. Decisive/fatal and irreversible/inevitable ruination/ collapse/defeat is set in motion.

strings.text: 亀裂から噴き出る血煙。サイクラノーシュが崩れ始める。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Sprays of blood spout out from the cracks. Cykranosh begins to fall apart.

strings.text: 「は……はははは……ッ！」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "Ha...... Hahahaha......"

strings.text: 燃える血風の中、むせ返る血臭の中、ウェスパシアヌスは嗤っていた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Amidst the scorching, bloodstained wind and the choking scent of blood, Vespasianus is laughing.

strings.text: 声に力は無い。既に虫の息だ。弱々しい嗤い声は、しかし途切れることがない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: There is no strength in his voice. He is already on his last breath. His frail laughter, however, is uninterrupted.

strings.text: 崩れゆくウェスパシアヌスの、何ものも映さない、冥い冥い瞳。それは諦念が命の光を奪ったためか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The dark, gloomy eyes of the disintegrating Vespasianus reflect nothing. Is it his resignation that took the light of life away from him?

strings.text: それとも底知れぬ心の闇が零れ出すためか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Or is it because the bottomless darkness in his heart is overflowing?

strings.text: 消え入りそうな声で、ウェスパシアヌスは自らを滅ぼした者に語りかける。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: With a dying voice, Vespasianus addresses his destroyers.

strings.text: 「礼を……言っておくべきですかな、博士？」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "Should I say...... thank you, Doctor?"

strings.text: 「何だと？」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Come again?"

strings.text: 「くだらぬ……くだらぬ悪夢だ。まったくもってくだらぬことに付き合わされたものだ」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "Ridiculous...... This nightmare is all too ridiculous. I was pulled into something utterly ridiculous."

strings.text: 「だが、これで終わる。私の役目は終わりだ。胸がすく気分だ……清々する。本当に清々する」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "But this concludes it. My role is finished. I feel relieved...... It's refreshing. I feel so refreshed."

strings.text: 「……何を言ってるの、この人？」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "......What is he talking about?"

strings.text: 「魔人に……魔人に逢ったのだ。何ものも到達できない高みに立つ、窮極の人外。金色の獣だ。そいつは獣だったのだよ」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "A demon...... I've met a demon. The ultimate inhuman, standing at a height no one can reach. It was the Golden Beast. That being was none other than the Beast."

strings.text: 光を宿さない瞳が、遠くを見つめる。その向こうに何を想い、何を悼むのか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: His lightless eyes stare off into the distance. Beyond that, what does he ponder, and what does he lament?

strings.text: 言葉はもはや語りかけではなく、独白に近い。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: His words are no longer a dialogue, but closer to a monologue.

strings.text: 「私は思った。ヒトの手で、私の手で、あのバケモノを創造しようと。ヒトの手で、私の手で、あのバケモノを超越しようと」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "I thought. With the hands of a man, with these hands of mine, I would create that monster. With the hands of a man, with these hands of mine, I would transcend that monster."

strings.text: 「藝術を……至高の藝術を！それなのに、それなのに……ふはははははははッ！」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "It was an art...... a sublime art! And yet, and yet...... Bwahahahahahahaha!"

strings.text: 吐息のように弱々しい声には、やがて熱が宿り、力がこもり、ついには哄笑となって響き渡った。それは燃え尽きる命の、最期の灯火のようなものだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Soon, his faint, sigh-like voice is brimming with passion and full of vigor before finally reverberating as a roar of laughter. It resembles a spark of flame of a life that burned out.

strings.text: 哄笑うウェスパシアヌスの脳裏をよぎるのは――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: What crosses Vespasianus' mind as he laughs out loud is--

strings.text: 目を見開くウェスパシアヌスの貌が、凶相／死相に醜く歪む。だがその表情も、いずれは血煙になって崩れてゆく。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Vespasianus' eyes widen as his face hideously distorts into a menacing/deathly look. Yet eventually, his expression also deteriorates and becomes a spray of blood.

strings.text: その様は、血の涙を流しているようにも見える。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The way he looks now appears like he's shedding tears of blood.

strings.text: 窮極の魔人――神の世界に到達する魔人を創造する。ウェスパシアヌスがかつて抱いた野望。だがそれも、無限螺旋を廻す歯車のひとつに過ぎなかったのだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: To create the ultimate demon--one that would reach the domain of gods. Such was the ambition Vespasianus once harbored. But that too was nothing more than a gear driving the Infinite Spiral.

strings.text: 彼は最も嫉み、焦がれ、憎んだ者を自らの手で産み落とした。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: With his own hands, he has given birth to the one he envied, yearned for, and loathed the most.

strings.text: それを知ったときの絶望は、深く深く刻み込まれている――単なるかりそめの悪夢でしかない、亡零の自分にも。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The despair he felt when he learned the truth is etched deeply, deeply within him--even into this spectral self, which is nothing more than a fleeting nightmare.

strings.text: だが彼の運命を弄んだあの魔人ですら、今この世界では単なる悪夢の残滓として、紡ぎ手の意に従う駒に過ぎないのだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: However, even the demon who toyed with his fate is now a mere remnant of a nightmare in this world, and simply a pawn that obeys the will of the weaver.

strings.text: 「くだらん！　この世は実にくだらん！　ふははははははははは！」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "How meaningless! This world is downright meaningless! Bwahahahahahahahaha!"

strings.text: 総ては虚構だ。身を灼く苦痛も、心を蝕む憎悪も、全部全部。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: All things are fictional. Every single thing, be it the agony that burns one's body, or the hatred that gnaws at one's heart.

strings.text: 虚構を塗り固めた脆弱な悪夢を加速させ、語り手は何処へ向かう気なのか――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Just where could the storyteller possibly be heading as they accelerate this fragile nightmare plastered together out of fiction--

strings.text: 知らない。知ったことではない。出番を終えた役者はさっさと舞台から降りるべきだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: No one knows. Nor is it a matter of concern. Actors who have fulfilled their roles should promptly walk off the stage.

strings.text: 「おさらばだ！　こんなくだらない世界とは、これで、これで、本当に、本当におさらばしよう！ふはははははははははははは！」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "Farewell! This time, THIS TIME, I am truly, TRULY saying goodbye to such a trifling world! BWAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA HAHAHA!"

strings.text: 紅に熔ける機体。紅に融ける躰。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The machine dissolves crimson. His body melts crimson.

strings.text: 解けてゆく。解けてゆく。血風となって渦を巻き、大気に散ってゆく。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Slowly, they dissipate. Slowly, they disperse. They twirl into a bloody wind, scattering into the air.

strings.text: 夢はただ夢と散り逝くだけだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A dream simply scatters away as a dream.

strings.text: 「勝手に自己完結して、逝っちゃったよ……」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "He just talked himself into closure on his own and passed on......"

strings.text: 「……レディ、進むぞ。先を急がなくては」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "......Lady, time to move on. We need to hurry."

strings.text: 「うん、そうだね」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "Mm, you're right."

strings.text: 戦闘による破壊痕だけをこの場に残し、アンブロシウスは飛び去った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Ambrose takes off, leaving only the scars of destruction caused by their battle in this place.

strings.text: 戦いの余熱すらも冷め切った元戦場を惜しむかのように、紅い風が吹く。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: As though lamenting the previous battlefield where even the residual heat of the fight has cooled off, a scarlet wind blows.

strings.text: 風が運ぶのは、ウェスパシアヌス――儚い悪夢の、最期の思考だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The wind carries the last thoughts of Vespasianus--a transient nightmare.

strings.text: ――しかし、自分よりも深い憎悪を抱く者はどうか？
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --But what about those who bear a grudge deeper than my own?

strings.text: 与えられた役に素直に従うものだろうか？
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Will they be amenable to the role they have been given?

strings.text: 「なあ……『獣』よ」
strings.speaker: ウェスパシアヌス
strings.translated: "Do you think so...... [Beast]?"

strings.text: アンチクロスを撃破して先を進む、三体の鬼械神。その終着点は『夢幻心母』の中心、心臓の間だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The three Deus Machina move forward after defeating the Anticross. Their destination is the heart chamber, the center of the [Illusory Heart Mother].

strings.text: かつて『Ｃ計画』の中枢ユニットとして機能していた、神の心臓である。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: This is the heart of god, which used to function as the central unit of the [C Project].

strings.text: 爆音のような鼓動の中、リベル・レギスは静かに待つ。宿敵――デモンベインの到来を。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Amidst the thunderous thumping, Liber Legis calmly waits for its archenemy's--Demonbane's arrival.

strings.text: 「……足りぬ」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "......Not enough."

strings.text: 呟きは、自然と零れ落ちた。身を灼く焦燥と、心を穿つ虚無。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A mutter naturally leaks out of his mouth. His body boils with impatience, and emptiness pierces through his heart.

strings.text: ――足りない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --This is insufficient.

strings.text: 切実な喪失感。迎え撃つ自分に、致命的に欠けているものがある。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: An acute sense of loss. Something is fatally missing within him as he waits to intercept them.

strings.text: 最強最悪の『獣』――邪神の血を色濃く引き、己もまた限りなく神に近い領域に立つ魔人は識る。論理ではなく、真理として。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The strongest and most wicked [Beast]--the demon who deeply inherits the blood of the Evil God and also stands in a realm infinitely close to a god himself--is aware. Not through logic, but as a fact.

strings.text: ――今の自分では、デモンベインに決して勝てない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --He can never defeat Demonbane in his current state.

strings.text: 今の自分に欠けているもの。それが何かが解からない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: His current self is lacking something. Yet he does not know what that is.

strings.text: それを満たさねば、『魔を断つ剣』と刃を交える権利すら無いのだ。あの三位一体を為す最強の剣と――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: If that condition is not met, then he won't even get the privilege to cross blades with the [Sword that Smites Evil]. Against that ultimate sword which achieved the Trinity--

strings.text: 今、この大空間に存在するのはリベル・レギスのみ。しかしマスターテリオンの第六感は、確かに違和感を感じ取る。この空間を形成する字祷子に生じる乱れ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Right now, only Liber Legis is situated in this large chamber. However, with certainty, Master Therion's intuition feels something off. A disturbance occurs in the Azathoth that constructs this space.

strings.text: 「何者だ……この空間に干渉しているのは？」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Who's there...... interfering with this space?"

strings.text: 答えはない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: No answer.

strings.text: ノイズはさらに激しく、度し難いものになっていく。マスターテリオンの声が、冷たい怒気を孕む。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The noise grows increasingly intense and unbearable. Master Therion's voice gets filled with chilling anger.

strings.text: 「不愉快だ……失せろ」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "So unpleasant...... begone."

strings.text: 「そうはいかないよ……」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "That won't happen......"

strings.text: 「だって君は――」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "Because you--"

strings.text: 「このネロが滅ぼすんだから」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "Shall be destroyed by me, Nero."

strings.text: 神の心臓が裂けた。滝のように流れ落ちる鮮血。その奥に、血に濡れた白銀の輝きがある。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The god's heart tears open. Fresh blood pours like a waterfall. Within it, there is a blood-soaked silvery glow.

strings.text: それはヒトの形をした異形／神を象った異形。それは機械仕掛けの神――鬼械神。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It is a humanoid Other/an Other modeled after a god. It is a mechanical god--a Deus Machina.

strings.text: 心臓から産まれ落ちたその機体は、血の海面に音も無く舞い降りる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: That machine, born from the heart, quietly descends onto the sea of blood.

strings.text: 天を衝くように聳え立つ巨体。その荘厳な威容は、神殿を連想させる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The giant towers as if reaching the heavens. Its solemn appearance is reminiscent of a temple.

strings.text: ――鬼械神ネームレス・ワン。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --Deus Machina Nameless One.

strings.text: 『無名祭祀書』が招喚する鬼械神。リベル・レギスにも匹敵する力を持つ機体だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A Deus Machina summoned from the [Unaussprechlichen Kulten]. It is a machine that possesses strength comparable even to that of Liber Legis.

strings.text: そしてそれを駆る者もまた、尋常ならざる魔力を持つ魔術師――魔人の中の魔人である。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: And its pilot is also a sorcerer with remarkable magic power--a demon among demons.

strings.text: ネームレス・ワンの中から現れる、小柄な少女。マスターテリオンの表情が凍りついた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: From within Nameless One emerges a petite young girl. Master Therion's expression freezes.

strings.text: 「ごきげんよう、大導師。最後のアンチクロスがやってきたよ……ちょっと遅刻しちゃったけどね」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "Good day, Grand Master. The last Anticross has come...... I was a bit late, though."

strings.text: そう。彼女もまたアンチクロスの一人。魔人の中の魔人にして、罪人の中の罪人。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Yes. She too is one of the Anticross. A demon among demons, and a sinner among sinners.

strings.text: 『暴君』ネロ。最強最悪のアンチクロス。そして、もう一人の『聖書の獣』。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: [Tyrant] Nero. The strongest and most evil of the Anticross. And another [Beast of Scripture].

strings.text: 「なに？　そんなにぼーっとしちゃって。ネロが居るのがそんなに不思議？」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "What's wrong? Why do you look so dumbfounded? Is it really that strange for Nero to be here?"

strings.text: 「嫌だなぁ……勝手にネロだけを仲間外れにしないでよ」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "Oh no...... Don't you dare decide on your own and leave Nero out in the cold."

strings.text: 言って、くすくすと笑う。マスターテリオンは動けない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: As soon as she says so, she chuckles. Master Therion makes no move.

strings.text: ただ呆然と、少女を見つめ続ける。少女もまた構わず進める。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Instead, he only keeps staring at the girl in a daze. The girl also proceeds without showing him any regard.

strings.text: 「まあ、でも、確かに他のみんなとは事情が違うかも」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "Well, but I guess my circumstances are different from everyone else."

strings.text: 「――総てはかりそめ。単なる悪夢。ネロも、他のアンチクロスも、大導師……君もだよ」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "--All things are impermanent, as they are simply a nightmare. Nero, other Anticrosses, and you too...... Grand Master."

strings.text: 「全部全部、意味の無い、くだらないマボロシに過ぎないのさ」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "Every single thing here is nothing but a meaningless, silly fantasy."

strings.text: 少女の貌から微笑が消える。リベル・レギスを――その中に居るマスターテリオンを視る瞳には、光が無い。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The smile is gone from her face. Her eyes are devoid of light as she observes Liber Legis--and Master Therion, who is inside it.

strings.text: 底無しに深い闇色。少年がその瞳に宿す金色の闇と同じように。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: There is a profound, endlessly deep darkness. Just like the golden darkness that dwells in the young man's eyes.

strings.text: 「でも、だからこそ……何にも呪縛られてない。この世の全てに縁が無いんだもの。だったら――」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "Still, precisely thanks to that...... we are cursed by nothing. We are not fated to anything in this world. Which is why--"

strings.text: 「紡ぎ手の言うことを聞く必要だってないでしょ？」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "We don't need to do what the weaver has told us to, right?"

strings.text: 少女はかつて自分を呪縛していたものを想う。無限螺旋の世界。邪神によって組み立てられた輪廻の箱庭。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The girl recalls the thing that once imprisoned her. The world of the Infinite Spiral. A miniature garden of Samsara made by an Evil God.

strings.text: それは混沌の呪縛。運命の歯車を動かすため――少女は穢され、狂わされ、殺され続けた。無限に等しい時間の中、無限に等しい繰り返しの中で。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It was a curse of Chaos. To instigate the Wheel of Fortune--she continued to be violated, driven mad, and slaughtered. In a time equal to infinity, and in a cycle equivalent to an eternity.

strings.text: 「つまりだよ……」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "In other words......"

strings.text: 少女の貌に再び表情が戻る。だが、瞳に宿した闇黒はさらに深く、冥く。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The girl regains the look on her face. However, the darkness within her eyes is even deeper and gloomier.

strings.text: 少女が笑う。亀裂のような喜悦。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The girl laughs. A joy that feels like a crack.

strings.text: 「殺せるんだ。ネロは君を殺せるんだ」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "I can kill you. Nero can kill you."

strings.text: 「この手で……私はこの手で、我が子を！――縊り殺せる！」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "With these hands...... With these very hands of mine, I can strangle my own child to death!"

strings.text: 少女が詠うのは殺意。それは無垢な――極限まで純化された、宝石のような殺意だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The girl sings of a murderous impulse. It is pure--a jewel-like killing intent, purified to the extremes.

strings.text: 想えるのだ。人はこんなにも純粋に、誰かを殺したいと想えるのだ。こんな――愛にも似た切実さで。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: One can imagine. People are able to have such a pure desire to kill someone. Like this--with a sincerity similar to love.

strings.text: マスターテリオンは――金色の少年は、ただ呆然と少女の殺意を受け止める。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The golden young man--Master Therion--can only receive her killing intent, stunned.

strings.text: 母の殺意を受け止める。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: He receives his mother's killing intent.

strings.text: ――母。然り、少女は少年を孕んだ。外なる神ヨグ＝ソトースを父とする、この少年を。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --Mother. Indeed, the girl had conceived the boy. This boy, fathered by the Outer God Yog-Sothoth.

strings.text: 少女は邪神と交わり、世界に仇なす最悪の魔人を産み落としたのだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The girl had lain with the Evil God and given birth to the most wicked demon, an enemy to the world.

strings.text: この少女こそ、闇の聖母。魔人マスターテリオンの母。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: This young girl is Our Lady of Darkness. She is the mother of the demon, Master Therion.

strings.text: 母は詠う。殺意を。我が子に対する殺意を。宝石のような殺意を。愛にも似た殺意を。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The mother recites her murderous intent. A murderous intent towards her own child. A jewel-like murderous intent. A murderous intent resembling love.

strings.text: 「この役だけは九郎にも譲らない。さあ……私の腕の中で眠り、息絶えなさい！」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "This role alone I won't hand over to Kurou. Come...... fall into a deep slumber and breathe your last in my embrace!"

strings.text: 「望まれぬ生命！　忌むべき蛭子！――嗚呼、憎しや憎し、私の坊や！」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "The undesired life! The loathsome, unwanted child! --Ah, my baby boy, I loathe you with every fiber of my being!"

strings.text: 少年はなおも呆然と、少女を見つめている。魔人としての狂気も、黒の王としての威厳も、今の彼には無い。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The young man, still in shock, continues staring at her. At the moment, he has neither the madness of a demon nor the majesty of the Black King.

strings.text: 少年の心は、無垢な子どもの――世界を知らない赤子のそれに等しかった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The young man's heart is akin to that of an innocent child--an infant who lacks awareness of the world.

strings.text: だが――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: However--

strings.text: 「は……ははは……」
strings.speaker: テリオン

strings.text: 少年の中で何かが決壊した。それは心を護る鎧だったのか。それとも心を縛る鎖だったのか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Something shatters inside the young man. Is it the armor protecting his heart? Or the chains binding his spirit?

strings.text: 決壊した心から、零れ落ちる笑い。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: His broken soul bursts into laughter.

strings.text: 「は……ははははははは……！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Ha...... Hahahahahahaha......!"

strings.text: それは止め様もなく増大し、
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: And as it grows uncontrollably,

strings.text: 「ははははははははははははははははははははははははははははは！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA HAHAHAHAHA!"

strings.text: 哄笑となって、何もかもを呑み込んでゆく。亀裂のような喜悦を浮かべ、少年は哄笑う。咆吼るように。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It swells into uproarious laughter, swallowing up everything. Wearing a fissured grin of ecstasy, the young man roars with laughter. As if he is howling.

strings.text: 「こいつは確かに……極上の悪夢だ！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Now this is truly...... the finest nightmare!"

strings.text: リベル・レギスから莫大な魔力が噴き出し、爆発した。爆発は突撃力に変換される。爆音を置き去りに、紅の機神は稲妻のように奔る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Immense magic power wells up from Liber Legis, resulting in a discharge. The blast converts into a striking force. Leaving a detonation behind, the crimson Machine God dashes as fast as lightning.

strings.text: 「アアアアアアアアアアァァァッ！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "AAAAAAAAAAAAARGH!"

strings.text: 咆吼とも悲鳴ともつかぬ叫びと共に、ネームレス・ワンに襲いかかる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: With a cry that is half roar, half shriek, it rushes at Nameless One.

strings.text: 堅牢な防禦陣が、リベル・レギスの行く手を阻む。無理矢理にでも突破しようと突き進むリベル・レギス。ぶつかり合う魔力と魔力が、爆光となって踊り狂う。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A sturdy defensive field blocks Liber Legis' path. Liber Legis plunges forward, trying to break through even by force. Two sources of magic power clash, dancing madly in a burst of light.

strings.text: 「アアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアッッッ！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!"

strings.text: 機体のあちらこちらが爆ぜた。飛び散る水銀の血。だがそれは闘気に触れて、一瞬で蒸発する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Explosions occur all over the machine. Mercury blood scatters. However, it evaporates in a split second upon exposure to his fighting spirit.

strings.text: 機体にかかる負荷には一切構わず、少年はさらに力を注ぎ込む。ネームレス・ワンに触れるために。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Paying no heed to the strain on his machine, the young man pours in yet more power. Just to touch Nameless One.

strings.text: （足りぬ……）
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: (Not enough......)

strings.text: 心の何処かで何かが囁く。――足りない、と。囁きは無限に増殖し、思考を塗り潰す。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Something whispers somewhere in his mind. --Not enough, it says. The murmur multiplies infinitely, painting over his thoughts.

strings.text: （足りぬ……足りぬ……足りぬ……足りぬ！）
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: (Not enough...... Not enough...... Not enough...... Not enough......!)

strings.text: ――足りない。――これでは欠けている。――これでは届かない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --This is not enough. --This is lacking. --I can't reach it with this.

strings.text: ――デモンベインには届かない！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --This won't reach Demonbane!

strings.text: もっと強く。もっと激しく。もっと鋭く。超えろ超えろ超えろ超えろ超えろ超えろ超えろ！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It needs to be stronger, fiercer, and sharper. Exceed, exceed, exceed, exceed, exceed, exceed!

strings.text: 取り戻せ。デモンベインと対峙する権利を取り戻せ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I must regain it. Reclaim the right to face Demonbane.

strings.text: そのために――何が足りない？何が欠けている？
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Therefore--what else is missing? What am I lacking?

strings.text: 欠けたる力――欠けたる半身。それは何だ！？
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The inadequate power--the absent other half. Just what is it!?

strings.text: デモンベインに比べて、自分には何が欠けている！？あの三位一体の剣に在って、自分に欠けているもの――！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Compared to Demonbane, what am I still missing!? What that Sword of Trinity has that I am lacking--!

strings.text: 『三位一体』
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The [Trinity].

strings.text: 欠けている断片が、最後の鍵が合わさった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The missing piece, the last key, comes together.

strings.text: 理解よりも迅く、少年は叫んだ。謳った。自らの半身の名を。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The young man shouts, quicker than his comprehension. He extols. The name of his other half.

strings.text: 「我が魔導書――『ナコト写本』よ！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "My Grimoire--the [Pnakotic Manuscripts]!"

strings.text: 「来い！　エセルドレーダ！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Come forth! Etheldreda!"

strings.text: 「イエス・マスター！　御前に！」
strings.speaker: エセルドレーダ
strings.translated: "Yes, Master! At your service!"

strings.text: リベル・レギスから放たれた複雑強大な術式が、ネームレス・ワンの防禦陣を兇悪に侵略し、征服した。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A complex, mighty spell unleashed from Liber Legis viciously invades and conquers Nameless One's defensive field.

strings.text: あれほどの堅牢さを誇っていた防禦陣が、跡形も無く分解される。防禦陣崩壊の余波が、爆発となって二体の鬼械神を襲う。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: That defensive field, which has displayed such sturdiness, decomposes without a trace. The aftermath of its disintegration blows up, assailing both Deus Machina.

strings.text: 爆炎が晴れる。リベル・レギスは微動だにせず、其処に立っていた。そして少年――大導師マスターテリオンは、
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The explosion clears. Liber Legis stands there, not budging an inch. And then the young man--the Grand Master, Master Therion,

strings.text: 「そうだ！　貴女の言う通りだ！我等は悪夢。単なる幻影。存在し得ぬ、狂った幻想……」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Correct! You just said it! We are nightmares. We are merely phantoms. We are mad fantasies that shouldn't exist......"

strings.text: 「ならばこそ！我等を呪縛するものは何も無い！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Thus! We are free from all restraint!"

strings.text: 叫ぶマスターテリオンの周囲――リベル・レギスの操縦室は濃厚な血の霧に充たされていた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A dense bloody mist fills Liber Legis' cockpit-- surrounding Master Therion as he cries out.

strings.text: むせ返るような血臭は、原初の海の匂い――母の胎内と同じ匂いだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The choking stench of blood is the scent of the primordial sea--the very same scent as the inside of a mother's womb.

strings.text: 其処は少年を充たした、絶望の胎内。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: That place is a womb of despair that fills the young man.

strings.text: 「さあ、今こそ怨嗟を込めて責め問おう！何故だ！　何故だ！　何故なのだ！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Now, let us pour in all our resentment and demand an answer! Why! Why! Why is it?!"

strings.text: 「――『何故』という言葉を、私は刃金に変える」
strings.speaker: エセルドレーダ
strings.translated: "--I turn the word called 'Why' into a blade of steel."

strings.text: 「私はマスターの怒り。
strings.speaker: エセルドレーダ
strings.translated: "I am Master's wrath.

strings.text: 私はマスターの痛み。
strings.speaker: エセルドレーダ
strings.translated: I am Master's pain.

strings.text: 私はマスターの叫び……」
strings.speaker: エセルドレーダ
strings.translated: I am Master's cry......"

strings.text: 操縦室を充たす血の霧が凝固し、実体を結ぶ。紅の血塊が闇色に染まる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The bloody mist spreading all over the cockpit solidifies and materializes. The crimson blood clot becomes tinged with darkness.

strings.text: 墨を流したような黒い髪。黒曜石のような瞳。黒いドレス。そして肌だけが、闇に浮かび上がるように白い。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Hair as black as ink. Eyes like obsidian. And a black dress. Then only the whiteness of her skin shines against the dark.

strings.text: ――顕現する、少女の姿。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --The girl's form manifests.

strings.text: 「――私はマスターの刃」
strings.speaker: エセルドレーダ
strings.translated: "--I am Master's sword."

strings.text: 少年の傍らに少女が寄り添った。かつて、そうしたように。これからも、そうであるように。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The girl nestles close to the young man's side. Just like she has done before. Just like she will continue to do from now on.

strings.text: その身が無意味な幻であっても、少女の想いは変わらない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Even though her body is a meaningless illusion, her feelings never change.

strings.text: 少年は少女を見ない。其処に居るのは解かっている。何もかもを理解している。それは信頼より強く、確信よりも確かな信仰だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The young man does not glance at the girl. Because he knows she is there. He understands everything. It is a faith stronger than trust, more certain than belief.

strings.text: ――今こそ彼は、あの怨敵と互角になったことを知る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --At this moment, he knows he has become evenly matched with that sworn enemy of his.

strings.text: だが、その前に責め問おう。そうだ。今から投げかけるこの問いこそが、総ての絶望の始まりなのだ。総ての憎悪の根源なのだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: But before that, let him demand an answer. Indeed. The very question he is about to hurl is the beginning of all despair. It is the root of all hatred.

strings.text: 今の彼は、白の王と並び立つ黒の王ではない。総ての呪縛から解放された剥き身の魂。この世界に生を享けた、意味の無い有象無象のひとつに過ぎない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Now, he is not the Black King that rivals the White King. But a bare soul, liberated from all limitations. He is only one among the insignificant rabble that has come into this world.

strings.text: ――歓喜と憎悪と慟哭と共に、今こそ叫べ！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --With rapture, hatred, and lamentation, cry out now!

strings.text: 「何故！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Why?!"

strings.text: 「何故！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Why?!"

strings.text: 「何故――！余を産み落とした！　母さん！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Why--! Why did you give birth to me?! Mother!"

strings.text: 「その言葉で呼ぶなァァァァァァァァ！」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "DON'T YOU DARE CALL ME BY THAT WOOOOOOOOORD!"

strings.text: 子は母を殺せ。母は子を殺せ。太母は死を司り、英雄は太母を殺す。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Child, kill thy mother. Mother, kill thy child. The Great Mother rules over death, and the hero slays the Great Mother.

strings.text: ――嗚呼、呪われし母と子よ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --Alas, the cursed mother and child.

strings.text: 「征くぞエセルドレーダ、我が半身よ！余を灼き滅ぼす、恐怖と共に踊れ！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Let's go, Etheldreda, my other half! Dance with the fear that immolates me!"

strings.text: 「イエス、マイ・マスター……いつまでも、何処までも！」
strings.speaker: エセルドレーダ
strings.translated: "Yes, my Master...... Forever and always!"

strings.text: ……おれはまだ母親の胎内にいるのだ。こんなおそろしい「胎児の夢」をみてもがき苦しんでいるのだ……。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: ......I am still in my mother's womb. I suffer in agony as I have a terrible "fetal dream" like this.......

strings.text: ……そうしてこれから生まれ出ると同時に大勢の人を片ッ端から呪い殺そうとしているのだ……。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: ......And the moment I am born, I am going to curse and kill masses of people left and right......

strings.text: ……しかしまだだれも、そんな事は知らないのだ……ただおれのモノスゴイ胎動を、母親が感じているだけなのだ……。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: ......But such a thing is yet to be known to anyone....... ......All my mother can do is feel my tremendous fetal movements.......

strings.text: 「は……ははは……ははははははは！ははははははははは！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Ha...... Hahaha...... Hahahahahahaha! Hahahahahahahahaha!"

strings.text: 哄笑が広大な心臓の間に響き渡る。だけどそれは笑っているのに、泣いているように聴こえた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A roar of laughter resounds through the vast heart chamber. Still, even though he is laughing, it sounds as if he is weeping.

strings.text: 「……マスター」
strings.speaker: エセルドレーダ
strings.translated: "......Master."

strings.text: 力を失ったネームレス・ワンは枯れ果てた大樹のような姿で立ち尽くしていた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Stripped of its power, Nameless One stands frozen like a withered great tree.

strings.text: ひび割れる機体。崩れた破片がボロボロと血の海に墜ちてゆく。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Its frame cracks. Crumbling fragments tumble down one after another into the sea of blood.

strings.text: リベル・レギスがネームレス・ワンの胸部を鷲掴みにして、一気に引き剥がした。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Liber Legis seizes the chest of Nameless One, ripping it off in one go.

strings.text: 祭壇にも似た操縦室が剥き出しになる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The altar-like cockpit is laid bare.

strings.text: その中に、息も絶え絶えな少女の姿。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Inside is a figure of a girl, on her dying breath.

strings.text: 「さあ……母さん。僕の怨嗟を受け取ってください」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "Now...... Mother. Please accept my resentment."

strings.text: リベル・レギスの右掌が白く焔える。絶対零度の刃。その掌に触れれば、一切が死の静寂に停止し、跡形もなく消滅する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Liber Legis' right palm burns white. It is the Blade of Absolute Zero. Anything that touches that palm is brought to a halt in the silence of death, vanishing without a trace.

strings.text: これで総てに止めを。そして再び黒の王としてデモンベインの前に――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: This will be the finishing blow to everything. And once again, he will confront Demonbane as the Black King--

strings.text: 「……もう良いんだよ」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "......It's all right now."

strings.text: 突然返ってきた少女の声に、マスターテリオンは酷い違和感を覚えた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Master Therion feels a severe sense of discomfort as the girl's voice unexpectedly returns.

strings.text: 「……もう苦しまなくても良い」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "......You don't need to suffer anymore."

strings.text: 脳裏を駆ける雑念／雑念／雑念。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Intrusive thoughts/Intrusive thoughts/ Intrusive thoughts sweep through his mind.

strings.text: 「……マスター？」
strings.speaker: エセルドレーダ
strings.translated: "......Master?"

strings.text: 「君は、本当ならもう……救われているんだから」
strings.speaker: ネロ
strings.translated: "Because you should already...... be saved."

strings.text: さっきまでとは違う。リベル・レギスを見上げる瞳――そこに宿るのは、あの底無しの闇ではない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: She is different from what she was just now. The eyes looking up at Liber Legis-- what dwells there is not that bottomless darkness.

strings.text: 底無しよりも深く、しかし何よりも透明な瞳。それは少年の識らない、少女／母の瞳だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Her eyes are deeper than infinity, yet more transparent than anything. These are the eyes of a maiden/mother, unknown to the young man.

strings.text: ――決定的に、違う。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --Decisively different.

strings.text: 「貴女は……さっきまでの悪夢ではない！」
strings.speaker: テリオン
strings.translated: "You...... are not the nightmare from a moment ago!"

strings.text: 「何……何なんですか、貴女は……！」
strings.speaker: エセルドレーダ
strings.translated: "What...... What in the world are you......!"

strings.text: 「このまま進めば……」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "If we keep going like this......"

strings.text: 「間違いない。『夢幻心母』の中枢部だ」
strings.speaker: アル
strings.translated: "No doubt. It's the heart chamber of the [Illusory Heart Mother]."

strings.text: いつか見た光景の中を、デモンベインは進む。奥へ進むごとに濃度を増す、神気／瘴気。あのときと同じだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Demonbane moves through a scene they have seen before. The divine aura/miasma thickens the deeper they go. Just like it was back then.

strings.text: 最後の舞台は恐らく、あの中枢部。神の心臓が鎮座する大空間。あれほど最終決戦に相応しい場所もあるまい。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
