strings.translated: However, now I'm about to suffer a crushing defeat.

strings.text: 解ける。『我』という存在が、紅い術式になって解ける。解け、血の霧となって稀薄になる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I'm dissolving. The existence called 'me' is breaking down into a crimson magic formula. It decomposes, thinning into a bloody mist.

strings.text: 呼吸が苦しい。陸に打ち揚げられた魚のように、酸素を欲する。だけど胸にはぽっかりと穴が開き、肺が無い。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: My breathing is painful. I crave oxygen, as though a fish out of water. Even so, a hole opens wide in my chest, and I am without lungs.

strings.text: がらんどうの胸の中、まるで紅玉のように輝く心臓が浮かんでいる。脈打ち、紅い紅い術式を、虚空に送り出している。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Within my hollow chest floats a heart shining like a ruby. It pulsates, sending a deep crimson magic formula out into the void.

strings.text: 術式はやはり二重螺旋を描いて昇り、やがては意味の繋がらない魔術文字の羅列となって、散って消える。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Likewise, the magic formula ascends as it forms a double helix; soon, it scatters into a string of meaningless arcane symbols before fading away.

strings.text: 『我』が無くなってゆく。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: 'I' am returning to nothing.

strings.text: 「……さあ、愛してくださいまし、お父様」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "......Now, please love me, Daddy."

strings.text: 何処からかアナザーブラッドの声が聴こえてくる。――違えた血。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: From somewhere, I'm starting to hear Another Blood's voice. --The Other Blood.

strings.text: 我が悪意。歪んだ姿見。在り得ざる可能性。忌まわしき魂の双児。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: My malice. My distorted reflection. The impossible possibility. The damned twin of my soul.

strings.text: だが今こそ、彼女こそが正しき血になろうとしている。正しい未来になろうとしている。違えてしまった我は、こうして崩れ去ろうとしているのだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: But right now, she is the one about to become the true blood. She is about to become the true future. And I, the one who went astray, am about to crumble away just like this.

strings.text: ――こんなところで、我は、潰えてしまうのか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --Am I going to be defeated in a place like this?

strings.text: と思うものの、何の感慨も無い。無念を抱くには、心は空っぽだった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: So I think, yet I feel nothing. My heart is too empty to harbor regret.

strings.text: 躰が崩れゆくように、心もまた崩れ落ちる。崩壊を止めようとする意志すら崩れ去る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Just as my body falls apart, so too does my heart. Even my will to prevent disintegration collapses.

strings.text: 我は、喪失われる――大十字九郎の、目の前で。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I will be lost--right before Daijuuji Kurou's eyes.

strings.text: 二重螺旋の回転が止まった。血の霧は空中で固化される。総てが停止した。心の動きすらも。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The rotation of the double helix stops. The bloody mist solidifies in mid-air. Everything comes to a halt. Even my mind is no exception.

strings.text: ただアナザーブラッドの声だけが、何故か我に届く。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Somehow, only the voice of Another Blood reaches my ears.

strings.text: 「そっと。耳元で。呼んで。私の――」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "Softly. Close to my ear. Call me. By my--"

strings.text: ――違えた血。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --The Other Blood!

strings.text: アナザーブラッド！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Another Blood!

strings.text: アナザーブラッド！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Another Blood!

strings.text: アナザーブラッド！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Another Blood!

strings.text: ――贋作め！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --You faker!

strings.text: 我と入れ替わり、世界に顕れるか。螺旋禍った己の未来に、世界を誘うか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Who said you could replace me and manifest yourself in this world? Who said you could tempt the world into your sick, twisted future?

strings.text: 大十字九郎の――父の愛を手に入れ、世界を手に入れるか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Who said you could claim this world and win the love of my father--Daijuuji Kurou?

strings.text: 肺を喪失い、息を吐けぬ咽喉から、無理やり声を搾り出す。胸の中のがらんどうに浮かぶ心臓が激しく脈打つ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I forcefully squeeze my voice out of my lungless, breathless throat. My heart, floating inside the hollow cavity of my chest, beats fiercely.

strings.text: 「させるか……させるものか……ッ！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "I won't let you...... Like hell I will let you......!"

strings.text: 二重螺旋の術式が逆転し、我の中に編み込まれる。固化した霧が吸い込まれ、肉体となって結晶する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The double-helix magic formula reverses, weaving into me. The stiffened mist is absorbed, shaping into flesh.

strings.text: 「それだけはさせるものか……ッ！アナザーブラッドォォォォ！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Like I will allow THAT to happen......! ANOTHER BLOOOOOD!"

strings.text: 空虚だった心を満たす、煮え滾った熱い何か。その熱量が、我を衝き動かす動力となる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Something boiling hot and passionate fills my vacant heart. Its heat becomes the power to push me.

strings.text: 奴のデモンベインに踏み砕かれた、我のデモンベインが再び動き出す。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: My Demonbane, crushed and trampled on by hers, begins to move again.

strings.text: 天を掴もうとするかのように、へし折れた腕を伸ばす。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It reaches out its fractured arm, as though trying to grasp the heavens.

strings.text: 動くたびに水銀の血が噴き出し、銀色の雨を降らせる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Mercury blood gushes out each time it moves, raining down in silver.

strings.text: 血まみれの、奴のデモンベインが、こちらを見下ろした。――醜い、と思った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Her bloodstained Demonbane looks down on me. --So hideous, I think.

strings.text: こんな不様なデモンベインを、我は認めぬ。父親に媚を売るような浅ましい売女を、我は認めぬ。このようなものが、我と我が剣に取って代わるなどと、我は断じて認めぬ！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I will not accept such an unsightly Demonbane. I will not accept a despicable whore who fawns over her father. And never will I accept such a thing replacing me and my sword!

strings.text: 「否定してやるぞ……アナザーブラッド！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "I will reject you...... Another Blood!"

strings.text: 速やかに排除しなければならない。目の前の醜い存在総てを。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I must eradicate them immediately. All the repulsive beings before my eyes.

strings.text: あれは汚染だ。我を侵す魂の汚染だ。我が気高く在るために、彼奴らを……！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: They are pollution. They are the contamination of my soul that infects me. For the sake of preserving my nobility, they have to be......!

strings.text: 「デモンベイン！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Demonbane!"

strings.text: 我が剣に呼びかける。破損したデモンベインが急速に修復されていく。破損箇所から溢れ出す螺子／
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I call out to my sword. My damaged Demonbane is rapidly regenerating. Overflowing from the damaged sections: screws/

strings.text: 歯車／発条／配管／
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: gears/springs/pipes/

strings.text: 鉄骨／導線／装甲――汚染を退けるための機械を、我に！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: frames/wires/armor--machinery to repel the contamination, unto me!

strings.text: 血まみれのデモンベインの足を掴み、立ち上がろうとする。その間にも螺子／歯車／
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Trying to stand up, I seize the leg of the bloodstained Demonbane. Meanwhile, screws/gears/

strings.text: 発条／配管／鉄骨／導線／装甲は際限なく虚無から湧き出でて、機体を組み立てる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: springs/pipes/frames/ wires/armor are emanating endlessly from the void, assembling into a machine.

strings.text: 掴んだ足を引きずり落とそうと、力を込める。螺子／歯車／発条／配管／鉄骨／
strings.speaker: NARRATION

strings.text: 導線／装甲はなおも絶えず、虚無から湧き出でる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: wires/armor keep emanating relentlessly from the void.

strings.text: 敵の躰を這い登る。自分と同じ奈落に引きずり込もうと。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I crawl up the enemy's body, trying to drag it down into the same abyss as me.

strings.text: 湧き出でる。湧き出でる。螺子／歯車／発条／配管／鉄骨／導線／装甲／螺子／歯車／発条／配管／鉄骨／導線／
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: They are emanating. And continue emanating. Screws/ gears/springs/pipes/frames/wires/armor/screws/ gears/springs/pipes/frames/wires/

strings.text: 装甲……無限の最果てから、なおも。なおも。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: armor...... coming forth from the farthest reaches of infinity, still more. And still more.

strings.text: 「……デモンベイン？」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "......Demonbane?"

strings.text: 螺子／歯車／発条／配管／鉄骨／導線／装甲／混沌／の海に沈みながら、我はデモンベインの――否、デモンベインだった何かの聲を聴いた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: As I sink into the sea of screws/gears/springs/pipes/frames/wires/armor/chaos/, I hear the voice of Demonbane--no, of something that WAS Demonbane.

strings.text: 「――我こそは這い寄る混沌、ナイアルラトホテップなれば」
strings.speaker: ファーザー・ナイ＆ナイア
strings.translated: "--For I am the Crawling Chaos, Nyarlathotep."

strings.text: デモンベイン・トゥーソードから溢れ出る螺子／歯車／発条／配管／鉄骨／導線／装甲――それは瞬く間に地平までを埋め尽くし、世界を機械の海へと沈めた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: From Demonbane Two-Sword overflows a stream of screws/gears/springs/pipes/frames/wires/armor--burying everything to the horizon in the blink of an eye, submerging the world in a sea of machinery.

strings.text: 無限に増殖を続けるそれらは、だがその総てが完全な調和をもって見事に噛み合い、とうてい人智の及ばない異界の論理に則って駆動していた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Driven by a transcendental logic far beyond the mortal mind, they keep multiplying infinitely, yet they all engage with each other flawlessly in perfect symmetry.

strings.text: 世界を覆うほどに巨大な――巨大過ぎるこの異形の機械は、デモンベインすらその機関に組み込もうと螺子／歯車／発条／配管／鉄骨／導線／装甲を、纏わりつかせてくる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: This gargantuan and otherworldly machine--vast enough to encompass the entire world--even begins to coil Demonbane around with screws/gears/ springs/pipes/frames/wires/armor in an attempt to incorporate it into its engine.

strings.text: 導線が機体内に侵入し、配管、鉄骨が突き刺さり、螺子は装甲と装甲を繋ぎ止め、歯車、発条は内部と外部の動きを連結させるべく組まれる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Wires penetrate into the machine, pipes and frames impale it; screws link one piece of armor to another, and gears and springs are put together to connect both internal and external movements.

strings.text: デモンベインが異形の機械に侵蝕される。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Demonbane is encroached upon by an unearthly machine.

strings.text: デモンベイン・トゥーソードもまた同じだ。分解され、再構築され、みるみる別の、違う『何か』に変容していく。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: This is also true of Demonbane Two-Sword. It is disassembled, rebuilt, and continues to transform into 'something' else, something 'Other' before my eyes.

strings.text: 「なんで……？なんでこんなことになっているの……？」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "Why......? Why are things turning out this way......?"

strings.text: その様子を驚愕の表情で、呆然と見つめる紅の少女。無論、これは彼女の意図した事態ではないだろう。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: With a shocked look on her face, the girl in red stares at the scene in disbelief. Of course, this is probably not the scenario she has in mind.

strings.text: しかし俺には理解っている。この神力――この存在力！俺はかつて、この具現化した絶望――宇宙的な悪意と対峙したのだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: But I am fully aware. This divine power--this presence! Once, I confronted this embodied despair-- this cosmic malice.

strings.text: 外なる神。無貌の神。千の異形。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The Outer God. The Faceless God. The God of a Thousand Forms.

strings.text: 混沌！混沌！混沌！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Chaos! Chaos! Chaos!

strings.text: 「……ナイアルラトホテップ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "......Nyarlathotep!"

strings.text: 「久しぶりだ、大十字九郎君。いや、私にとって時間の概念は酷く無意味なものではあるが」
strings.speaker: ファーザー・ナイ
strings.translated: "It's been some time, Daijuuji Kurou. Though to me, the concept of time bears no meaning at all."

strings.text: 「……ゲームキーパー」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "......Gamekeeper."

strings.text: 変質するデモンベイン・トゥーソードの頭頂部に黒い人影があった。闇よりも深い漆黒の影。だが少しずつその姿を認識できるようになる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A shadowy figure rests atop the transformed Demonbane Two-Sword. Pitch-black shadow deeper than darkness. However, little by little, I'm able to recognize that figure.

strings.text: 「アウグストゥスだと？　何故、そんな姿を……？」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Augustus? Why are you taking that sort of form......?"

strings.text: 「ああ、そうか。そうだったな。今の、その『君』とは、この姿では出遭ったことはなかったな」
strings.speaker: ファーザー・ナイ
strings.translated: "Ah, I see. That's right. I haven't met the present 'you' in this form, have I?"

strings.text: 姿が変わる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: His guise undergoes a change.

strings.text: 男の容から、女の容へと。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: From the shape of a man to a woman.

strings.text: 「ふふ……そうだね。やっぱりこの姿が気に入ってるかな？君との逢瀬を愉しむときは特に、ね」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "Heh heh...... true. Perhaps I like this form best after all? Especially when enjoying a tryst with you, that is."

strings.text: 「今度も貴様が黒幕なんだな……！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "So you are the mastermind again......!"

strings.text: 「再びこの世界――『今の』その『君』に逢うにはえらく手間取ったよ。こんな大仕掛けをしなけりゃならないほどにさ」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "It took me lots of effort to greet the 'you' of 'now'--of this world--again. So much that I had to arrange such a major upheaval."

strings.text: 「今度は何だ！？九朔のデモンベインに何を仕掛けたッ！？」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "What's your game this time!? What did you do to Kuzaku's Demonbane!?"

strings.text: 「九朔君のデモンベインだって？」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "Kuzaku's Demonbane, you said?"

strings.text: 邪神の貌が、冒涜的な嘲笑に歪んだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The Evil God's face warps into a loathsome sneer.

strings.text: 「そんなものは存在しない」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "Such a thing does not exist."

strings.text: 「……何だって？」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "......What did you say?"

strings.text: 邪神の――女の容が崩れ、幽めく。極彩色の黯黒が、焔える。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The appearance of the Evil God--of the woman--crumbles and flickers. The richly colored darkness bursts into flames.

strings.text: 「これは僕だ。僕自身だ。千の貌を持つ無貌の、そのひとつだ」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "This is me. Myself. It's one aspect of the Faceless with a thousand forms."

strings.text: 部品に群がられ、組み替えられ、変質したデモンベイン・トゥーソードを、急速に膨張した邪神――焔える黯黒が包み込んだ。極彩色の闇が躍る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The rapidly swelling Evil God--the burning darkness envelops a transmuted Demonbane Two-Sword as it is recomposed and swarmed in parts. The vibrant darkness dances.

strings.text: ――そして、俺は、理解した。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --And then, I come to a realization.

strings.text: 「今のこの僕は、文明に発展をもたらす叡智の神だ。あるときは原初の炎を、あるときは計算機を、そしてあるときは原子力を人類に与え、進化させてきた」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "I am now the god of wisdom, who brings about development to civilization. At one point, I bestowed the primordial flame on mankind; at some point, I gave them the computer; and at another point I brought atomic energy, thus allowing them to evolve."

strings.text: 耀く黯黒の機体――その貌を引き裂くように見開かれた、三つの燃える眸！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A shining, pitch-black machine--and tearing open across its face, three burning eyes!

strings.text: コレはデモンベインなんかじゃない。その真逆――『魔を断つ剣』にとっての、永遠の仇敵！ナイアルラトホテップの化身！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: This isn't Demonbane at all. It's the exact opposite--the eternal adversary of the 'Sword that Smites Evil'! An avatar of Nyarlathotep!

strings.text: 「今の僕は『機械仕掛けの悪夢』だ」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "Right now, I am 'A Clockwork Nightmare.'"

strings.text: 「ゲームキーパー？『機械仕掛けの悪夢』？ナイアルラトホテップ？」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Gamekeeper? 'A Clockwork Nightmare'? Nyarlathotep?"

strings.text: みるみる変質するデモンベイン――否、もはや機体から感じられる気配は、我の知るそれとは遠くかけ離れている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Before my vision, Demonbane is changing--no; the presence I sense from this machine is already far, far removed from the one that I know.

strings.text: 操縦室は冒涜的な角度に歪み、地獄めいた悪意が空間を満たしていた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Hellish malice is filling the air as my cockpit bends at profane angles.

strings.text: 不浄の角度から機械／奇怪な部品が降り注ぐ。雨音のように連続する金属音。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Mechanical/Strange parts pour down from impure angles. A continuous metallic clanking sounds like a rainfall.

strings.text: 「――デモンベイン、じゃない？」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "--You are not Demonbane?"

strings.text: 螺子が歯車が発条が鋼線が螺旋を描いて繰々と廻り廻り廻りながら、噛み合い、組み合わさり、人間大ほどに成長した。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Screws, gears, springs, and wires spin round and round ceaselessly as they spiral, meshing and combining until they have grown to the size of a person.

strings.text: 「そうだよ。我が愛しの怨敵デモンベインは、宇宙でたったひとつの機体さ。宇宙でたったふたり――大十字九郎とその妻アル・アジフのためだけの機体さ」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "Yes. My beloved sworn enemy, Demonbane, is a unique machine in the universe. It's a machine that exists just for the sake of only one couple in this universe--Daijuuji Kurou and his wife, Al Azif."

strings.text: 『ソレ』は、我を背後から抱き締める。ぞっとするほどに冷たい躯。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: 'It' embraces me from behind. Its body is so cold it sends a chill down my spine.

strings.text: 心臓の鼓動の代わりに伝わってくるのは、機械的な律動。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: In place of a heartbeat, a mechanical rhythm pulses against me.

strings.text: 「だから君の傍にいたのは僕だ。僕こそが君の剣であり、君の鎧だ」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "Which is why I was by your side. I was your very sword and armor."

strings.text: 『ソレ』が、我を覗き込む。艶然と微笑む女の顔――だがその半分には、巨大な時計が埋まっている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: 'It' peers into me. A female visage, grinning joyfully--yet half of it is buried in a massive clock.

strings.text: 女の硝子の瞳に、我の貌が映っている。焦点を合わせるためだろうか、瞳孔の奥、無数の歯車が忙しく駆動していた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: My face is reflected in her glassy eyes. I wonder if it is to match the focal point, but deep inside her pupils, countless gears are restlessly moving.

strings.text: 嗚呼――機械仕掛けの人間だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Ahh--a clockwork human.

strings.text: 「どんなときだって、僕は君と一緒だったんだよ……嗚呼、可愛い可愛い僕の騎士殿」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "No matter when, I was always with you...... Ah, my sweet and adorable Sir Knight."

strings.text: これがデモンベインと信じていたモノの正体だというのなら――我が騎士道の終着だというのなら――我が戦いの結末だというのなら――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: If this truly is the identity of what I thought to be Demonbane-- If this truly be the end of the line for my chivalry-- If this truly be the conclusion of my battle--

strings.text: 「総ては戯事。大十字九朔君――君もまた、『運命』という巨大な機械の、ちっぽけな部品に過ぎない」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "Everything is just a silly joke. Daijuuji Kuzaku--even you are no more than a tiny part of a massive machination called 'Fate'."

strings.text: 混沌が、優しく嘲笑う。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Chaos gently sneers at me.

strings.text: 「君の手には『魔を断つ剣』なんて握られてない」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "You never seized the [Sword that Smites Evil] in your hands."

strings.text: 「あ……ああ……ああああ……！」
strings.speaker: 九朔

strings.text: ――血の匂いは、鉄錆の臭いだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --The scent of blood is the essence of rust.

strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: " Eh?"

strings.text: 紅の少女の畸妙な動き。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The girl in red's movements turn odd.

strings.text: 撥条の切れた玩具のような。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Like a toy with a damaged spring.

strings.text: ギチリギチリギチリギチリギチリギチリ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Clank clank clank clank clank clank.

strings.text: 少女の指が、制御を失ったような、常軌を逸した動きと異様な痙攣を繰り返す。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The girl's fingers, seemingly losing their control, repeat bizarre convulsions and erratic motions.

strings.text: ブチリブチリブチリブチリブチリブチリ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Rip rip rip rip rip rip.

strings.text: 関節が千切れて、中から血まみれの針金が飛び出る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Her joints are shredded, with bloody wires popping out of her insides.

strings.text: カタカタカタカタガタガタガタガタガタガタガタガチャガチャガチャガチャガチャガチャガラガラガラガラガランガシャングシャガラガッシャン。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle rattle crash crush rattle smash.

strings.text: その暴走が全身を汚染するまで、大した時間はかからなかった。暴れるたびに少女の躰のいたる箇所から、機械の部品が零れ落ちる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It does not take long before the malfunction contaminates all of her. Each time she struggles, mechanical parts scatter from all over her body.

strings.text: 「なななななんんんんでででででででで？」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "Wwwwwhhhhyyyyyyyy?"

strings.text: 壊れた音楽盤のような聲が問う。何処からか、ラジオのような雑音混じりの聲が答える。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: She asks with a voice similar to a broken record. From somewhere, a static-laden radio-like voice responds:

strings.text: 「九朔君から君を分けたとき、存在力が足りなくてね……しょうがないから、僕の血肉を分けたんだ」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "When I split you from Kuzaku, your essence was lacking...... It couldn't be helped, so I shared some of my flesh and blood."

strings.text: 零れ落ちる。零れ落ちる。機械の部品が、少女の躰から零れ落ちる。血に濡れて、錆びた部品が。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: They spill out. And keep spilling out. Mechanical parts exude from the girl's body. They are blood-soaked rusty parts.

strings.text: 「つまり君も、僕の化身のようなものだ。君は何処までも贋作なんだよ」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "Long story short, you are like an avatar of mine. You were a fake from the get-go."

strings.text: 「わたしはだからおかあさまになってわたしはほんものの　わたしに」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "That is why I will become Mother and I will become the real me"

strings.text: 「君は捏造された悪夢。決して辿り着かない未来だ。君は何にもなれない」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "You are a fabricated nightmare. A future you will never reach. You can be nothing."

strings.text: 「ああああああああああああああ」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "Aaaaaaaaaaaaaah."

strings.text: 紅の少女の紅の瞳から、滂沱として流れ落ちる／血の涙／血まみれの螺子／血に錆びた歯車／
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: From the girl in red's scarlet eyes, bloody tears/ bloodstained screws/blood-rusted gears/roll down her cheeks in streams/

strings.text: 少女の躰がぴたりと止まった。ゆっくりと、崩れるように、紅の少女がこちらに向かって倒れてくる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Her body comes to an abrupt halt. Slowly, as though collapsing, the girl in red topples towards me.

strings.text: 俺は少女に手を伸ばそうとするが、拘束服に動きを封じられ、不様に足掻くばかりだった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I try to reach out to her, but I can only flail about ineptly since I am restrained by the straitjacket.

strings.text: 紅の少女が、砕け散る／分解する。螺子に。歯車に。発条に。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The girl in red shatters/disintegrates. Into screws. Into gears. Into springs.

strings.text: そして、血の霧に。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: And then, into a bloody mist.

strings.text: ――血の匂いは、鉄錆の臭いだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --The scent of blood is the essence of rust.

strings.text: 「斯くの如く、出番を終えた役者は壇上から降りて、舞台は幕を下ろす」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "And so the actors get off the stage after they have finished their parts, and the curtain drops."

strings.text: 「最後を飾るのは僕だ。今や自身が『機械仕掛けの神』と化したこの僕だ」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "It is I who concludes this play on a high note. Now at last, I've become the [God from the Machine] itself."

strings.text: 「機械仕掛けの悪夢――名探偵にして、人造の神を駆る、ご都合主義の寵児たる君に立ち向かう」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "A Clockwork Nightmare--standing before you, the Great Detective and darling of plot convenience who pilots the Artificial God."

strings.text: 「そのために、そのためだけに、僕はこの姿で顕れた。大十字九郎――愛しの君よ！」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "For that purpose, and for that sole purpose, I have manifested in this guise. O my dearest--Daijuuji Kurou!"

strings.text: 「さあ、物語は悪夢に螺旋禍る。在るべき未来は失われ、物語のひとつが今、僕の手に落ちる。総てを僕の愛で包み込んであげよう！」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "Here, the story spirals into a nightmare. The future that should be has been lost; now, one of the stories falls into my hands. I shall envelop all in my love!"

strings.text: 「ナイアルラトホテップ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Nyarlathotep!"

strings.text: 脳を、全身を灼く激痛。呪詛返しの魔力が、我の中で荒れ狂う。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A sharp pain burns through my brain and my whole being. The magical feedback rages within me.

strings.text: 血管が裂けて、血が迸る。噴き出る血は霧となり、二重螺旋を描いて昇り、術式を紡ぐ。血は鉄錆の臭いがした。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: My veins burst, with blood gushing out. The spouting blood turns into mist, ascending as it draws a double helix before weaving into a magic formula. That blood reeks of rust.

strings.text: 錆びついた術式が、少女の容を編む。華奢な躰が、壊れた玩具のように投げ棄てられる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The rusted magic formula weaves the shape of a girl. Her frail body is cast aside like a broken toy.

strings.text: 「……アナザーブラッド」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "......Another Blood."

strings.text: 「もともとソレは君の一部だ。長い間借りっぱなしだったが、お返しするよ」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "Originally, she was a part of you. Though I had been borrowing her for quite some time, I'll give her back to you."

strings.text: か細い、脆弱な呼吸が、アナザーブラッドの咽喉から漏れる。何も映さない空虚な瞳から、血の涙を散々と流し、何も無い虚空に向かって手を伸ばす。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A weak, fragile breath escapes Another Blood's throat. Tears of blood overflow from her vacant, hollow eyes as she reaches out towards nothing.

strings.text: 我はアナザーブラッドの傍らに寄った。ぞっとするほどに軽い躰を、胸に抱く。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I move to Another Blood's side. I hold her body, so light it sends a chill through me, against my chest.

strings.text: 何も映さない空虚な瞳が、覗き込む我の姿を映す。光が戻る。紅蓮に燃える憎悪の炎。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Those blank, lifeless eyes reflect my appearance as I peer into them. Light returns to her gaze. Flames of hatred burn bright red.

strings.text: アナザーブラッドの伸ばした手が、我の胸に触れる。我の胸の中へと沈み込む。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Another Blood's outstretched hand touches my chest. It sinks into my chest.

strings.text: 深く。深く。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Deep. Deep.

strings.text: てのひらが、心臓に触れる。胸を締めつけられるような痛みが、我を苛む。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Her palm feels my heart. A pain as though my chest is being squeezed torments me.

strings.text: だけど空虚な少女の力はあまりに弱く、剥き身の心臓すら握り潰せそうになかった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Nevertheless, the strength of the empty girl is so utterly weak that it seems she can't even crush my bare heart.

strings.text: 「……ぁ……ぁぁ……おまえ……なんか……おまえ、なんかぁぁ……っ！」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "......Ah...... ahh...... Someone...... like you...... Someone like yooou......!"

strings.text: 虫の息の呼吸から、ありったけの呪詛を搾り出す。不様に泣きじゃくりながら、幼稚な憎悪をぶつけてくる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: With her dying breath, she squeezes out a curse with all her might. She hurls her immature abhorrence at me as she sobs woefully.

strings.text: てのひらは、さらに深く。深く。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Her palm goes deeper. And deeper.

strings.text: 融け合い／蕩け合う。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: We unify/melt into each other.

strings.text: 無力な呪詛が、我の中心に触れる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: That powerless curse touches my heart.

strings.text: 戦慄するほどの一体感。そして、我は知る。アナザーブラッドの総てを。何ひとつ余さず。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: There is a sense of unity, enough to make my blood run cold. And then I know. All about Another Blood. Not a single thing left out.

strings.text: ネクロノミコン血液言語訳
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Necronomicon Blood Language Edition.

strings.text: 魔導書残酷地獄絵巻
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Grimoire: Cruel Scroll of Hell.

strings.text: 原作　吾舞弗惡流覇坐唖怒
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Original work: Abdul Alhazred.

strings.text: 巻頭歌この子は　シんでいるけど　シんでいないのです。気がとおくなるほどの時の最涯ではシぬことすら　シにたえてしまうのです。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Opening couplet: That is not dead which can eternal lie. And with strange aeons even death may die.

strings.text: 「あたしは蛭子なので御座います。あたしは堕胎されるや否や揺籃であり柩であるこの箱庭に納められたので御座います。嗚呼、この世は地獄なのでゴザイマス」
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: "I am a leech-child. No sooner was I aborted than I was placed within this miniature garden, at once my cradle and my coffin. Alas, this world is hell."

strings.text: ――与えられた世界は、牢獄だった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --The world that was given to her was a prison.

strings.text: 少女ひとりを捏造するためだけに捏造された世界の、捏造された過去。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A fabricated past of a made-up world to forge a single girl.

strings.text: ゲームキーパーが彼女に用意した、かりそめの寄処。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The Gamekeeper has arranged a temporary shelter for her.

strings.text: 「ガハッ！　グゥゥ――ッ！　ギィィィ……アアアアアアアアアア……！　ヒィアアアアアアア！」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "Gah! Guuuh--! Grrrr...... Aaaaaaaaaargh......! Hyaaaaaaah!"

strings.text: 「イタイイタイ　ヤメテ　ウゴカナイデ　クルシイ」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "It hurts, it hurts! Stop it! Don't move! It's painful!"

strings.text: 「アグ……グゥア……アァァ……アアアア……ギャアアァアアアアアア――――――――ッ！」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "Agh...... Guuah...... Aaah...... Aaaargh...... Gyaaaaaaaaaah--------!"

strings.text: 「イタイ……イタイ……ヤメテ……ヤメテ……ヒドイコトシナイデ……アアア――ッ……」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "It hurts...... It hurts...... Stop...... Stop it...... Don't do anything cruel to me...... Ahhh--......"

strings.text: 「ガアアア……アガア……ヒィィ……ヒィヤアア……ヒギィィィアアア……アアアア……ギャアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアアア」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "Gaaaah...... Agaah...... Eek...... Hyaaah...... Hygyyyyaaaah...... Ahhhh...... Gyahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!"

strings.text: 「ゴメンナサイゴメンナサイゴメンナサイゴメンナサイゴメンナサイゴメンナサイ　ユルシテクダサイ　ユルシテユルシテェ――ッ　ヒィィィィッ」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド
strings.translated: "I'm sorry I'm sorry I'm sorry I'm sorry I'm sorry I'm sorry! Please forgive me...... please forgive me, please forgive me--Eeeeek!"

strings.text: 「ヒュ――ッ……ヒュルルルゥ……ゼェ――――ッ……ウグァア……ァァァァ……」
strings.speaker: アナザーブラッド

strings.text: 其処は取って付けたような、陳腐な地獄だ。陳腐ゆえに何の迷いもない、ただ悪意と悪辣と悪徳を無邪気に詰め込んだ、純真無垢な地獄だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: This place was a tacked-on, cliche hell. There was no indecision because of its cliched nature. It was a sincere, pure hell filled with malice, wickedness and vice.

strings.text: その宇宙はただ少女ひとりを虐待して、拷問して、凌辱して、玩弄するためだけに存在していた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: This universe existed solely to abuse, torture, violate, and toy with a single young girl.

strings.text: 人間が想像し得る限りのあらゆる悪が存在し、そしてそれを超えるものは何ひとつなかった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: All the evils mankind could imagine were there, and nothing exceeded them.

strings.text: その幼稚さこそがまた極上の悪意だった。蝶の翅を毟り、蟻の巣に熱湯を注ぎ込む、そんな子供じみた残虐性のみが宇宙唯一の意思だった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: That very childishness was also the apex of malevolence. Like plucking the wings from butterflies or pouring boiling water into anthills, such childish cruelty was the only will in this universe.

strings.text: 品性下劣な神が描き殴った、知性の欠片も感じさせない地獄。その唯一の住人が、少女だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A hell devoid of even a shred of intelligence, scribbled out by a lowlife God with a vulgar character. The only resident was a young girl.

strings.text: 「だが、しかし。地獄、悪夢は喜劇名詞。宇宙は書割。登場人物は皆、端役。総ては単なる舞台の演目に過ぎない」
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: "And yet, however: Hell and nightmares are mere farcical words. The universe is a painted backdrop. Every character is a bit player. All of it is nothing more than a play on a stage."

strings.text: そう。何もかもが虚構だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Yes. Everything is fiction.

strings.text: 悪意も悪辣も悪徳も苦痛も悲痛も激痛も残酷も過酷も冷酷も汚辱も恥辱も凌辱も恐怖も狂気も兇悪も、血、肉、骨、胎、臓、糞、尿、血、血、血、血、血、血、血、血、血、血、血、血、血、血、血、血、血、血。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Malice, cruelty, depravity; agony, anguish, torment; brutality, harshness, ruthlessness; defilement, disgrace, violation; terror, madness, atrocity; blood, flesh, bones, womb, viscera, feces, urine, blood, blood, blood, blood, blood, blood, blood, blood, blood, blood, blood, blood, blood, blood, blood, blood, blood, blood.

strings.text: 何もかも、存在感を持たない薄っぺらな虚構。虚偽。虚実。虚飾。虚無。ウツロ。自分自身ですらも。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Everything was flimsy fiction devoid of substance. Falsehood. Fabrication. Pretense. Nothingness. Emptiness. Even herself.

strings.text: 悪意よりも悪辣よりも悪徳よりも苦痛よりも悲痛よりも激痛よりも残酷よりも過酷よりも冷酷よりも汚辱よりも恥辱よりも凌辱よりも恐怖よりも狂気よりも兇悪よりも――でっち上げの地獄を構築する舞台道具の何よりも、そのウツロこそが絶望だった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Even malice, even viciousness, even vice, even agony, even bitterness, even pain, even cruelty, even rigor, even ruthlessness, even disgrace, even shame, even rape, even terror, even insanity, even brutality-- despair sprang not from the props that constructed this fabricated hell, but from the emptiness at its source.

strings.text: 『私』は虚構であり――地獄に縋らなければ、自己の確立すらままならず――そんな地獄の責め苦すら容易く劣化し、虚無が嘲笑うように『私』をごっそりと抉っていく。空虚を穿つ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: 'I' am fictional--unable to even establish myself without depending on this hell--even pains of such a hell merely erode, and nothingness persists in hollowing out pieces of 'me' completely as though mocking me. Boring through the void.

strings.text: ウツロが荒れ狂う壷の中で、少女は渇いてゆく。飢えてゆく。癒されぬ渇望が、飢餓が、かくも豊潤な怨嗟を育てる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Within the jar where nonexistence raged like a storm, the girl thirsted. She was starving. Unquenchable thirst and unsatisfied hunger bred such abundant resentment.

strings.text: 違えた血――少女の容をした、血の彩をした、名前すら無い呪詛の塊。ゲームキーパーが精製した極上の蠱毒だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The Wrong Blood-- An unnamed mass of curses, in the form of a blood-dyed young girl. The finest poison there is, refined by the Gamekeeper.

strings.text: そして。そして。嗚呼。嗚呼。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: And. And. Ah. Ah.

strings.text: 嗚呼――我が忌まわしき魂の双児よ。我が血より分かたれたおまえの怨嗟と呪詛は、矢張り血を辿るのだ。血を呪い、だがしかし、血に焦がれるのだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Alas--O the damned twin of my soul. Your resentment and curse, separated from my blood, still trace back to our bloodline. You curse blood, and yet you yearn for it.

strings.text: 嗚呼。嗚呼。だけど。だけど。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Ah. Ah. But. But.

strings.text: 嗚呼――我が忌まわしき魂の双児よ。その罪の源泉は、元よりお前の内にあったのだろうか？
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Alas--O the damned twin of my soul. Was the source of that sin within you all along?

strings.text: そもそもは――我は――我が――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: From the start--I--I was--

strings.text: アナザーブラッドの手が、我の胸から抜け落ちる。我の心から、彼女の心が抜け落ちる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Another Blood's hand comes off my chest. Her heart disconnects from mine.

strings.text: 急速に失われる一体感。胸に大穴が開いたような喪失感。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: We are quickly losing our sense of unity. The feeling of loss is like a large hole opened up in my heart.

strings.text: 幽かにあった力が――虫の吐息が、ついに消えた。その瞳は、もう何も映していない。光も無く、闇すら無く――ただウツロがぽっかりと空いているだけだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Her weakened strength--her last breath--finally vanishes. Those eyes reflect nothing anymore. There is no light, not even darkness--it's just an empty void.

strings.text: 『我』もまたウツロに、ごっそりと持って行かれた。我が半身はこうして、朽ちて、果てた。もう二度と、取り戻すことは出来ない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: 'I' too am completely taken away by the nothingness. Thus rotted and perished my half. No longer can it be regained.

strings.text: 喪失われた。永遠に。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It is gone. Forever.

strings.text: 少女の貌に水滴が落ちた。それは血に濡れた頬を伝い、白い軌跡を残してゆく。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A droplet lands upon the girl's face. It rolls down her blood-soaked cheek, leaving a white trail behind.

strings.text: 雫はさらに止め処なく、降り注ぐ。少女を染める血を洗い流してゆく。ぽつり。ぽつり。ぽつり。次から次へと。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: An endless stream of drops continues to trickle. They proceed to clean off the blood that dyes her face. Drop by drop. Drop by drop. Drop by drop. One after another.

strings.text: 我は、自分が泣いていることに気付いた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I realize I am crying.

strings.text: 「我は……我は……っ！今までいったい何を……っ！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "I...... I......! What have I been doing all this time......?!"

strings.text: ……これは『我』だ。我自身だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: ......This is 'me'. She is 'myself'.

strings.text: 弱くてちっぽけな、つまらない我そのものだ。最初から分かっていたことではないか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: My very frail, tiny, and worthless self. Wasn't that obvious since the beginning?

strings.text: それなのに……何を今更！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: But even so...... what's the point of it now?!

strings.text: アナザーブラッドは、別のモノガタリなどではない。在り得ざる、もうひとりの我などではない。悪徳を為す、我の可能性などでは断じてない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Another Blood is not a different story. She is not my impossible, alternate self. Nor is she a possibility of me committing wrongdoings, not a chance.

strings.text: こいつは……我の『悪』だ。我の『悪』そのものだ。我の中に今もなお確と存在する『悪』の顕現だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: She is...... my 'evil'. My 'evil' itself. The manifestation of the 'sin' that certainly still exists within me.

strings.text: ――なのに、大十字九朔。貴様のやってきたことは、いったい何だ？
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --Despite this, Daijuuji Kuzaku. What in the world did you do?

strings.text: 烏滸がましくも騎士を騙り、皆を守護ると妄言を弄し――それなのに何だ、この醜態は！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: You deluded yourself into believing you were a Knight, bragging about protecting others, all the while on your high horse--and yet, how do you explain this shameful display?!

strings.text: 貴様のやってきたことは、単なる暴走だ。憎悪のままに敵を斬り、怨みに固執して大十字九郎に楯突いた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Your behavior is nothing more than throwing a tantrum. You cut down your enemies out of spite, rebelled against Daijuuji Kurou while clinging to your grudge.

strings.text: 己の悪から目を背け、くだらぬ自尊心を守る――そのためだけに。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: For that reason alone--you disregarded your own evil to defend your silly pride.

strings.text: 挙げ句がこれだ！過去の世界に破滅的な災禍をもたらし、そして今、未来の可能性を根絶やしにしようとしている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: And this is the consequence! You brought a catastrophic calamity upon the past world, and now you're about to eradicate the possibilities of the future.

strings.text: ――総て我のせいだ！総ては、我の歪んだ心根が呼び寄せた悪夢ではないか！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --This is all my fault! Isn't everything a nightmare invoked by my twisted heart?!

strings.text: ミニミイカンンイチストテニカクラナカトリナモコイスニミキチクタクチクタククニトリニハイトイソラミシトミナモコイスニミキチクタクチクタクニカトカラセセイシトクラスカミイヒイスカラキラチキチニミ　テクイミカクイラリシモチミシニイシ
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Ninety years without slumbering Tick, tock, tick, tock, His life seconds numbering, Tick, tock, tick, tock, It stopp'd short, never to go again When the old man died.

strings.text: 秩序立った無秩序、異界の律動が幾重にも木霊して、耳を――魂を――聾する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Ordered disorder, otherworldly rhythms echo in layers, deafening my ears--and--my soul.

strings.text: 機械化する宇宙。何もかもが、この意味を持たぬ混沌の機械を動かすための、部品と化していく。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It is an automatized universe. Everything transforms into parts to run this illogical Chaos Machina.

strings.text: 螺子。歯車。発条。我もまた同じ。アナザーブラッド同様、邪神の陰謀を組み立てる小さな部品に過ぎない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Screws. Gears. Springs. Even I am the same. Just like Another Blood, I'm merely an insignificant part that composes the Evil God's scenario.

strings.text: 俺は、誰かを守護る、騎士なんかじゃなかった。そんな気高い精神なんて、これぽっちもありはしないんだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I was never a Knight who protects everyone. I don't have anything like a noble spirit at all.

strings.text: 「うっ……ぐっ……ぐぅぅ……！」
strings.speaker: 九朔

strings.text: 猛烈な吐き気に襲われる。体内に充満する血の匂い――否。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I'm struck by severe nausea. The scent of blood permeates inside my body--no.

strings.text: ――鉄錆の、臭い。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --It's the foul odor of iron rust.

strings.text: 「あああああ……」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Aaaaah......"

strings.text: 全身に浮かび上がる黒い汚染。我の躰は錆びついていた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Black contamination emerges all over me. My body is rusting.

strings.text: 襤褸々々と粉になった鉄錆が零れ落ちる。襤褸々々と崩れてゆく。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Iron rust comes off me, scattering into dust. I'm starting to fall apart.

strings.text: これが、結末だ。不様で滑稽な道化に相応しい、不様で滑稽な結末。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: This is the end. A humiliating and comical ending worthy of a humiliated and comical clown.

strings.text: 我自身も、腕の中のこの少女も、我が我である存在は総て、朽ちて消える。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I, myself, this girl in my arms, and everything that makes up my being will decay and cease to exist.

strings.text: 我こそが間違った血――間違った未来なのだ。無くなってしまえば良い。零になってしまえば良い。総ては、混沌の機械が見る悪夢に過ぎない――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I am the defective blood--the wrong future. It's fine if I end up fading away. It's fine if I end up returning to zero. For all is nothing but a nightmare seen by the Chaos Machina--

strings.text: 「……畜生……畜生ぉぉ……！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "......Damnit...... Damnit all......!"

strings.text: 涙が止まらない。震えが止まらない。歯の根が合わず、がちがち鳴り続ける。顔は涙と鼻水と鉄錆でグチャグチャだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: My tears won't stop. I can't stop shaking. I'm unable to clench my teeth as they keep chattering. My face is sloppy with tears, snot, and rust.

strings.text: 惨めだ。酷く惨めだ。この期に及んで、なおも不様を晒す気か。散り際すらこうも見苦しく、泣き喚くのか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Pathetic. Utterly pathetic. Even at this stage, do you still intend to disgrace yourself? Even in your final moments, will you wail so unsightly?

strings.text: こんな貧弱な魂に、どうして騎士道が宿っていると勘違いできたのだろうか。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: How could you misjudge that such a feeble spirit would embody chivalry?

strings.text: だけど。それでも。我は――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: But. But still. I--

strings.text: 「……消えたくない」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "......I don't want to disappear."

strings.text: 自分の存在が無かったことになる。零になってしまう。アナザーブラッドを蝕んだものと同じ、抗いようのない恐怖と絶望。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: My existence will end up perishing. It will become nought. The same irresistible fear and despair that gnawed at Another Blood.

strings.text: こんなのは嫌だ。こんな惨めなまま、消えてしまいたくない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I want nothing like this. I don't want to end up disappearing in such a miserable state.

strings.text: 誇り、自信、自尊心――あらゆる虚飾を剥ぎ取られた我に残った、それが唯一の本心だった。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Pride, confidence, self-esteem--stripped of all these pretentious traits, it's the sole genuine feeling I have left.

strings.text: 我は、最低だ。不様に滅びるのが嫌だから、不様に足掻く。全く以って、救い難い。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I am the worst. I don't want to fall disgracefully, so I struggle pathetically. It's all hopeless.

strings.text: だけど。だけど。それでも。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Still. Still. Nevertheless.

strings.text: それでも、我は救われたいのだ！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Nevertheless, I wish to be saved!

strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Somebody......"

strings.text: 誰か。誰か。誰か。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Somebody. Someone. Anyone.

strings.text: 誰でも良い。何でも良い。どんな陳腐な奇跡だって構わない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Anyone will do. Anything will do. I don't care how cliched a miracle it might be.

strings.text: 我を……我等を……このウツロな地獄から、救い出してくれ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Please save me...... save us...... from this hollow hell.

strings.text: 誰か。誰か。誰か――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Somebody. Someone. Anyone--

strings.text: 「誰か……助けて……ッ！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Somebody...... help us......!"

strings.text: 「助けるに……決まってんだろうがッッッッ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "I'll save you...... isn't that obvious!"

strings.text: その声は、混沌の中心で、耳を聾する如何なる音よりも高らかに響いた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Amidst the chaos, his voice rings out, louder than any ear-shattering sound.

strings.text: アナザーブラッドの呪縛から解き放たれて、俺は立ち上がる。錆び付いた拘束服が襤褸々々と崩れ落ちた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Freed from Another Blood's binding spell, I stand up. The rusted blood jacket crumbles.

strings.text: 事態は何も改善していない。アルは消えて、デモンベインは動かせない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: But we are not out of the woods yet. Al's gone, and Demonbane is immobile.

strings.text: そしてナイアルラトホテップ――『機械仕掛けの悪夢』は総てを自らの機関に組み込もうとしている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: And Nyarlathotep--[Nightmare from the Machine]--is trying to assimilate everything into its system.

strings.text: まったくもって、打つ手なしだ。クソッタレ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: As a matter of fact, we're done for. Shit.

strings.text: だけど。だけどだ。それでもなお――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: But. But, hey... Nonetheless--

strings.text: 「大十字……九郎？」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Daijuuji...... Kurou?"

strings.text: 声が聴こえてしまったのだ。想いが伝わってしまったのだ。理解してしまったのだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I heard his voice. His feeling has been conveyed to me. I knew it right away.

strings.text: ――助けを求めて泣いている子どもが、此処に居るのだと。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --There's a child here, crying for help.

strings.text: 「後味悪ィじゃねえかよ、そういうの……！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Stuff like this would leave an awful aftertaste, wouldn't it......!"

strings.text: よろしくない。そいつだけは大変よろしくない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: That's no good. That one thing is really no good at all.

strings.text: コメカミはズキズキするわ、うなじはジリジリするわ、胸はムカムカするわ、心臓はバクバクするわ、胃はシクシクするわで散々だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: My temples are throbbing, the back of my neck is burning, my chest is queasy, my heart is pounding, and my stomach is aching--I'm a total wreck.

strings.text: 視界が灼ける。耳鳴りがする。鼻の奥がきな臭い。舌が乾く。咽喉が渇く。胸の奥が熱くて、腹の底が冷たい。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: My vision is burning. My ears are ringing. There's a burnt smell hitting my nostrils. And my tongue is dry. My throat is parched. I feel hot deep in my chest and cold in the pit of my stomach.

strings.text: こんなのは嫌だ。大嫌いだ。まったくもって不愉快極まる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I hate this. I fucking hate this. It's absolutely and extremely annoying.

strings.text: それなのに、そんななのに、たかが打つ手がない程度のことでいちいち手をこまねいてられるか！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: But even then, despite all this, you expect me to sit on my ass over something as trivial as running out of options!?

strings.text: 「……足掻くんだね。大十字九郎、やっぱり君は何処までも足掻くんだね。たかが人の分際で」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "......You're struggling, aren't you? As expected, you struggle no matter where you go, Daijuuji Kurou. Even though you're a mere human being."

strings.text: 「……嘲笑ってんじゃねえぞ！たかが神の分際で！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "......Don't you ridicule me! You're only some lousy god!"

strings.text: 「待ってろ……今、このクソ戯けたクソ機械をぶっ壊して、そのクソにやけたクソ面ァぶん殴ってやる！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Just sit tight...... 'Cause I'll smash this damned, stupid machine and smack the fuck outta that stupid, shitty grin of yours!"

strings.text: 「何を……何を言ってるんだ、大十字九郎？」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "What...... What are you saying, Daijuuji Kurou?"

strings.text: 混沌機械の中枢、『機械仕掛けの悪夢』の核を見据える。真っ直ぐに。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I fix my gaze on the nucleus of [Nightmare from the Machine], the center of the Chaos Machina. Straight ahead.

strings.text: 俺は、訴える。その向こうに囚われているはずの少年に向かって。真っ直ぐに。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I call out to the boy who must be trapped on the other side. Straight ahead.

strings.text: 「――泣くな、九朔」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "--Don't cry, Kuzaku!"

strings.text: 「まだ終わってない……終わらせはしないさ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "It's not over yet...... I won't allow it to end!"

strings.text: 「……莫迦な！今さら、あんたに何が出来るんだッ！？」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "......Ridiculous! What can you do at this stage!?"

strings.text: 「――何だって出来るさ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "--I can do anything."

strings.text: 「……ッ！　巫山戯るなァ！何の力も無いくせにッッ！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "......! Quit screwing around! You don't even have any strength!"

strings.text: 「無駄だ無駄だ無駄だ！無駄なんだッ！　何もかもッ！全部……全部、無駄だったんだっっっっ！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "It's useless, useless, useless! It's all useless! Everything! Everything...... Everything was useless!"

strings.text: 「……てめえがふざけんな、バカタレッッッッッ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "......You're the one who needs to quit screwing around, you dumbass!"

strings.text: 「九朔……てめえ、俺とアルの息子なんだってな……」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Kuzaku...... You said you're Al and my son, yeah.....?"

strings.text: 「お父さんは、お前をそんな軟弱な子どもに育てた憶えはありませんっっっっ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Papa doesn't remember raising you to be such a weak-ass child!"

strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: *Silence*.

strings.text: 「貴様に育てられた憶えなど最初から無いわ糞親父ィィィィィ――――ッ！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "I don't remember ever being raised by you, YOU SHITTY OLD MAAAAAAN----!"

strings.text: 「な、何が御父様だ！　き、気色悪ぅッ！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Wha-What do you mean, 'Papa'!? T-That makes my skin crawl!"

strings.text: 「――貴様は喋るな口を開くな呼吸を禁ずる深刻な変態が空気感染して世界中で猛威を振るう黒死病以来の大惨事だ！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Don't you speak, don't open your mouth, and don't even breathe! This perverted deviant is the worst catastrophe since the Black Death that spreads through the air, wreaking havoc across the world!"

strings.text: 「酷いッ！？　父の大いなる愛をないがしろにッ！？……しかも、言うに事欠いて糞呼ばわりだァッ！？てめえ、父親にンな口利いて良いと思ってんのか馬鹿息子！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "You meanie! How dare you neglect the great love of your own father!? ......On top of that, don't you have anything better to say than calling me shitty!? You think you can speak to your daddy like that, my dumbass of a son!"

strings.text: 「棄てたくせに！　棄てたくせに棄てたくせに棄てたくせにィ――――ッ！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Even though you abandoned me! You abandoned me, abandoned me, abandoned meeee----!"

strings.text: 「まだやってねえことで責めんじゃねえよ！これだから未来人はっ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Don't blame me for something I haven't done yet! This is the problem with time travelers!"

strings.text: 「都合良く父親面する貴様が何を抜かすか！――殺す！　やはり貴様の首だけは、我がこの手で斬り落としてくれる！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "What the hell are you talking about when you're conveniently acting like my father!? --I'll kill you! As I thought, I'll just cut your head off myself!"

strings.text: 「ゲェァ――ハハハハハハハッ！（※註：主人公の笑い）ずいぶん調子が出てきたじゃねえか小僧ォッ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "GEEA--HAHAHAHAHAHAHA! (*Note: This is the laughter of our MC) You're feeling much better now, aren't you kiddo!?"

strings.text: 「そうだなぁッ……？てめえは最初会ったときから生意気だと思ってたんだ！ここらで徹底的に親子の語らいと洒落込もうじゃねえかァ！？――主に暴力言語で！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Oh yeah......? I thought you were a cocky brat from the moment we met! Isn't it time for us to have some serious parent-child communication here!? --Mainly through verbal abuse!"

strings.text: 「は……はは……ハハハハハッ！　面白いじゃねえかこの人格と知性が吐き気を催すほどに退化した家庭内暴力野郎め！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Heh...... Haha...... Hahahahaha! Isn't this hilarious, this domestic-abusing bastard has regressed both his personality and intellect so much that I can't help but feel sick to my stomach!"

strings.text: 「良かろう、貴様の斬殺屍体を明朝のアーカム・アドヴァタイザーの社会面に提供してくれるわッ！」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Fine then, I'll do you a favor by donating your slain carcass to the local news page of tomorrow morning's Arkham Advertiser!"

strings.text: 「おっしゃあああ！　今から殴りに行ってやるからな！逃げんじゃねえぞ馬鹿息子ッ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "HELL YEAHHHH! I'm comin' over right now to beat some sense into you! Don't run away, my dumbass son!"

strings.text: 「必ず。そっちに。行く」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "I will. Definitely. Come to you."

strings.text: デモンベインのコクピットから身を乗り出し、大十字九郎は外に――混沌機械に埋め尽くされた異界に身を晒す。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Leaning out of Demonbane's cockpit, Daijuuji Kurou exposes himself to the outside--to the strange world filled with the machinery of Chaos.

strings.text: 手には二挺の魔銃。それだけが、今の彼に残された武器。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: In his hands are a pair of magic guns. These are the only weapons he has left at the moment.

strings.text: 「うおりゃああああああ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "UORYAAAAAAAH!"

strings.text: デモンベインの上から飛び降りる。一瞬の躊躇も無く。一片の恐れも無く。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: He jumps off Demonbane. Without a moment's hesitation. Without even a hint of fear.

strings.text: 巨大な歯車の上に着地する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: He lands atop a giant gear.

strings.text: すかさず螺子／歯車／発条／配管／鉄骨／導線／装甲／螺子／歯車／発条／配管／鉄骨／導線／装甲が降り注ぐ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Immediately, screws/gears/springs/pipes/frames/ wires/armor/screws/gears/springs/pipes/frames/ wires/armor rain down upon him.

strings.text: ギリギリのところで飛び退く。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: He narrowly leaps back.

strings.text: 躱して
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: He dodges,

strings.text: 躱して
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: dodges,

strings.text: 躱して
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: dodges,

strings.text: 躱す。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: and dodges.

strings.text: 複数の螺子が太腿に突き刺さる。鋼線が頬をかすめ、鮮血が飛び散る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Multiple screws pierce his thigh. Wires graze his cheek, scattering fresh blood.

strings.text: ――意に介さず。大十字九郎は、走る。こっちに向かって。我の元へと。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --Yet he doesn't mind. Daijuuji Kurou runs. On his way here. Towards me.

strings.text: 「あははははっ！九郎君……君はやはり素晴らしく愛おしい！」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "Ahahahaha! Oh, Kurou...... You're still as wonderful and precious as ever!"

strings.text: クンチノナミイミミンチトナモチツナミニチクタク　チクタクラマニニトチミミカラリカナトンラミニチクタク　チクタクニモチクチモラナキラノチミチニトラミラカラノイニ
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: One hundred years without slumbering Tick, tock, tick, tock Along with my grandfather Tick, tock, tick, tock Now the clock will run no more

strings.text: 耳障りな、蜜蜂の羽音にも似た機械音を響かせて、無数の部品が大十字九郎に怒涛のように押し寄せる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Countless parts surge onto Daijuuji Kurou like raging waves as they emit a jarring, mechanical noise similar to the buzzing of honeybees.

strings.text: 螺子／歯車／発条／配管／鉄骨／導線／装甲の雪崩れは、押し寄せながら精密に組み合わさり、噛み合わされ、築き上げられ、無数のヒトガタとなる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The avalanche of screws/gears/springs/pipes/ frames/wires/armor rushes forward, precisely combining, engaging, and forming into innumerable humanoid figures.

strings.text: 機械人の軍勢。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: An army of mechanical men.

strings.text: 「チクショウが！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Motherfucker!"

strings.text: 二挺魔銃が吼える。しかし術衣形態になれない以上、今の彼には戦力が足りない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The two magic pistols roar. However, since he cannot transform into Magius Style, right now, his combat prowess is far from enough.

strings.text: 射撃の精度が足りない。術の錬度が足りない。運動系機能の遅さ／鈍さは目も当てられない。肉体の強度は致命的な脆さだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: His shooting accuracy is low. His sorcery skills are lacking. The slowness/sluggishness of his motor system's function is beyond belief. The strength of his body is fatally weak.

strings.text: だが大十字九郎は征く。機械仕掛けの軍隊の只中／撃ち抜かれる機械人／砕け降り注ぐ螺子、歯車、発条、鋼線／わずかに拓かれた血路を一直線に。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: But Daijuuji Kurou marches on. In the midst of the clockwork army/a Tick-Tock Man is shot through/dropping broken pieces of screws, gears, springs, and wires/heading straight down the barely opened path.

strings.text: 迫る迫る押し迫る機械機械機械機械機械機械機械機械機械機械機械機械を撃って撃って撃って撃って撃って撃って撃って撃って撃って撃って撃ち砕き撃ち漏らし「歯」車で出来た「牙」が首筋に／鮮血／
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Shoot shoot shoot shoot shoot shoot shoot shoot shoot shoot the approaching advancing marching machinery machinery machinery machinery machinery machinery machinery machinery machinery machinery machinery machinery shatter missed a shot "teeth" of a "gear" on the neck/fresh blood/

strings.text: 「ぐぅああああっ！この……野郎ぉっ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Guuaaaargh! You...... son of a bitch!"

strings.text: 銃底で機械人の顔面を打ち砕き、転がって逃れる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: He smashes the face of a Tick-Tock Man with his gunstock and turns over to evade.

strings.text: 転がりながらの装弾／もどかしいほどに遅い／立ち上がり、流れる血にも構わず撃つ撃つ撃つ／どうせ一秒にもならない時間稼ぎを無理矢理に積み重ねる刹那から刹那への綱渡り。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Reloading while rolling/irritatingly slow/stand up and open fire fire fire, ignoring the dripping blood/ constantly treading a tightrope, while struggling to buy some time even for another second.

strings.text: 螺子が突き刺さる。歯車が噛み千切る。発条が引き千切る。鋼線が引き裂く。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Screws pierce into him. Gears chew chunks out of him. Springs tear him apart. Steel wires rip his flesh.

strings.text: 肉が裂ける。血が噴き出る。力が抜けて膝を突く。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: His flesh is torn. His blood spurts out. His strength falters, and he falls to his knees.

strings.text: すかさず襲いかかる巨大な歯車を何とか躱し、圧し掛かってくる機械人の口に銃口を捻じ込み、撃ち抜く。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: As he manages to avoid the incoming giant gear without hesitation, he then shoves the muzzle into the mouth of a Tick-Tock Man that begins to push down on him, blasting it.

strings.text: ガタガタと笑う膝に鞭打って、なおも走る――飛来する螺子螺子螺子――腕で顔を庇う／突き刺さる螺子螺子螺子――痛みに気取られる。もつれて、転ぶ――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Forcing his trembling knees to keep running-- flying screws screws screws--shielding his face with his arms/piercing screws screws screws-- feeling the pain. Getting tangled up and tripping--

strings.text: それを戦闘と呼ぶには不様過ぎた。技は無く、術も無く、策は何ひとつとして無く――大十字九郎は、ただただ己が血と肉と骨で抗っていた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It is way too amateurish to be called a battle. There is no technique, no skill, and not even a single strategy-- Daijuuji Kurou is only resisting with his own flesh, blood, and bones.

strings.text: 圧倒的な戦力差――という表現では生温い。今や世界そのものが大十字九郎の敵なのだ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The difference in their fighting strength is overwhelming--saying that would be an understatement. Now, the world itself is Daijuuji Kurou's enemy.

strings.text: 総ての希望は奪われて、あらゆる未来は刈り取られ、かくして絶望だけが世界を統べる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: All hopes are taken away, all futures are reaped, and thus only despair dominates the world.

strings.text: しかし。それでも、なお。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Yet. Nonetheless.

strings.text: 「――何故なんだ？」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "--Just why?"

strings.text: 大十字九郎は止まらない。ただの一度たりとも、ただの一歩たりとも、後退しない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Daijuuji Kurou does not stop. He does not retreat, nor does he take a step back, not even a single one.

strings.text: ただ、走る。前へ。真っ直ぐに。我の元へと。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: He simply runs. Forward. Straight head. Heading towards me.

strings.text: 入り混じり入り乱れ混乱し困惑し渦を巻く疑問疑問疑問。言い尽くせぬ想いの数々、理解の追いつかぬ思考のことごとくは、やがてたった一つの問いへと結晶した。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Question after question after question spiral into a jumbled mixture of confusion and bewilderment. Numerous inexpressible feelings and all incomprehensible thoughts finally form into a single question.

strings.text: 叫ぶ――堰を切る想い――もはや止めようもなく――それは責め問う声として。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A cry--an emotional outburst-- No longer will it be stopped--it becomes an accusatory voice--

strings.text: 「何故、あんたは、闘えるんだ！？」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "Why do you fight!?"

strings.text: 俺は、今こそ答えよう。責め問う子らの想いに応えよう。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I will give my answer now. I will respond to the feelings of the children who questioned me.

strings.text: 「あのなぁ……九朔。子どもが泣いて『おしまい』なんて後味悪ィお話――胸糞悪ィって思うんだよ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Look...... Kuzaku. A story that rubs me the wrong way is when the child cries and it goes like 'The End'--I find it sickening, you know."

strings.text: 子らは、それを物語と呼んだ。子らは、それは悪夢と言った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The children called it a story. The children said it was a nightmare.

strings.text: 「ふざけるな。くだらねえ。んなモン俺は認めねえ」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Cut the crap. What a load of bullshit. As if I'ma accept that."

strings.text: 「悪夢だの地獄だの絶望だの……そんなものは、ほんのちっぽけな欠片に過ぎない！　そいつは世界の仕組みなんかじゃあない！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Stuff such as nightmares, hell, despair, or whatever...... those kinds of things are purely trivial parts! They aren't the mechanism of the world or anything!"

strings.text: 子らを苦しめたのが、何なのかを俺は知らない。親の――俺の行いこそが、総ての悪夢の胎なのかも知れない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I don't know what brought suffering to these kids. Maybe their father's--my very actions--are the catalyst of this entire nightmare.

strings.text: だけど俺は未来を悔いる術を知らない。ならば俺は「現在」に立ち――「今」こそ子らに伝えよう。俺が信じる物語を。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: But I have no idea how to repent for the future. In that case, I will stand in the 'present'--and tell my kids 'now'. The story I believe in.

strings.text: 「泣くな、九朔！　お前の物語は終わっちゃあいない！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Don't cry, Kuzaku! Your story is not over yet!"

strings.text: にねとい  ゑある     すうヰとほうとするむべ         りねぐチクタク　チクタクえぃちヰすりぃふぇす  えしおねどすんうむべ         りねぐチクタク　チクタクあいとすと  おぺっどす         ほるとんエヴァ       るとーぐおあがいん  ちえんと            へおるどむ        えーんど            いえど
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Ninety years without slumbering Tick, tock, tick, tock His life seconds numbering, Tick, tock, tick, tock It stopped short never to go again, When the old man died.

strings.text: 谺する機械音／重複する蜜蜂の羽音。地面から突き出す鉄骨の杭／大蛇のように襲い来る配管／導線から放電する雷撃。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Echoing mechanical noises/chorus of bees buzzing. Steel stakes stick out of the ground/tubes strike like serpents/lightning sparks from wires.

strings.text: 抉られ潰され灼かれ、悶える。だからどうした。それがどうした。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I am gouged, beaten, roasted, and in agony. Yeah, so? So what?

strings.text: こちとら激しいプレイがお好みだ。無限螺旋の戦いで徹底的に鍛えられた被虐嗜好、そう簡単に満足すると思ったら大間違いだ！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Impact play is my fetish. My masochism has been thoroughly shaped through the Infinite Spiral's battles; if you think this is enough to satisfy me, you've made a bad call!

strings.text: 「でも……一人でどうやって！？一人なのにどうして！？」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "But...... How can you do it by yourself!? Why do all this even if you are alone!?"

strings.text: 「独りじゃねえ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "I'M NOT ALONE!"

strings.text: 「自惚れるなガキィィ！お前は……俺たちは、ただの一瞬だって独りじゃねえ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Don't get too cocky, kiddo! You...... We're not alone, even for a moment!"

strings.text: ――俺は、友を想った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --I think about my friends.

strings.text: 祖父の遺志を継いで戦った、その華奢な躰を想った。罪も怒りも呑み込んで人を護った、その柔らかな笑顔を想った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I think about her delicate figure as she fought, succeeding her grandfather's will. I think about her gentle smile as she swallowed her sin and fury to protect others.

strings.text: 鋭く迅い拳と、それを手に入れるための覚悟を想った。外道の知識に汚染され、なおも人で在り続ける賢者たちを想った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I think about his keen, lightning-fast fists, and his determination to obtain them. I think about the sages who, though tainted by unholy knowledge, still remain human.

strings.text: 戦う者に仕える人々の、その優しさと朗らかさを想った。戦う者を支える子らの、その輝かしい未来を想った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I think about the kindness and optimism of those who serve the fighters. I think about the bright future of the children who support the fighters.

strings.text: ――俺は、敵を想った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --I think about my enemies.

strings.text: 絶対悪であるという宿命。恐怖と絶望に病み疲れた、その金色を想った。その少年に仕え、傅き、寄り添う少女の、その激しい愛を想った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I think about the fate of being absolute evil, about the Gold who was exhausted from fear and despair. I think about the fierce affection of the devoted, servile girl who was always at the young man's side.

strings.text: 自らの狂気に殉じた、黒き翼を想った。邪神に玩弄された少女の、その慟哭と決意を想った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I think about the obsidian wings who submitted to his madness. I think about the lamentation and resolution of the young girl who was toyed with by the Evil God.

strings.text: ――俺は、馬鹿どもを想った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --I think about the fools.

strings.text: 破壊と混乱をお茶の間に提供する、人格崩壊式科学者を想った。人造人間の三原則の欠片もない、全方位型暴走娘を想った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I think about a deranged, mad scientist who delivers chaos and destruction everywhere. I think about an all-around wild girl who has zero regard for the Three Laws of Robotics.

strings.text: 罵詈雑言が弾雨の如く飛び交う日々の、そのくだらなさを想った。ワリと本気の殺意宿ってる的なじゃれ合いの、そのかけがえのなさを想った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: I think about our daily antics, where streams of insults fly past each other like a hail of bullets. I think about the irreplaceable moments we spent goofing around, which harbor some pretty serious bloodlust.

strings.text: 想えば想うほど溢れ出す、人々の想い。想い。想い。それは自分を縛る呪いのようなものであり――だがしかし、あらゆる力の源泉だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The more I think, the more the people's thoughts overflow. Their feelings. Their desires. It's very much like a spell that binds me-- But at the same time, it's the source of all my power.

strings.text: 「独りじゃないんだ！どんなときだって独りじゃいられないんだ！たとえ一人でも、お前の背中には誰かがいるんだよっ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "We're NOT alone! No matter when, we can never be alone! Even if you are alone, you have someone on your back!"

strings.text: そして――俺は、我が半身を想う。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: --Then, I think about my other half.

strings.text: 糞生意気な古本娘。はた迷惑な傲慢娘。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: That damn cheeky little Miss secondhand book. That little braggart who is always on my nerves.

strings.text: 戦う友よ。愛しき君よ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: My combat partner. My dearest.

strings.text: 「誰かを背中に庇っているから、戦わなくちゃいけないんだ！
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "It's because I'm shielding someone behind me that I have to fight!

strings.text: 誰かが背中を護っているから、戦うことが出来るんだ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: It's because someone has my back that I can fight!"

strings.text: そうだ。俺たちはいつだって共に在る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: That's right. We'll forever be together.

strings.text: どんな死線も、如何なる死地も。良いときも、悪いときも。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: No matter what kind of do-or-die situation, no matter what sort of predicament awaits us. For better, for worse.

strings.text: 富めるとき……はねえかも知れんが、とりあえずは貧しいときも。病めるときも。健やかなるときも。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: For richer...... or perhaps not, though, let's say for poorer for the time being. In sickness and in health.

strings.text: 死がふたりを――分かつとも！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Till death--do us part!

strings.text: 「信じろ、大十字九朔！　お前は決して独りじゃない！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Believe in me, Daijuuji Kuzaku! You're never, EVER, alone!"

strings.text: 「俺が此処にいるぞ！　それに……アルもだ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "I'm right here! Besides...... there's Al too!"

strings.text: そうだ！あいつが！あの人外化生が！あの外道法典が！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Yes! It's her! That inhuman avatar! That unholy manuscript!

strings.text: あのアル・アジフが！……これしきのことで素直に消滅しちまうような、そんな慎み深い性格してるワケがねえ！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: That Al Azif! ......Given how arrogant she is, no way she would suck it up and go poof at just this!

strings.text: あの馬鹿！　いったい今度は何処で、出のタイミング見計らってるんだクソッタレ！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: That moron! Where the bloody hell is she? Waiting for her cue to make an entry!? Shit!

strings.text: 「何でそんなことが……」
strings.speaker: 九朔
strings.translated: "How could that possibly be......"

strings.text: 「信じられるんだよ！　良いか！　俺の物語はこうだ！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "You CAN believe it! Listen up! THIS is my story!"

strings.text: 「光射す世界に！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "In this world of light!"

strings.text: 「涙を救わぬ正義無し！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "There is no place for justice that cannot wipe the tears!"

strings.text: 「我は刃我は鋼我は翼我は風我は空我は光我は速度我は意志我は我は我は勝利勝利勝利するもの敵を敵を敵を撃滅殲滅絶滅するもの我は我は我は我は我が名は――――！」
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: "I am the blade, I am the steel, I am the wings, I am the wind, I am the sky, I am the light, I am the speed, I am the will, I am that which triumphs, I am that which prevails, I am that which conquers, I am that which exterminates my enemies, I am that which annihilates my enemies, I am that which eradicates my enemies, I am, I am, I am, I am, my name is----!"

strings.text: 「アンブロシウス！　翔けろ！」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Ambrose! Soar!"

strings.text: 「……ラバン・シュリュズベリイ！？時空を超えて、来たか！」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "......Laban Shrewsbury!? So you've come after transcending time and space!?"

strings.text: 吹き荒れる爆風。乱れ狂う字祷子の咆吼。物質と霊質との摩擦が、断末魔の軋みを上げる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It is a raging tempest. A howl of maddening Azathoth. The friction between the material and astral elements gives rise to a loud, screeching noise of disintegration.

strings.text: 破壊槌と化した、アンブロシウス飛行形態の突撃。超速で振り下ろされる巨大質量の鉄塊、超高密度の魔素の塊。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Ambrose Flight Mode's charge becomes a hammer of destruction. The supermassive body of steel--the mass of ultra-high density magical essence--is swung at hyper-speed.

strings.text: 触れるもの総てを跡形も無く粉砕する、必壊の一撃。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A finishing blow that pulverizes everything it touches without leaving a single trace.

strings.text: だが――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Yet--

strings.text: 異常な空間の異常な角度から、長大な機械の腕が伸びた。広大な機械の掌が、その途方も無い破壊力の総てを受け止める。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A huge mechanical arm extends from a peculiar angle in the strange space. The massive mechanical palm halts all of that tremendous destructive force.

strings.text: 「視えるか……ラバン・シュリュズベリイ」
strings.speaker: ナイア
strings.translated: "Can you see...... Laban Shrewsbury?"

strings.text: ひび割れる機械の腕。しかし掌はアンブロシウスを放さない。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A crack forms in the mechanical arm. Still, the palm refuses to let go of Ambrose.

strings.text: 女の容をした混沌が、アンブロシウスを見上げる。炎える三つの眼が。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Chaos, appearing as a woman, lifts its face to look at Ambrose. It is the three-lobed burning eye.

strings.text: 「お前の眼にも……この混沌が視えるか？」
strings.speaker: ファーザー・ナイ
strings.translated: "Can your eyes...... also see this Chaos?"

strings.text: 女の口から発せられる聲は、だが不吉にしゃがれた男の聲。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The voice emanating from the woman's mouth, however, is a threatening, hoarse vocalization of a man.

strings.text: 「ダディ！　こいつは……この邪悪は――！」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "Daddy! This being...... This evil is--!"

strings.text: 「ああ、視える！　私の眼にも！私の空虚な眼窩にも！貴様の姿がはっきりと視えるぞ！」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Yeah, I can see it! Even with my very eyes! Even with my empty eyeholes! I can clearly see what your true form is!"

strings.text: 「人類を玩ぶ、邪しき神！人の世を悪路に誘う黒夜の魔王よ！」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "An Evil God that toys with humanity! The nocturnal Demon Lord who leads the world of man to the path of evil!"

strings.text: 「撃ち砕いて魅せよ、人間！人に仇なす姦しき鬼を撃ち滅ぼし、この悪夢を終わらせて魅せよ！」
strings.speaker: ファーザー・ナイ
strings.translated: "Show me how you will break this, human! Show me how you will destroy the chaotic demon that resents man and end this nightmare!"

strings.text: 機械の掌に力がこもる。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The mechanical palm tightens its grip.

strings.text: 金属が拉げ、軋む音が耳に届く。圧し潰される機体が悲鳴を上げている。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A creaking noise of metal being squeezed can be heard. The machine screams as it is being flattened.

strings.text: 「ああああああああああ！」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "AAAAAAAAAARGH!"

strings.text: 「シュリュズベリイ先生！」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "Prof. Shrewsbury!"

strings.text: 「――ぐぅぅぅッ！第四の結印は『旧き印』！
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "--Guuuuh! Ye forth sign is that of ye [Elder Sign]!

strings.text: 脅威と敵意を祓い、我が怨敵を撃ち破るもの也！」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: Banish ye forces of menace and antagonism, and smite mine archenemy!"

strings.text: 刃の煌きが迅る。飛行形態から鬼械神形態に変形したアンブロシウスの死鎌が次元ごと縛めを断った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The blade leaves a swift flash. Ambrose's Death Scythe, transformed from its Flight Mode to Deus Machina Mode, slashes the binding along with the dimension itself.

strings.text: 刃の軌跡は五芒星形――『旧き印』。機械の掌は粉微塵に切断され、破壊の余波は腕にまで伝播する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The trajectory of its blade is a pentagram--the [Elder Sign]. The mechanical palm is cut into atoms, sending a wake of devastation across the arm.

strings.text: 砕け散る機械の腕。螺子と歯車と発条の雨が降る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The mechanical arm crumbles. It rains screws, gears, and springs.

strings.text: 解き放たれたアンブロシウスが舞い降りる。だが機体は潰れ、捻じ曲がり、見るも無残な状態だった。さらには。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Ambrose, after being unleashed, flies down. However, its frame is in a miserable state, looking all squashed and twisted. Worse...

strings.text: 「燃料零……もう限界……ッ」
strings.speaker: ハヅキ
strings.translated: "Fuel zero...... We've hit our limits......!"

strings.text: 機体を奔る術式の光が雲散霧消する。アンブロシウスは、静かにその活動を停止した。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The line of magic formula coursing through the machine dissipates into thin air. Ambrose shuts down as it falls into silence.

strings.text: 混沌機械の部品が、動けぬ機体を埋め尽くしていく。アンブロシウスを己が機関に組み込もうと。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Parts of the Chaos Machina blanket the immobile machine. They are trying to assimilate Ambrose into the system.

strings.text: 「ここまでか……ッ！」
strings.speaker: シュリュズベリイ
strings.translated: "Is this it......!?"

strings.speaker: アズラッド
strings.translated: "--You've done enough!"

strings.text: アンブロシウスが穿った天空の裂け目より、漆黒の機神が飛び込んできた。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: From the aerial rift that Ambrose has opened, an obsidian Machine God barges in.

strings.text: 巨大な魔杖を構え、その砲口を混沌の女へと向ける。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: It prepares a huge magical rod, aiming its muzzle at the woman of Chaos.

strings.text: 「イア！　クトゥグアァァァァ！」
strings.speaker: アズラッド
strings.translated: "Ia! Cthughaaaaa!"

strings.text: 北落師門の彼方にまで届く霊波的大音響が、星気領域を激震させた。宿敵との邂逅に打ち震える妖神の、憤怒と歓喜の絶叫だ。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: A loud spiritual vibration, which reaches up to the remote Fomalhaut, causes the Astral Domain to quake violently. It is a scream of delight and rage from the Demon God, trembling at the encounter with its old rival.

strings.text: 光が爆ぜた。超高熱の顎が、混沌の女を捉える。周囲の機械が一瞬で蒸発する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The light explodes. A super-high heated jaw seizes the woman of Chaos. The surrounding machinery evaporates in a flash.

strings.text: 女もまた煮え滾り、灼け爆ぜる。女の容が熔けて／融けて／解けて――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The woman also boils, burns, and comes apart. Her form melts/dissolves/disperses--

strings.text: 「温ぅございますよ、アズラッド様」
strings.speaker: ニアーラ（ナイア）
strings.translated: "So warm, Sir Azrad."

strings.text: 女の皮を剥ぎ取り、黯黒が爆発的に燃え広がった。炎える闇が、吼える劫火を灼き尽くす。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The darkness quickly bursts into flames, shredding off the woman's skin. The burning darkness incinerates the roaring, world-ending blaze to nothing.

strings.text: 黯黒が結晶する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The darkness takes shape.

strings.text: 柱のような三本の脚。自在に伸縮する腕、鉤爪。触腕状の頭部に咆吼する黒い女の顔――
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Three pillar-like legs. Retractable claws and arms. Atop its tentacular head is the howling face of a black woman--

strings.text: 「ヴーアの無敵の印において！力を……与えよ！」
strings.speaker: アズラッド
strings.translated: "In the invincible sign of Voor! Give...... power!"

strings.text: 邪神目がけて一直線に降下するアイオーンの、その掌に爆炎が生じ、バルザイの偃月刀が鍛え上げられる。全魔力を込めるかのような、全身全霊の一撃が振り下ろされ――！
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: As Aeon descends straight at the Evil God, an inferno arises in its palm, forging the Scimitar of Barzai. It brings down a blow with all its might, as though channeling its entire magic power into it--!

strings.text: 「うおおおおおおおおおおお！」
strings.speaker: アズラッド
strings.translated: "UOOOOOOOOOOOH!"

strings.text: 「なぁっ！？」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "What!?"

strings.text: 「あはははははははっ！」
strings.speaker: ニアーラ（ナイア）
strings.translated: "Ahahahahahahaha!"

strings.text: 偃月刀はいつの間にか、巨大なハリセンに挿げ替えられていた。場違いな快音が、悪夢の空間に響き渡る。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Before anyone knows it, the Scimitar has been replaced with a giant pleated paper slap-fan. An out-of-place smack echoes through the nightmarish space.

strings.text: 「お久しゅうございますね、アズラッド様」
strings.speaker: ニアーラ（ナイア）
strings.translated: "It's been a while, hasn't it, Sir Azrad?"

strings.text: 触腕状の首が、ぐるりと、とぐろを巻いてアイオーンを覗き込む。首の先端に、まるで出来の悪い冗談のようにくっ付いた、黒い肌の女の顔が嗤った。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The tentacular head coils itself around Aeon, peering into it. The dark-skinned woman's face, affixed atop its head like some bad joke, chuckles.

strings.text: 「まだこんなところを、世迷っておいでですか？」
strings.speaker: ニアーラ（ナイア）
strings.translated: "Still roaming about in such a place?"

strings.text: 「ナイアルラトホテップ！」
strings.speaker: アズラッド
strings.translated: "Nyarlathotep!"

strings.text: アイオーンの腕が、邪神を羽交い締めにする。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Aeon's arms put the Evil God in a nelson hold.

strings.text: 急激に高まる魔力。全身の関節が灼熱の炎を噴き、闇色の装甲が赤熱する。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: There is a sudden burst of magic power. The joints of its whole body spout scorching flames, turning its obsidian armor red-hot.

strings.text: 「あはははは！　これはこれは！情熱的な抱擁でございますねえ！」
strings.speaker: ニアーラ（ナイア）
strings.translated: "Ahahahaha! My goodness! What a passionate embrace!"

strings.text: そのとき、アイオーンの周囲に無数の工具――ドライバーやらスパナやらペンチやらニッパーやらバールやら――が顕現した。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: At that moment, countless tools--screwdrivers, wrenches, pliers, nippers, crowbars, and so on--manifest around Aeon.

strings.text: 工具が砂糖に群がる蟻のように、アイオーンに群がる。刹那。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Those tools gather about Aeon like ants swarming to sugar. The next moment...

strings.text: さらに質の悪い冗談。最強の魔導書『アル・アジフ』が招喚する鬼械神、漆黒の機体、最強の機神が――分解された。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: Before us is another sick joke. The Deus Machina summoned by the ultimate Grimoire [Al Azif], the obsidian machine, the strongest Machine God--has been disassembled.

strings.text: 「んな阿呆なっ！？」
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: "You've gotta be shittin' me!?"

strings.text: 螺子が、歯車が、配管が、骨格が、導線が鋼の雪崩となって落下していく。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: Screws, gears, tubes, frames, and wires continue to fall like an avalanche of steel.

strings.text: 地表では、混沌の機械が極上の餌を取り込まんと、狂おしく律動していた。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: On the surface, the Chaos Machina is thumping madly, seeking to devour its finest prey.

strings.text: 鋼の雪崩の只中にひとり、術衣状態のアズラッドが呆然と宙に浮かんでいた。
strings.speaker: 九郎
strings.translated: Amidst the steel avalanche, Azrad, in his Magius Style, is hovering in the air by himself, dumbfounded.

strings.text: 「所詮は神の模造品――鬼械神では私の相手は務まりませんよ。こう見えても一応、私だって神様なものでして」
strings.speaker: ニアーラ（ナイア）
strings.translated: "In the end, an imitation of gods--a Deus Machina is no match for me. I may appear this way, but I'm basically a god, you know."

strings.text: 邪神の躰が炎える闇になって膨張し、しかしそこから急速に凝縮した。
strings.speaker: NARRATION
strings.translated: The Evil God's body swells into burning darkness, but then, it rapidly compresses.

strings.text: 結晶した邪神は再び女の――黒い肌をしたメイドの姿に変わっていた。
